postgres-17.rationale: Starts the database server process; typically managed by pg_ctl rather than invoked directly.

postkick.translation: Send a command to a Postfix service over a local transport channel.
postkick.rationale: Internal Postfix utility for inter-process communication.

postlock.translation: Acquire a Postfix-compatible lock on a file and execute a command.
postlock.rationale: Creates a lock file; the lock is released when the command completes.

postlog.translation: Write a message to the Postfix logging system.
postlog.rationale: Appends a log entry; does not modify mail or configuration.

postmap.translation: Create or query a Postfix lookup table from a text file.
postmap.rationale: Rebuilds lookup tables that affect mail routing and delivery.

postmulti.translation: Manage multiple Postfix instances on the same machine.
postmulti.rationale: Creates, enables, disables, or destroys Postfix instances.

postqueue.translation: View or flush the Postfix mail queue.
postqueue.rationale: Lists queued mail or triggers delivery; does not delete messages.

postsuper.translation: Perform maintenance on the Postfix mail queue.
postsuper.rationale: Can delete, hold, or requeue messages in the mail queue.

powermetrics.translation: Display detailed CPU, GPU, and power usage statistics for the system.
powermetrics.rationale: Read-only monitoring of system power and performance metrics.

pp.translation: Package a Perl script and its dependencies into a standalone executable using PAR.
pp.rationale: Creates a packaged executable file; does not modify the source script.

pp5.34.translation: Package a Perl 5.34 script and its dependencies into a standalone executable using PAR.
pp5.34.rationale: Creates a packaged executable file; does not modify the source script.

ppdc.translation: Compile CUPS printer driver information files.
ppdc.rationale: Generates PPD files from driver info; does not modify printer configuration.

ppdhtml.translation: Generate an HTML summary of a CUPS PPD file.
ppdhtml.rationale: Read-only conversion that writes HTML to the terminal.

ppdi.translation: Import PPD files into a CUPS driver information file.
ppdi.rationale: Modifies a driver info file; does not affect printer configuration.

ppdmerge.translation: Merge two or more CUPS PPD files into a single multi-language file.
ppdmerge.rationale: Creates a merged output file; source files are not modified.

ppdpo.translation: Extract message strings from CUPS PPD files for translation.
ppdpo.rationale: Read-only extraction that writes a PO file.

ppm2tiff.translation: Convert a portable pixmap image file to TIFF format.
ppm2tiff.rationale: Creates a new TIFF file; the source image file is not modified.

pppd.translation: Run the Point-to-Point Protocol background service for establishing network connections.
pppd.rationale: Establishes network connections that change routing and interface configuration.

pr.translation: Format text files for printing with headers, columns, and pagination.
pr.rationale: Read-only formatting that writes to the terminal.

praudit.translation: Print the contents of macOS audit trail files in human-readable format.
praudit.rationale: Read-only display of security audit logs.

prettier.translation: Format source code files according to consistent style rules.
prettier.rationale: By default prints formatted output to stdout without modifying files.

priclass.d.translation: Trace process priority classification using DTrace.

pridist.d.translation: Trace process priority distribution using DTrace.
pridist.d.rationale: Read-only tracing of scheduling priority distribution.

printenv.translation: Print the values of environment variables.

printf.translation: Format and print text to the terminal.
printf.rationale: Read-only output formatting; does not modify files.

printf_gettext.translation: Format and print a translated message string.
printf_gettext.rationale: Read-only output of a translated format string.

printf_ngettext.translation: Format and print a translated message string with plural form support.
printf_ngettext.rationale: Read-only output of a translated plural format string.

procsystime.translation: Trace the time processes spend in system calls using DTrace.
procsystime.rationale: Read-only tracing of system call timing.

productbuild.translation: Build a macOS Installer product archive from component packages.
productbuild.rationale: Creates a product archive file; does not install anything.

productsign.translation: Sign a macOS Installer product archive with a developer identity.
productsign.rationale: Adds a digital signature to a package; does not modify the package contents.

profiles.translation: Manage macOS configuration profiles for device management and policy enforcement.
profiles.rationale: Installs or removes configuration profiles that can change system settings and restrictions.

prove.translation: Run Perl test scripts and display results using the Test Anything Protocol.
prove.rationale: Executes test scripts; primarily a read-only testing operation.

ps.rationale: Read-only snapshot of running processes that does not modify anything.

psm.translation: Run the macOS persistent storage manager utility.
psm.rationale: System utility for storage management diagnostics.

psql.rationale: Connects to a live database where any SQL statement can be executed, including destructive operations.

psql-17.translation: Open the PostgreSQL 17 interactive terminal for executing SQL queries.
psql-17.rationale: Provides direct SQL access to databases, allowing data modification and schema changes.

ptar.translation: Create, list, or extract tar archives using a Perl implementation.
ptar.rationale: Can extract files that overwrite existing data, or create archives from the filesystem.

ptardiff.translation: Show differences between a tar archive and the current filesystem.

ptargrep.translation: Search for patterns inside files within a tar archive.

ptargrep5.34.translation: Search for patterns inside files within a tar archive using Perl 5.34.

purge.translation: Force the macOS disk cache to be purged, freeing inactive memory.
purge.rationale: Clears disk caches; no data is lost as caches are rebuilt on demand.

pwd.translation: Print the full path of the current working directory.
pwd.rationale: Read-only display of the current directory path.

pwd_mkdb.translation: Generate the password database files from the master password file.
pwd_mkdb.rationale: Rebuilds the system password database; errors can lock out users.

pwpolicy.translation: View or set password policies for macOS user accounts.
pwpolicy.rationale: Changes password requirements that can lock out users who do not meet the new policy.

py.test.translation: Run Python tests using the pytest framework.
py.test.rationale: Executes test code; primarily a read-only testing operation.

py.test-benchmark.translation: Run Python benchmarks using the pytest-benchmark plugin.
py.test-benchmark.rationale: Executes benchmark code; a read-only performance measurement.

pydoc3.translation: Display Python 3 documentation for modules, classes, and functions.

pydoc3.12.translation: Display Python 3.12 documentation for modules, classes, and functions.

pydoc3.13.translation: Display Python 3.13 documentation for modules, classes, and functions.

pydoc3.14.translation: Display Python 3.14 documentation for modules, classes, and functions.

pyftsubset.translation: Create a subset of a font file containing only specified glyphs.
pyftsubset.rationale: Creates a new font file; the original is not modified.

pygmentize.translation: Highlight source code syntax and output in various formats.
pygmentize.rationale: Read-only syntax highlighting that writes to the terminal or a file.

pyproject-build.translation: Build a Python package from its pyproject.toml configuration.
pyproject-build.rationale: Creates distribution archives in a build directory; does not install or publish.

pyrsa-decrypt.translation: Decrypt data using an RSA private key.
pyrsa-decrypt.rationale: Read-only decryption that writes plaintext to the terminal.

pyrsa-encrypt.translation: Encrypt data using an RSA public key.
pyrsa-encrypt.rationale: Read-only encryption that writes ciphertext to the terminal.

pyrsa-keygen.translation: Generate a new RSA public and private key pair.
pyrsa-keygen.rationale: Creates new key files; does not modify existing keys.

pyrsa-priv2pub.translation: Extract the public key from an RSA private key.
pyrsa-priv2pub.rationale: Read-only operation that derives a public key from a private key without modifying the original key file.

pyrsa-sign.translation: Create a digital signature for data using an RSA private key.
pyrsa-sign.rationale: Creates a signature; does not modify the input data.

pyrsa-verify.translation: Verify a digital signature against data using an RSA public key.

pytest.translation: Run Python tests using the pytest framework.
pytest.rationale: Executes test code; primarily a read-only testing operation.

pytest-benchmark.translation: Run Python benchmarks using the pytest-benchmark plugin.
pytest-benchmark.rationale: Executes benchmark code; a read-only performance measurement.

python.rationale: Executes arbitrary Python code with full access to the user's environment and files.

python3.rationale: Executes arbitrary Python code, which can modify files, make network requests, or run system commands.

python3-config.translation: Display compiler and linker flags for building Python 3 extensions.
python3-config.rationale: Read-only output of build configuration values.

python3-intel64.translation: Run the Python 3 interpreter in Intel 64-bit mode.
python3-intel64.rationale: Executes arbitrary Python code, which could modify files or system state.

python3.12.rationale: Executes arbitrary Python code, which could modify files or system state.

python3.12-config.translation: Display compiler and linker flags for building Python 3.12 extensions.
python3.12-config.rationale: Read-only output of build configuration values.

python3.12-intel64.translation: Run the Python 3.12 interpreter in Intel 64-bit mode.
python3.12-intel64.rationale: Executes arbitrary Python code, which could modify files or system state.

python3.13.rationale: Executes arbitrary Python code, which could modify files or system state.

python3.13-config.translation: Display compiler and linker flags for building Python 3.13 extensions.
python3.13-config.rationale: Read-only output of build configuration values.

python3.14.rationale: Executes arbitrary Python code, which could modify files or system state.

python3.14-config.translation: Display compiler and linker flags for building Python 3.14 extensions.
python3.14-config.rationale: Read-only output of build configuration values.

pzstd.translation: Compress or decompress files using the Zstandard algorithm with parallel processing.
pzstd.rationale: Creates compressed files alongside originals by default; original files are preserved unless explicitly removed.

qlmanage.translation: Manage and test Quick Look previews and thumbnails for files.
qlmanage.rationale: Generates previews and thumbnails; does not modify the source files.

quota.translation: Display disk usage and quota limits for a user or group.
quota.rationale: Read-only display of disk quota information.

quotacheck.translation: Scan a filesystem and update the disk quota usage database.
quotacheck.rationale: Modifies the quota database files to reflect current disk usage.

quotaoff.translation: Disable disk quotas on a filesystem.
quotaoff.rationale: Disables quota enforcement, allowing users to exceed their limits.

quotaon.translation: Enable disk quotas on a filesystem.
quotaon.rationale: Activates quota enforcement, which may immediately restrict users who exceed limits.

racoon.translation: Run the Internet Key Exchange management background service for IPsec VPN connections.
racoon.rationale: Manages VPN encryption keys and security associations for network tunnels.

rails.translation: Run the Ruby on Rails web application framework command-line tool.
rails.rationale: Can generate code, modify databases, and start web servers.

railway.translation: Run the Railway cloud platform command-line tool.
railway.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

railway delete.rationale: Permanently removes the project and all its services and data from Railway.

railway deploy.translation: Provision a template into a Railway project.
railway deploy.rationale: Creates infrastructure from a template on the Railway platform.

railway down.translation: Remove the most recent deployment from Railway.
railway down.rationale: Takes down a running deployment, which may cause downtime for users.

railway init.rationale: Creates a new empty project on Railway.

railway link.translation: Associate the current directory with a Railway project.
railway link.rationale: Stores a local configuration link; does not modify the remote project.

railway list.translation: List all projects in your Railway account.

railway login.translation: Log in to your Railway account.
railway login.rationale: Stores credentials locally; does not modify projects.

railway logout.translation: Log out of your Railway account.
railway logout.rationale: Removes locally stored authentication credentials, requiring the user to log in again.

railway logs.translation: View build or deploy logs from a Railway deployment.

railway redeploy.translation: Redeploy the latest deployment of a Railway service.
railway redeploy.rationale: Triggers a new deployment that replaces the currently running version.

railway restart.translation: Restart the latest deployment of a Railway service without rebuilding.
railway restart.rationale: Restarts the service, causing brief downtime.

railway run.translation: Run a local command using environment variables from the active Railway environment.
railway run.rationale: Executes an arbitrary command with Railway environment variables injected.

railway status.translation: Show information about the current Railway project.

railway unlink.translation: Remove the association between the current directory and a Railway project.

railway up.translation: Upload and deploy the current project to Railway.
railway up.rationale: Deploys code to a live service that may receive production traffic.

railway variable.translation: Manage environment variables for a Railway service.
railway variable.rationale: Modifies environment variables that affect running services.

rake.translation: Run Ruby build tasks defined in a Rakefile.
rake.rationale: Executes arbitrary Ruby code defined in task files.

ranlib.translation: Add or update the table of contents in a static library archive.
ranlib.rationale: Modifies only the archive index; library contents are unchanged.

rarpd.translation: Run the Reverse Address Resolution background service to respond to address lookup requests.
rarpd.rationale: Responds to network address resolution requests; does not modify system configuration.

raw2tiff.translation: Convert a raw image data file to TIFF format.
raw2tiff.rationale: Creates a new TIFF file; the source file is not modified.

rdjpgcom.translation: Display text comments embedded in a JPEG image file.

rdoc.translation: Generate HTML documentation from Ruby source code and comments.
rdoc.rationale: Creates documentation files; does not modify source code.

read.translation: Read a line of input from standard input into shell variables.
read.rationale: Shell built-in that reads input; does not modify files.

readlink.translation: Show where a shortcut link points to.
readlink.rationale: Read-only display that resolves and prints a link target without modifying anything.

realpath.translation: Show the full, absolute path of a file or directory with all shortcuts resolved.
realpath.rationale: Read-only operation that displays a resolved path without modifying anything.

reboot.rationale: Immediately restarts the system, terminating all running processes and unsaved work.

recode-sr-latin.translation: Convert Serbian text from Cyrillic to Latin script.
recode-sr-latin.rationale: Read-only text conversion that writes to the terminal.

redis-cli.translation: Connect to a Redis data store.
redis-cli.rationale: Connects to a live data store where any command can be executed, including destructive operations like FLUSHALL.

reindexdb.translation: Rebuild indexes in a PostgreSQL database.
reindexdb.rationale: Rebuilds indexes, which temporarily locks tables and uses additional disk space.

reindexdb-17.translation: Rebuild indexes in a PostgreSQL 17 database.
reindexdb-17.rationale: Rebuilds indexes, which temporarily locks tables and uses additional disk space.

render.translation: Render text or templates using a rendering engine.
render.rationale: Produces rendered output; does not modify source files.

renice.translation: Change the scheduling priority of a running process.
renice.rationale: Adjusts how much CPU time a process receives; does not stop or modify the process itself.

repquota.translation: Display a summary report of disk quotas for a filesystem.
repquota.rationale: Read-only display of quota usage across all users.

reset.translation: Reset the terminal to a sane default state.
reset.rationale: Resets terminal settings only; does not modify files or processes.

resgen.rationale: Creates a new resource file; does not modify the source.

resolveLinks.translation: Resolve symbolic links and aliases in a file path.
resolveLinks.rationale: Read-only operation that resolves symbolic links and aliases to display the actual file path.

rev.translation: Reverse the characters in each line of a file.
rev.rationale: Read-only text filter that writes to the terminal.

rg.translation: Search file contents for lines matching a pattern using ripgrep.
rg.rationale: Read-only search that displays matching lines without modifying any files.

ri.translation: Display Ruby API documentation for classes, methods, and modules.

rm.rationale: Removes a single named file; prompts for confirmation if the file is not writable.

rmdir.rationale: Only removes directories that are already empty; fails if the directory contains any files.

rotatelogs.translation: Rotate Apache log files based on time or size without restarting the server.
rotatelogs.rationale: Creates new log files on rotation; old files are preserved.

route.translation: View or modify the network routing table.
route.rationale: Changes to the routing table affect how network traffic is directed, potentially disrupting connectivity.

route add.translation: Add a new route to the network routing table.
route add.rationale: Incorrect routes can misdirect traffic or cause network connectivity loss.

route change.translation: Modify an existing route in the network routing table.
route change.rationale: Changing a route can redirect traffic to the wrong destination or break connectivity.

route delete.translation: Remove a route from the network routing table.
route delete.rationale: Deleting a route can immediately break connectivity to the affected destination.

route flush.translation: Remove all routes from the network routing table.
route flush.rationale: Deletes every route, immediately breaking all network connectivity until routes are restored.

route get.translation: Look up and display the route used to reach a destination.

route monitor.translation: Continuously display changes to the routing table in real time.

rpc.lockd.translation: Run the NFS file locking background service.
rpc.lockd.rationale: System background service for NFS lock management; typically started by launchd.

rpc.statd.translation: Run the NFS status monitoring background service.
rpc.statd.rationale: System background service for NFS crash recovery notifications.

rpcbind.translation: Run the RPC port mapper background service for mapping RPC services to ports.
rpcbind.rationale: System background service that maps RPC program numbers to network ports.

rpcgen.translation: Generate C code for RPC client and server stubs from an RPC protocol specification.
rpcgen.rationale: Generates source code files; does not modify system state.

rpcinfo.translation: Display information about registered RPC services.
rpcinfo.rationale: Read-only query of the RPC port mapper.

rs.translation: Reshape a data array by rearranging rows and columns.
rs.rationale: Read-only text transformation that writes to the terminal.

rst2html.rationale: Read-only conversion that writes HTML output.

rst2html4.rationale: Converts reStructuredText markup to HTML4 output; does not modify the source file.

rst2html5.rationale: Converts reStructuredText markup to HTML5 output; does not modify the source file.

rst2latex.translation: Convert reStructuredText documents to LaTeX format.
rst2latex.rationale: Converts reStructuredText markup to LaTeX output; does not modify the source file.

rst2man.translation: Convert reStructuredText documents to Unix manual page format.
rst2man.rationale: Converts reStructuredText markup to manual page format; does not modify the source file.

rst2odt.translation: Convert reStructuredText documents to OpenDocument format.
rst2odt.rationale: Converts reStructuredText markup to OpenDocument format; does not modify the source file.

rst2pseudoxml.translation: Convert reStructuredText documents to pseudo-XML for debugging.
rst2pseudoxml.rationale: Converts reStructuredText markup to pseudo-XML output; does not modify the source file.

rst2s5.translation: Convert reStructuredText documents to S5 slideshow format.
rst2s5.rationale: Converts reStructuredText markup to S5 slideshow format; does not modify the source file.

rst2xetex.translation: Convert reStructuredText documents to XeTeX format.
rst2xetex.rationale: Converts reStructuredText markup to XeTeX output; does not modify the source file.

rst2xml.translation: Convert reStructuredText documents to XML format.
rst2xml.rationale: Converts reStructuredText markup to XML output; does not modify the source file.

rsvg-convert.translation: Convert SVG images to PNG, PDF, or other raster formats.
rsvg-convert.rationale: Creates a new output file; the source SVG is not modified.

rsync.translation: Synchronize files and directories between two locations.
rsync.rationale: Copies and synchronizes files, potentially overwriting files at the destination.

rtadvd.translation: Run the IPv6 router advertisement background service.
rtadvd.rationale: Sends router advertisements that affect IPv6 network configuration for connected devices.

ruby.rationale: Executes arbitrary Ruby code, which can modify files, make network requests, or run system commands.

ruff.translation: Run the Ruff Python linter and formatter.
ruff.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

ruff check.translation: Analyze Python source code for lint errors and style violations.
ruff check.rationale: Read-only static analysis that reports problems but does not modify files by default.

ruff format.translation: Format Python source code to a consistent style.
ruff format.rationale: Reformats Python files in place; changes are purely stylistic and reversible via version control.

rust-gdbgui.translation: Launch a graphical GDB debugging interface for Rust programs.
rust-gdbgui.rationale: Starts a debugging interface; does not modify program binaries.

rust-lldb.translation: Launch the LLDB debugger with Rust-specific formatting support.
rust-lldb.rationale: Starts a debugging session; does not modify program binaries.

rustc.translation: Compile Rust source code into an executable or library.
rustc.rationale: Compiles code locally; does not execute it or modify existing files beyond the output.

rustdoc.translation: Generate HTML documentation from Rust source code and doc comments.
rustdoc.rationale: Creates documentation files; does not modify source code.

rustfmt.translation: Format Rust source code according to standard style guidelines.
rustfmt.rationale: Modifies only whitespace and formatting; program semantics are unchanged.

rustup.translation: Run the Rust toolchain installer and manager.
rustup.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

rustup check.translation: Check for available updates to Rust toolchains and rustup.
rustup check.rationale: Read-only check that does not install anything.

rustup component.translation: Manage components of a Rust toolchain.
rustup component.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

rustup component add.translation: Add a component to the active Rust toolchain.
rustup component add.rationale: Downloads and installs a component locally.

rustup component remove.translation: Remove a component from the active Rust toolchain.
rustup component remove.rationale: Removes a local component; can be re-added.

rustup default.rationale: Changes which toolchain is used by default; easily reversible.

rustup doc.translation: Open the Rust documentation in a browser.
rustup doc.rationale: Opens a local documentation page; does not modify anything.

rustup override.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

rustup override set.translation: Set a Rust toolchain override for the current directory.
rustup override set.rationale: Changes which toolchain is used in this directory; easily reversible.

rustup override unset.translation: Remove the Rust toolchain override for the current directory.
rustup override unset.rationale: Restores the default toolchain for this directory.

rustup run.translation: Run a command with a specific Rust toolchain's environment.
rustup run.rationale: Executes an arbitrary command in the toolchain environment.

rustup self uninstall.translation: Uninstall rustup and all installed Rust toolchains.
rustup self uninstall.rationale: Removes the entire Rust installation from the system.

rustup show.translation: Show the active and installed Rust toolchains.

rustup target.translation: Manage compilation targets for a Rust toolchain.
rustup target.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

rustup target add.translation: Add a compilation target to the active toolchain.
rustup target add.rationale: Downloads target support files; does not modify existing projects.

rustup target remove.translation: Remove a compilation target from the active toolchain.
rustup target remove.rationale: Removes locally installed target files; can be re-added.

rustup toolchain.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

rustup toolchain install.rationale: Downloads and installs a toolchain locally.

rustup toolchain uninstall.rationale: Removes a local toolchain; can be reinstalled.

rustup update.translation: Update installed Rust toolchains and rustup itself.
rustup update.rationale: Downloads and installs newer toolchain versions locally.

rustup which.translation: Display the path to the binary that would be run for a given command.

rvictl.translation: Create or manage a remote virtual network interface for capturing iOS device traffic.
rvictl.rationale: Creates a virtual interface for packet capture; does not modify device data.

rview.translation: Open the Vim text editor in read-only, restricted mode.
rview.rationale: Read-only editor mode that prevents file modification and shell commands.

rvim.translation: Open the Vim text editor in restricted mode.
rvim.rationale: Restricted mode prevents shell commands and external program execution.

rwbypid.d.translation: Trace read and write activity by process ID using DTrace.

rwbytype.d.translation: Trace read and write activity by type using DTrace.

rwsnoop.translation: Trace read and write system calls in real time using DTrace.
rwsnoop.rationale: Read-only tracing of I/O system calls.

sa.translation: Display system accounting statistics from process accounting records.
sa.rationale: Read-only display of historical accounting data.

safaridriver.translation: Run the Safari WebDriver server for automated browser testing.
safaridriver.rationale: Controls Safari browser programmatically, navigating to URLs and interacting with web pages.

sample.translation: Profile a running process by periodically sampling its call stack.
sample.rationale: Read-only profiling that does not modify the target process.

sampleproc.translation: Sample running processes at regular intervals using DTrace.

sandbox-exec.translation: Execute a command within a macOS sandbox with restricted permissions.
sandbox-exec.rationale: Restricts the executed command to a sandbox, reducing rather than increasing risk.

say.rationale: Read-only text-to-speech conversion that only produces audio output.

sc_auth.translation: Configure SmartCard authentication for user accounts.
sc_auth.rationale: Modifies authentication settings for local accounts; changes are reversible but affect login security.

sc_auth changepin.translation: Change or unblock a SmartCard PIN.
sc_auth changepin.rationale: Modifies the SmartCard PIN; incorrect attempts can lock the card.

sc_auth create-ctk-csr.translation: Create a certificate signing request for a CryptoTokenKit identity.
sc_auth create-ctk-csr.rationale: Generates a CSR file; does not modify existing keys or identities.

sc_auth create-ctk-identity.translation: Create a new CryptoTokenKit identity with a key pair.
sc_auth create-ctk-identity.rationale: Generates a new cryptographic identity in the Secure Enclave; reversible by deletion.

sc_auth delete-all-ctk-identities.rationale: Irrecoverably destroys all CryptoTokenKit identities including non-exportable keys; broad blast radius with no undo.

sc_auth delete-ctk-identity.translation: Delete a CryptoTokenKit identity by its public key hash.
sc_auth delete-ctk-identity.rationale: Permanently removes a cryptographic identity; if the key was non-exportable, it cannot be recovered.

sc_auth enable_for_login.translation: Enable a SmartCard token extension for system login.
sc_auth enable_for_login.rationale: Changes system authentication configuration; reversible but affects login flow.

sc_auth export-ctk-identity.translation: Export a CryptoTokenKit identity to a file.
sc_auth export-ctk-identity.rationale: Reads an identity and writes it to a file; no destructive action.

sc_auth filevault.translation: Manage SmartCard support for FileVault disk encryption unlock.
sc_auth filevault.rationale: Modifies FileVault unlock configuration; incorrect changes could complicate disk access recovery.

sc_auth identities.translation: List all identities on all connected SmartCards.

sc_auth import-ctk-certificate.translation: Import a certificate for an existing CryptoTokenKit identity.
sc_auth import-ctk-certificate.rationale: Associates a certificate with an identity; reversible but affects authentication trust.

sc_auth import-ctk-identities.translation: Import CryptoTokenKit identities from a file.
sc_auth import-ctk-identities.rationale: Adds identities to the system from a file; reversible by deletion.

sc_auth list.translation: List all public keys associated with a user account.

sc_auth pair.translation: Associate a user account with a SmartCard public key.
sc_auth pair.rationale: Modifies the user's keychain to allow SmartCard unlock; reversible with unpair.

sc_auth pairing_ui.translation: Control whether the SmartCard pairing dialog appears when an unpaired card is inserted.
sc_auth pairing_ui.rationale: Toggles a dialog prompt preference; no authentication state is changed.

sc_auth unpair.translation: Remove the association between a user account and a SmartCard key.
sc_auth unpair.rationale: Removes SmartCard authentication binding; user can still log in with password.

sc_auth verifypin.translation: Verify a SmartCard PIN without changing anything.
sc_auth verifypin.rationale: Read-only PIN verification that does not modify state.

sc_usage.translation: Show system call usage statistics for a process in real time.
sc_usage.rationale: Read-only monitoring of system call activity; modifies nothing.

scalar.translation: Manage large Git repositories with performance optimizations.
scalar.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

scalar clone.translation: Clone a repository with Scalar performance optimizations enabled.
scalar clone.rationale: Creates a new local repository and downloads data from a remote; disk space is consumed but no existing data is modified.

scalar delete.translation: Delete a Scalar enlistment from the local file system.
scalar delete.rationale: Removes the entire enlistment directory including the repository; recovery requires re-cloning or backups.

scalar diagnose.translation: Collect diagnostic information about a Scalar enlistment into a zip file.
scalar diagnose.rationale: Read-only data gathering that writes a zip file; no destructive action.

scalar list.translation: List all repositories currently registered with Scalar.

scalar reconfigure.translation: Reapply Scalar's optimized Git configuration to a registered repository.
scalar reconfigure.rationale: Updates Git config settings; does not modify repository content.

scalar register.translation: Register a repository with Scalar and start background maintenance.
scalar register.rationale: Adds a repository to the maintenance list; trivially reversible with unregister.

scalar run.translation: Run a specified maintenance task on a registered repository.
scalar run.rationale: Executes Git maintenance operations like repacking; optimizes internal storage without data loss.

scalar unregister.translation: Remove a repository from Scalar's list and stop background maintenance.
scalar unregister.rationale: Stops maintenance scheduling; does not delete any data.

scandeps.pl.translation: Scan Perl files and report their module dependencies.
scandeps.pl.rationale: Read-only static analysis of Perl source files; does not modify anything.

scp.translation: Copy files between the local machine and a remote server over SSH.
scp.rationale: Transfers files over the network, potentially overwriting files at the destination.

screen.translation: Start a terminal multiplexer session that persists after disconnecting.
screen.rationale: Creates a persistent terminal session; does not modify files.

screencapture.translation: Capture images or video from the screen and save them to a file or clipboard.
screencapture.rationale: Creates a screenshot file; does not modify existing files or system state.

script.translation: Record a terminal session to a file.
script.rationale: Creates a transcript file of terminal output; does not modify existing files.

scselect.translation: Select or display the active network location configuration.
scselect.rationale: Switching locations immediately reconfigures network settings, which can disrupt connectivity.

scutil.translation: Manage system configuration parameters and network settings.
scutil.rationale: The bare command opens an interactive shell for querying the dynamic store; no changes without explicit subcommands.

scutil --dns.rationale: Read-only display of DNS resolver settings.

scutil --get.translation: Retrieve a system configuration preference such as the hostname.
scutil --get.rationale: Read-only query of a system preference value.

scutil --nc.translation: Monitor and interact with VPN network connections.
scutil --nc.rationale: Can start, stop, or reconfigure VPN connections, affecting network connectivity.

scutil --proxy.translation: Display the current system proxy configuration.

scutil --renew.translation: Trigger a re-evaluation of network configuration on a specified interface.
scutil --renew.rationale: Forces network reconfiguration which may briefly disrupt connectivity on the interface.

scutil --set.translation: Update a system configuration preference such as the hostname.
scutil --set.rationale: Changes system identity settings like ComputerName or HostName; reversible but affects network identity.

sdef.translation: Extract the scripting definition from a scriptable application.
sdef.rationale: Read-only extraction of AppleScript dictionary to standard output; modifies nothing.

sdiff.translation: Display two files side by side highlighting differences.
sdiff.rationale: Read-only comparison of two files; modifies nothing by default.

sdp.translation: Process a scripting definition file into various output formats.
sdp.rationale: Transforms an sdef file into header or resource files; creates new files without modifying originals.

sdx.translation: Run the Starkit Developer Extension for building and managing Tcl Starkits.
sdx.rationale: The bare command prints available subcommands and modifies nothing.

sdx lsk.translation: List the contents of a Starkit archive.

sdx mkpack.translation: Copy and optimally repack a Starkit to remove unused areas.
sdx mkpack.rationale: Creates a new optimized copy; the original file is unchanged.

sdx mksplit.translation: Split a Starkit into head and tail parts.
sdx mksplit.rationale: Creates new split files; the original Starkit is unchanged.

sdx qwrap.translation: Create a Starkit from a single Tcl script.
sdx qwrap.rationale: Creates a new archive file from a script; does not modify existing files.

sdx unwrap.translation: Extract the contents of a Starkit into a directory.
sdx unwrap.rationale: Extracts files into a new directory; does not modify the original Starkit.

sdx version.translation: Display the version ID of a Starkit.

sdx wrap.translation: Create a Starkit archive from a directory structure.
sdx wrap.rationale: Creates a new archive file; does not modify existing files.

security.translation: Manage keychains, keys, certificates, and other Security framework operations.
security.rationale: The bare command enters interactive mode or prints help; no modifications without subcommands.

security add-certificates.translation: Add certificates from files to a keychain.
security add-certificates.rationale: Imports certificate data into a keychain; does not modify existing entries.

security add-generic-password.translation: Add a generic password item to a keychain.
security add-generic-password.rationale: Adds a new entry; does not modify or delete existing items.

security add-internet-password.translation: Add an internet password item to a keychain.
security add-internet-password.rationale: Adds a new entry; does not modify or delete existing items.

security add-trusted-cert.translation: Add a certificate to the system's trusted certificate store.
security add-trusted-cert.rationale: Changes which certificates are trusted for TLS and code signing; reversible but affects system security posture.

security authorizationdb.translation: Read or modify the system authorization policy database.
security authorizationdb.rationale: Changes to the authorization database affect which operations require admin privileges system-wide.

security authorize.translation: Perform authorization operations using the Security framework.
security authorize.rationale: Requests or creates authorization rights; may elevate privileges for subsequent operations.

security cms.translation: Encode or decode Cryptographic Message Syntax messages.
security cms.rationale: Processes cryptographic message data; read-only transformation with no system state changes.

security create-keychain.rationale: Creates a new keychain file; does not modify existing keychains.

security create-keypair.translation: Create an asymmetric key pair in a keychain.
security create-keypair.rationale: Generates cryptographic keys that persist in the keychain; reversible by deletion.

security default-keychain.translation: Display or set the default keychain.
security default-keychain.rationale: Viewing or changing which keychain is the default is trivially reversible.

security delete-certificate.translation: Delete a certificate from a keychain.
security delete-certificate.rationale: Permanently removes a certificate; may break code signing or TLS trust until restored.

security delete-generic-password.translation: Delete a generic password item from a keychain.
security delete-generic-password.rationale: Permanently removes a stored credential; recovery requires re-entry or backup restoration.

security delete-identity.translation: Delete a certificate and its associated private key from a keychain.
security delete-identity.rationale: Permanently removes both the certificate and private key; the private key may be irrecoverable.

security delete-internet-password.translation: Delete an internet password item from a keychain.
security delete-internet-password.rationale: Permanently removes a stored credential; recovery requires re-entry or backup restoration.

security delete-keychain.translation: Delete keychains and remove them from the search list.
security delete-keychain.rationale: Permanently removes keychain files containing passwords and certificates; recovery requires backups.

security dump-keychain.translation: Dump the contents of one or more keychains.
security dump-keychain.rationale: Read-only display of keychain items; with -d may expose passwords but does not modify state.

security dump-trust-settings.translation: Display the contents of trust settings.
security dump-trust-settings.rationale: Read-only display of certificate trust configuration.

security error.translation: Display a descriptive message for a given Security framework error code.
security error.rationale: Read-only error code lookup; modifies nothing.

security execute-with-privileges.translation: Execute a tool with elevated privileges.
security execute-with-privileges.rationale: Runs arbitrary commands with elevated permissions; equivalent to granting sudo access.

security export.translation: Export items from a keychain to a file.
security export.rationale: Reads keychain items and writes them to a file; the keychain itself is not modified.

security find-certificate.translation: Find a certificate item in the keychain.
security find-certificate.rationale: Read-only search and display of certificates.

security find-generic-password.translation: Find and display a generic password item from a keychain.
security find-generic-password.rationale: Read-only search and display of keychain items.

security find-identity.translation: Find an identity consisting of a certificate and its private key.
security find-identity.rationale: Read-only search and display of identity items.

security find-internet-password.translation: Find and display an internet password item from a keychain.
security find-internet-password.rationale: Read-only search and display of keychain items.

security find-key.translation: Search the keychain for cryptographic keys.
security find-key.rationale: Read-only search of keys in the keychain.

security import.translation: Import items from a file into a keychain.
security import.rationale: Adds keys, certificates, or identities to a keychain; may overwrite existing trust settings.

security list-keychains.translation: Display or set the keychain search list.
security list-keychains.rationale: Displays keychain paths by default; setting the search list is low-impact and reversible.

security lock-keychain.translation: Lock a keychain so its contents cannot be accessed without a password.
security lock-keychain.rationale: Temporarily restricts access; unlocking reverses the action.

security login-keychain.translation: Display or set the login keychain.
security login-keychain.rationale: Viewing or changing the login keychain reference is trivially reversible.

security remove-trusted-cert.translation: Remove a certificate from the trusted certificate store.
security remove-trusted-cert.rationale: May break trust chains for TLS connections or code signing until the certificate is re-added.

security set-keychain-password.translation: Change the password for a keychain.
security set-keychain-password.rationale: Alters the keychain's encryption password; forgetting the new password could lock out access.

security set-keychain-settings.translation: Configure auto-lock settings for a keychain.
security set-keychain-settings.rationale: Changes timeout and sleep-lock preferences; trivially reversible.

security show-keychain-info.translation: Display the settings for a keychain.

security smartcards.translation: Enable, disable, or list disabled SmartCard tokens.
security smartcards.rationale: Enables or disables SmartCard authentication tokens; affects login methods.

security trust-settings-export.translation: Export trust settings to a file.
security trust-settings-export.rationale: Reads trust settings and writes to a file; no system modification.

security trust-settings-import.translation: Import trust settings from a file.
security trust-settings-import.rationale: Modifies which certificates are trusted; reversible but affects the system's security posture.

security unlock-keychain.translation: Unlock a keychain to allow access to its contents.
security unlock-keychain.rationale: Exposes keychain contents to authorized applications; the security posture is reduced until re-locked.

security verify-cert.translation: Verify the validity of one or more certificates.

securityd.translation: Run the security context background service for keychain and cryptographic operations.
securityd.rationale: System background service not intended for direct invocation; launching it manually has no destructive effect.

secutil.translation: Extract strongname and X509 certificate information from .NET assemblies.
secutil.rationale: Read-only extraction and display of certificate data; modifies nothing.

sed.translation: Find and replace text, or apply other editing rules, across lines of input.
sed.rationale: By default, outputs transformed text to the terminal without modifying the original file.

seeksize.d.translation: Print a report of disk event seek distances by process using DTrace.
seeksize.d.rationale: Read-only monitoring of disk seeks; modifies nothing.

segedit.translation: Extract or replace sections in Apple platform object files.
segedit.rationale: Can modify binary files when replacing sections; extraction is read-only but replacement alters executables.

sendmail.translation: Send email messages via the Postfix mail system.
sendmail.rationale: Delivers email to recipients; messages cannot be unsent once delivered.

seq.rationale: Outputs numbers to standard output; modifies nothing.

serverinfo.translation: Query macOS Server hardware, software, and configuration status.
serverinfo.rationale: Read-only queries about server status by default.

setkey.translation: Manipulate the IPsec Security Association and Security Policy databases in the kernel.
setkey.rationale: Modifies kernel-level IPsec configuration; incorrect entries can disrupt network connectivity or security.

setquota.translation: Set home directory disk quotas for users on the local computer.
setquota.rationale: Applies disk quota limits that can restrict users' ability to save files; reversible by removing quotas.

setreg.translation: Change settings for public key cryptography trust in the Mono runtime.
setreg.rationale: Modifies cryptographic trust settings which affect code signing verification; reversible but affects security posture.

setuids.d.translation: Monitor privilege-elevation system calls as they occur using DTrace.
setuids.d.rationale: Read-only monitoring of privilege-elevation events; modifies nothing.

sfltool.translation: Create a diagnostic snapshot of SharedFileList data.
sfltool.rationale: Creates a read-only archive of SharedFileList state for debugging; modifies nothing.

sftp.translation: Open an interactive secure file transfer session with a remote server.
sftp.rationale: Provides interactive file transfer capabilities that can upload, download, and delete remote files.

sgen.translation: Generate XML serialization assemblies for .NET types.
sgen.rationale: Creates serialization helper assemblies; does not modify existing files.

sh.translation: Run the standards-compliant-compliant command interpreter shell.
sh.rationale: Launches an interactive shell or executes scripts; the shell itself is just an interpreter.

sha1.translation: Compute SHA-1 message digests for files.

sha1sum.translation: Compute or verify SHA-1 checksums in GNU-compatible format.

sha224.translation: Compute SHA-224 message digests for files.

sha224sum.translation: Compute or verify SHA-224 checksums in GNU-compatible format.

sha256.translation: Compute SHA-256 message digests for files.

sha256sum.translation: Compute or verify SHA-256 checksums in GNU-compatible format.

sha384.translation: Compute SHA-384 message digests for files.

sha384sum.translation: Compute or verify SHA-384 checksums in GNU-compatible format.

sha512.translation: Compute SHA-512 message digests for files.

sha512sum.translation: Compute or verify SHA-512 checksums in GNU-compatible format.

shar.translation: Create a shell archive that can recreate files when run through sh.
shar.rationale: Writes a shell script to standard output; does not modify any files.

sharing.translation: Manage SMB file sharing share points on macOS.
sharing.rationale: Creates and modifies network share points which expose directories to other users on the network.

shasum.translation: Compute or verify SHA checksums for files.

shazam.translation: Run the ShazamKit command-line utility for audio recognition.
shazam.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

shazam custom-catalog.rationale: Creates or manages catalog files for audio recognition.

shazam signature.translation: Generate a Shazam audio signature file from audio input.
shazam signature.rationale: Creates a signature file; does not modify existing files.

shlock.translation: Create or verify a lock file for shell scripts.
shlock.rationale: Creates a small lock file containing a PID; trivially reversible by removing the file.

shortcuts.translation: Run the Shortcuts command-line utility for managing and executing shortcuts.
shortcuts.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

shortcuts run.rationale: Runs a shortcut which may perform arbitrary actions depending on its contents.

shortcuts sign.translation: Sign a shortcut file for distribution.
shortcuts sign.rationale: Creates a signed version of a shortcut file; does not modify the original.

shortcuts view.translation: Open a shortcut in the Shortcuts application for viewing.
shortcuts view.rationale: Opens the Shortcuts app; does not modify the shortcut.

showmount.translation: Display NFS mount information for a remote host.
showmount.rationale: Read-only query of NFS mount status; modifies nothing.

shutdown.translation: Shut down, reboot, or put the system to sleep at a specified time.
shutdown.rationale: Halts or reboots the entire system, terminating all running processes and potentially causing data loss.

sigdist.d.translation: Display the distribution of signals sent between processes using DTrace.
sigdist.d.rationale: Read-only monitoring of signal activity; modifies nothing.

signcode.translation: Digitally sign a .NET assembly or executable with an Authenticode certificate.
signcode.rationale: Modifies a binary file by embedding a digital signature; reversible by re-signing or stripping.

sips.translation: Process and modify raster image files and ColorSync color profiles.
sips.rationale: Modifies image files in place by default; changes can be directed to a separate output with --out.

size.translation: Print the size of sections in an Apple platform object file.
size.rationale: Read-only display of segment and section sizes; modifies nothing.

skywalkctl.translation: Control and query the Skywalk networking subsystem.
skywalkctl.rationale: Limited public documentation; appears to manage kernel-level networking but exact behavior is unclear.

slapacl.translation: Test access control list evaluation for an LDAP database.
slapacl.rationale: Read-only testing of ACL rules; does not modify the database or configuration.

slapadd.translation: Add entries from an LDAP data interchange file directly into an LDAP database.
slapadd.rationale: Directly modifies the LDAP database bypassing the server; incorrect entries can corrupt directory data.

slapauth.translation: Test authentication and authorization mappings for an LDAP database.
slapauth.rationale: Read-only testing of auth mappings; does not modify the database.

slapcat.translation: Export the contents of an LDAP database to LDAP data interchange format.
slapcat.rationale: Read-only export of database contents; the database is not modified.

slapconfig.translation: Configure the OpenDirectory LDAP server and related background services.
slapconfig.rationale: Modifies LDAP server configuration; incorrect changes can break directory services and authentication.

slapdn.translation: Test distinguished name normalization for an LDAP database.
slapdn.rationale: Read-only distinguished name validation; does not modify the database.

slapindex.translation: Regenerate indexes for an LDAP database.
slapindex.rationale: Rebuilds database indexes which requires the server to be stopped; incorrect use can leave indexes inconsistent.

slappasswd.translation: Generate a hashed password suitable for use in LDAP configurations.
slappasswd.rationale: Produces a password hash on standard output; does not modify any files or databases.

slapschema.translation: Check the schema compliance of entries in an LDAP database.
slapschema.rationale: Read-only schema validation; does not modify the database.

slaptest.translation: Test the validity of an LDAP server configuration.
slaptest.rationale: Validates configuration syntax without starting the server or modifying data.

sleep.translation: Pause execution for a specified amount of time.
sleep.rationale: Blocks the current shell for the given duration; no files or state are modified.

slogin.translation: Open a secure shell connection to a remote host.
slogin.rationale: Establishes an SSH session to a remote system; commands executed remotely can modify remote state.

smbd.translation: Run the SMB file sharing server background service.
smbd.rationale: Exposes file system directories over the network; normally managed by launchd rather than invoked directly.

smbdiagnose.translation: Gather diagnostic information for troubleshooting SMB file sharing issues.
smbdiagnose.rationale: Collects system state and network traces for debugging; does not modify SMB configuration.

smbutil.translation: Interact with the SMB network file sharing subsystem.
smbutil.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

smbutil dfs.translation: Display Distributed File System referrals for a specified SMB URL.
smbutil dfs.rationale: Read-only operation that queries Distributed File System referral information from the server without making changes.

smbutil identity.translation: Display the authenticated user identity as known by an SMB server.
smbutil identity.rationale: Read-only operation that displays the current SMB identity information without making changes.

smbutil lookup.translation: Resolve a NetBIOS name to an IP address.

smbutil multichannel.translation: Display multichannel connection information for mounted SMB shares.

smbutil snapshot.translation: List available snapshots for a mounted SMB share.
smbutil snapshot.rationale: Read-only operation that lists available server-side snapshots without modifying or deleting any.

smbutil statshares.translation: Display attributes of mounted SMB shares.

smbutil status.translation: Resolve a hostname to its NetBIOS workgroup and system name.
smbutil status.rationale: Read-only operation that queries the SMB server for its network status without making changes.

smbutil view.translation: List shared resources available on an SMB server.

sml.translation: Run the Standard ML of New Jersey interactive compiler and interpreter.
sml.rationale: Launches an interactive programming environment; does not modify files without explicit program instructions.

sn.translation: Manage strong name keys and signatures for .NET assemblies.
sn.rationale: Can generate keys and sign assemblies, modifying binary files.

sndiskmove.translation: Migrate the contents of an Xsan disk to a new disk.
sndiskmove.rationale: Copies and relabels disk volumes; incorrect use on active filesystems causes data corruption.

snfsdefrag.translation: Defragment files on an Xsan volume by consolidating extents.
snfsdefrag.rationale: Rewrites file data to reduce fragmentation; the files are preserved but disk layout changes.

snmp-bridge-mib.translation: Provide SNMP bridge MIB information from the local system.
snmp-bridge-mib.rationale: Read-only bridge MIB data provider; does not modify network configuration.

snmpbulkget.translation: Retrieve a large set of values from a network device in a single efficient SNMP request.
snmpbulkget.rationale: Read-only bulk SNMP query; does not modify the remote device.

snmpbulkwalk.translation: Retrieve all values in a section of a network device's management data using efficient bulk SNMP requests.
snmpbulkwalk.rationale: Read-only bulk SNMP walk; does not modify the remote device.

snmpconf.rationale: Creates or modifies SNMP configuration files that control how SNMP services behave.

snmpd.translation: Run the SNMP agent background service to respond to SNMP queries about the local system.
snmpd.rationale: Exposes system information via SNMP; normally managed by launchd.

snmpdelta.translation: Monitor how counter values change over time on a network device using SNMP.
snmpdelta.rationale: Read-only monitoring of SNMP counters; does not modify the remote device.

snmpdf.translation: Display disk space usage on a remote device via SNMP.
snmpdf.rationale: Read-only disk usage query; does not modify the remote device.

snmpget.translation: Retrieve a specific value from a network device using SNMP.
snmpget.rationale: Read-only SNMP request; does not modify the remote device.

snmpgetnext.translation: Retrieve the next SNMP variable in the MIB tree from a network device.
snmpgetnext.rationale: Read-only SNMP GETNEXT request; does not modify the remote device.

snmpinform.translation: Send an SNMP inform notification to a remote manager with acknowledgment.
snmpinform.rationale: Sends a notification to a monitoring system; may trigger alerts or automated responses.

snmpnetstat.translation: Display network connection and interface information from a remote device using SNMP.
snmpnetstat.rationale: Read-only network status query; does not modify the remote device.

snmpset.translation: Set the value of a variable on a network device using SNMP.
snmpset.rationale: Modifies configuration or state on a remote network device; incorrect values can disrupt services.

snmpstatus.translation: Retrieve a summary of status information from a network device using SNMP.
snmpstatus.rationale: Read-only status query; does not modify the remote device.

snmptable.translation: Retrieve and display a table of management data from a network device using SNMP.
snmptable.rationale: Read-only table query; does not modify the remote device.

snmptest.translation: Interactively send arbitrary SNMP requests to a network device.
snmptest.rationale: Can send both read and write requests depending on user input, so it has the potential to modify device state.

snmptranslate.translation: Convert SNMP object names between human-readable and numeric formats.
snmptranslate.rationale: Local-only name translation; no network communication or state modification.

snmptrap.translation: Send an SNMP notification to a monitoring system.
snmptrap.rationale: Sends a notification that may trigger alerts or automated responses on the receiving system.

snmptrapd.translation: Run the SNMP trap receiver background service to listen for incoming notifications.
snmptrapd.rationale: Listens for incoming SNMP traps; does not modify remote devices.

snmpusm.translation: Manage SNMP user accounts on a network device.
snmpusm.rationale: Creates, deletes, or modifies SNMP user credentials on network devices; incorrect changes can lock out management access.

snmpvacm.translation: Manage SNMP access control rules on a network device.
snmpvacm.rationale: Modifies access control rules on network devices; incorrect changes can expose sensitive data or lock out management access.

snmpwalk.translation: Retrieve all values in a section of a network device's management data using SNMP.
snmpwalk.rationale: Read-only SNMP walk; does not modify the remote device.

snquota.translation: Manage disk quotas on Xsan volumes.
snquota.rationale: Sets or modifies quota limits which can restrict users' ability to write data; reversible by adjusting quotas.

sntp.translation: Query a network time server for the current time.
sntp.rationale: Read-only time query; does not modify the system clock by default.

sntpd.translation: Run the Simple Network Time Protocol background service.
sntpd.rationale: Adjusts the system clock based on network time sources; incorrect time can affect authentication and logging.

soapsuds.translation: Generate proxy classes for .NET remoting and web service endpoints.
soapsuds.rationale: Generates source code files; does not modify existing code.

softwareupdate.translation: Check for and install macOS system software updates.
softwareupdate.rationale: The bare command prints help; actual updates require specific subcommands.

softwareupdate --download.translation: Download specified software updates without installing them.
softwareupdate --download.rationale: Downloads update packages to disk; does not modify the running system.

softwareupdate --fetch-full-installer.translation: Download a full macOS installer application.
softwareupdate --fetch-full-installer.rationale: Downloads a large installer to disk; consumes significant space but does not install.

softwareupdate --install.translation: Download and install specified software updates.
softwareupdate --install.rationale: Modifies system software which may require a restart; incorrect updates can affect system stability.

softwareupdate --install-rosetta.translation: Install Rosetta 2 for running Intel applications on Apple silicon.
softwareupdate --install-rosetta.rationale: Installs a system component; reversible but modifies system state.

softwareupdate --list.translation: List all available software updates for the system.
softwareupdate --list.rationale: Read-only query of available updates; does not download or install anything.

softwareupdate --list-full-installers.translation: List available macOS full installer versions.

sort.translation: Sort lines of text from files or piped input.
sort.rationale: Outputs sorted text to the terminal without modifying the input file.

source.translation: Read and execute commands from a file in the current shell session.
source.rationale: Executes arbitrary commands from a file with full access to the current shell environment, including the ability to modify variables, functions, and aliases.

sourcekit-lsp.translation: Run the Language Server Protocol server for Swift and C-family languages.
sourcekit-lsp.rationale: Provides IDE features like completion and diagnostics; does not modify source files.

spctl.translation: Manage the system security assessment policy for code execution and installation.
spctl.rationale: The bare command prints help; assessment is read-only by default.

spctl --assess.translation: Assess whether the system policy allows execution or installation of specified files.
spctl --assess.rationale: Read-only evaluation of security policy against files.

spctl --global-disable.translation: Reveal the option to allow applications from anywhere in security settings.
spctl --global-disable.rationale: Weakens Gatekeeper enforcement by exposing the allow-anywhere option.

spctl --global-enable.translation: Enable the system security assessment subsystem.
spctl --global-enable.rationale: Enables Gatekeeper enforcement; may prevent previously allowed applications from running.

spctl --status.translation: Display whether the security assessment subsystem is enabled or disabled.
spctl --status.rationale: Read-only operation that displays whether the system security assessment policy is enabled or disabled.

spfd.translation: Run the SPF query background service for email sender policy framework lookups.
spfd.rationale: Performs DNS-based SPF lookups; does not modify email or DNS records.

spfquery.translation: Query SPF records to verify email sender authorization.
spfquery.rationale: Read-only DNS query for SPF policy evaluation; does not modify any records.

spindump.translation: Capture a stack trace sample from running processes for performance analysis.
spindump.rationale: Read-only sampling of process state; writes a report file but does not modify running processes.

spit.translation: Write raw data patterns directly to storage devices for benchmarking.
spit.rationale: Writes directly to block devices, overwriting all existing data; recovery is impossible without backups.

splain.translation: Display verbose explanations for Perl warning and error messages.
splain.rationale: Read-only diagnostic tool that explains Perl messages; modifies nothing.

split.translation: Split a file into smaller pieces.
split.rationale: Creates new files from an input file; the original is unchanged.

spray.translation: Send a burst of RPC packets to a host to test network throughput.
spray.rationale: Network diagnostic that sends test packets; does not modify any state on the remote host.

sqlite3.translation: Open and interact with a SQLite database.
sqlite3.rationale: Can create, modify, and delete data in SQLite database files; a new database is created if the file does not exist.

sqlmetal.translation: Generate .NET data context code from a database schema.
sqlmetal.rationale: Reads database schema and generates source code files; does not modify the database.

sqlsharp.translation: Run an interactive SQL query shell for .NET database providers.
sqlsharp.rationale: Executes arbitrary SQL against connected databases; queries can modify data.

sqlx.translation: Run the SQLx command-line utility for managing SQL databases in Rust projects.
sqlx.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

sqlx database.rationale: Subcommand group for creating and dropping databases.

sqlx database create.translation: Create the database specified in the connection string.
sqlx database create.rationale: Creates a new database; reversible by dropping it.

sqlx database drop.translation: Drop the database specified in the connection string.
sqlx database drop.rationale: Permanently destroys the entire database and all its data; irrecoverable without backups.

sqlx migrate.rationale: Subcommand group for creating and running schema migrations.

sqlx migrate add.rationale: Creates an empty migration file in the project; does not modify the database.

sqlx migrate revert.translation: Revert the last applied database migration.
sqlx migrate revert.rationale: Rolls back schema changes which may drop tables or columns; data in those structures may be lost.

sqlx migrate run.rationale: Applies schema changes to the database which may alter tables, columns, or data; reversal requires a separate down migration.

sqlx prepare.translation: Generate query metadata for offline compile-time verification.
sqlx prepare.rationale: Reads the database schema and generates metadata files; does not modify the database.

ssh.translation: Open a secure shell connection to a remote server.
ssh.rationale: Establishes a remote session where commands can be executed on another machine.

ssh-add.translation: Add private key identities to the SSH authentication agent.
ssh-add.rationale: Loads keys into the agent for passwordless authentication; keys can be removed later.

ssh-agent.translation: Run the SSH authentication agent to hold private keys in memory.
ssh-agent.rationale: Starts a background agent process; keys must be explicitly added before any authentication occurs.

ssh-copy-id.translation: Install a public key on a remote server for passwordless SSH authentication.
ssh-copy-id.rationale: Adds a public key to the remote authorized_keys file, granting future access without a password.

ssh-keygen.translation: Generate, manage, and convert SSH authentication keys.
ssh-keygen.rationale: Creates or modifies SSH keys that control access to remote systems.

ssh-keyscan.translation: Gather SSH public host keys from remote servers.
ssh-keyscan.rationale: Read-only network query that retrieves public keys; does not modify the local system.

sshd.translation: Run the SSH server background service to accept incoming secure shell connections.
sshd.rationale: Opens a network listener for remote access; normally managed by launchd.

sso_util.translation: Configure and manage Kerberos Single Sign On settings.
sso_util.rationale: Modifies Kerberos service configurations; incorrect changes can break authentication.

sso_util configure.translation: Configure Kerberos services on the local machine for a specified realm.
sso_util configure.rationale: Creates service principals and modifies Kerberos database; affects authentication infrastructure.

sso_util info.translation: Display information about the current Kerberos Single Sign On environment.

sso_util useconfig.translation: Apply a secure configuration record to set up Kerberos on a server.
sso_util useconfig.rationale: Configures the server using an encrypted config record; changes authentication infrastructure.

stapler.translation: Attach or validate notarization tickets on macOS applications and installers.
stapler.rationale: Modifies signed bundles and disk images by attaching notarization tickets; the code itself is unchanged.

stapler staple.translation: Retrieve and attach a notarization ticket to a signed file.
stapler staple.rationale: Modifies the file by embedding the notarization ticket; reversible by re-signing.

stapler validate.translation: Validate an existing stapled notarization ticket.
stapler validate.rationale: Read-only validation of the attached ticket.

stat.translation: Display detailed information about a file, such as its size, permissions, and timestamps.
stat.rationale: Read-only display of file metadata that does not modify anything.

streamlit.translation: Run the Streamlit framework for building data applications in Python.
streamlit.rationale: The bare command prints help text and modifies nothing.

streamlit cache.rationale: Manages temporary cache data; clearing the cache does not affect application logic.

streamlit config.rationale: Views or modifies local configuration; trivially reversible.

streamlit hello.translation: Run the built-in Streamlit demo application.
streamlit hello.rationale: Starts a demo web server with no side effects beyond network listening.

streamlit init.rationale: Creates project scaffold files; does not modify existing files.

streamlit run.translation: Run a Python script as a Streamlit web application.
streamlit run.rationale: Executes a Python script and starts a web server; the script may have side effects.

streamzip.translation: Create a zip archive from piped input.
streamzip.rationale: Reads input and writes a zip file; does not modify existing files.

stringdups.translation: Identify duplicate strings and objects in the memory heap of a running process.
stringdups.rationale: Read-only analysis of a process's memory; does not modify the target process.

strings.translation: Find and display readable text embedded in non-text files.
strings.rationale: Read-only extraction of text from files; modifies nothing.

strip.translation: Remove symbol table information from object files.
strip.rationale: Permanently removes debug symbols from binaries; the information cannot be recovered without rebuilding.

stty.translation: Display or set terminal device options.
stty.rationale: Changes terminal settings for the current session; settings reset on terminal close.

stz.translation: Run the Xsan storage pool configuration tool.
stz.rationale: Limited public documentation; appears to manage Xsan storage configuration.

su.translation: Switch to another user account in the current terminal session.
su.rationale: Changes the active user identity, so all following commands run with that user's full permissions.

sudo.translation: Execute a command as the superuser or another user.
sudo.rationale: Elevates privileges to run commands as root; the executed command has unrestricted system access.

sum.translation: Compute a checksum and block count for a file.

sutf.translation: Run the Simple UTF encoding and decoding tool.
sutf.rationale: Performs text encoding conversion; does not modify files unless explicitly redirected.

sutf-benchmark.translation: Run performance benchmarks for the Simple Unicode Text Format encoding library.
sutf-benchmark.rationale: Executes read-only benchmark tests; modifies nothing.

svcutil.translation: Generate .NET service client proxy code from web service description metadata.
svcutil.rationale: Generates source code files from service definitions; does not modify existing code.

sw_vers.rationale: Read-only display of OS version; modifies nothing.

swift.translation: Run the Swift programming language compiler and interpreter.
swift.rationale: Can compile and execute arbitrary Swift code with full system access.

swift build.translation: Compile a Swift package and its dependencies.
swift build.rationale: Compiles code locally; does not execute the built binary.

swift package.translation: Manage Swift package dependencies and configuration.
swift package.rationale: The bare subcommand prints help text.

swift package clean.translation: Remove the build artifacts directory for the Swift package.
swift package clean.rationale: Deletes only the build cache; source code is untouched.

swift package init.translation: Create a new Swift package in the current directory.
swift package init.rationale: Creates template files; does not overwrite existing files.

swift package reset.translation: Reset the complete cache and build directory for the Swift package.
swift package reset.rationale: Deletes all cached data including resolved dependencies; everything is re-fetched on next build.

swift package resolve.rationale: Downloads dependency source code but does not compile or execute anything.

swift package update.translation: Update package dependencies to their latest allowed versions.
swift package update.rationale: Changes resolved dependency versions, which may introduce breaking changes.

swift run.translation: Compile and execute a Swift package's executable target.
swift run.rationale: Builds and runs the program, which may perform any action depending on the code.

swift test.translation: Run the tests for a Swift package.
swift test.rationale: Compiles and runs test code locally.

swift-inspect.translation: Inspect Swift runtime metadata in a running process.
swift-inspect.rationale: Read-only inspection of process memory for Swift type information; does not modify the target.

swiftc.translation: Compile Swift source code into an executable or library.
swiftc.rationale: Compiles code locally; does not execute it or modify existing files beyond the output.

symbols.translation: Display symbol information for a binary or running process.
symbols.rationale: Read-only analysis of binary symbols; modifies nothing.

symbolscache.translation: Manage the local cache of debug symbols.
symbolscache.rationale: Manages cached symbol files for debugging; clearing the cache only requires re-downloading symbols.

sync.translation: Flush pending disk writes to ensure data is written to storage.
sync.rationale: Forces cached data to disk; a safety operation that prevents data loss.

sysadminctl.translation: Manage local user accounts, secure tokens, and system administration settings.
sysadminctl.rationale: Creates, deletes, and modifies user accounts with full administrative control.

syscallbypid.d.translation: Trace system calls grouped by process ID using DTrace.
syscallbypid.d.rationale: Read-only tracing of system call activity; modifies nothing.

syscallbyproc.d.translation: Trace system calls grouped by process name using DTrace.
syscallbyproc.d.rationale: Read-only tracing of system call activity; modifies nothing.

syscallbysysc.d.translation: Trace system calls grouped by system call type using DTrace.
syscallbysysc.d.rationale: Read-only tracing of system call activity; modifies nothing.

sysctl.translation: Get or set kernel state parameters.
sysctl.rationale: Can modify kernel tuning parameters that affect system behavior; read-only by default but writable with name=value syntax.

sysdiagnose.translation: Collect comprehensive system diagnostic information into an archive.
sysdiagnose.rationale: Gathers logs, profiles, and system state into a tar archive; does not modify system configuration.

syslog.translation: Query and manage the system log.
syslog.rationale: Primarily reads log entries; can send log messages but does not modify existing logs.

syslogd.translation: Run the system log background service to collect and store log messages.
syslogd.rationale: System background service that collects log messages; normally managed by launchd.

syspolicy_check.translation: Check system policy compliance for applications and bundles.
syspolicy_check.rationale: Read-only policy evaluation; does not modify files or system state.

system-override.translation: Manage system configuration overrides for testing and development.
system-override.rationale: Modifies system behavior overrides; incorrect use can affect system stability.

system_profiler.translation: Report detailed hardware and software configuration of the system.
system_profiler.rationale: Read-only system information gathering; modifies nothing.

systemextensionsctl.rationale: Can list, reset, or uninstall system extensions which provide kernel-level functionality.

systemkeychain.translation: Manage the system keychain used for system-wide credentials.
systemkeychain.rationale: Modifies the system keychain which stores credentials used by system services; incorrect changes can break services.

systemsetup.translation: Configure machine-level settings such as date, time, sleep, and remote access.
systemsetup.rationale: Modifies system preferences that affect sleep, time, startup, and remote access; all settings are reversible.

systemsoundserverd.translation: Run the system sound server background service.
systemsoundserverd.rationale: Audio playback background service; normally managed by launchd and does not modify files.

systemstats.translation: Collect and report system performance statistics.
systemstats.rationale: Read-only performance data collection; modifies nothing.

tab2space.translation: Convert between tabs and spaces in text files.
tab2space.rationale: Text formatting conversion; output goes to the terminal by default.

tabs.translation: Set tab stops on a terminal.
tabs.rationale: Changes terminal tab stop positions for the current session; resets on terminal close.

tail.translation: Display the last lines of a file.
tail.rationale: Read-only display of file contents that modifies nothing.

tailspin.translation: Capture and display kernel trace data for performance analysis.
tailspin.rationale: Read-only system tracing that writes to a file; does not modify system state.

talk.translation: Open an interactive chat session with another user on the system.
talk.rationale: Text-based communication between users; does not modify files or system state.
