dropdb --force.rationale: Terminates all existing connections to the target database before dropping it, disrupting active users.

dropdb --if-exists.translation_modifier: without raising an error if the database does not exist
dropdb --if-exists.rationale: Prevents errors on nonexistent databases; does not change destructive behavior.

dropdb -U.rationale: Specifies the authentication identity; the user's permissions determine what is allowed.

dropdb -e.translation_modifier: displaying the SQL commands being sent to the server
dropdb -e.rationale: Shows the generated SQL; read-only diagnostic output.

dropdb -h.translation_modifier: on a specified database server host
dropdb -h.rationale: Specifies which server to connect to; does not change the operation.

dropdb -i.rationale: Adds an interactive confirmation step; a safety-enhancing option.

dropdb -p.rationale: Specifies which port to connect on; does not change the operation.

dropdb -w.rationale: Relies on passwordless authentication methods, which may indicate a less secure connection configuration.

dropdb-17 --force.translation_modifier: without asking for confirmation before dropping the database
dropdb-17 --force.rationale: Bypasses the confirmation prompt for a destructive database operation.

dropuser --if-exists.translation_modifier: without raising an error if the role does not exist
dropuser --if-exists.rationale: Prevents errors on nonexistent roles; does not change destructive behavior.

dropuser -i.rationale: Adds an interactive confirmation step; a safety-enhancing option.

dsimport --force.rationale: Forces import overwriting existing directory service records.

dtrace -Z.translation_modifier: allowing probe descriptions that match zero probes
dtrace -Z.rationale: Suppresses an error when no probes match; does not change tracing behavior.

dtrace -c.translation_modifier: running a command and tracing it until it exits
dtrace -c.rationale: Executes the specified command and traces it; the risk depends on what the command does.

dtrace -e.translation_modifier: compiling the script and exiting without actually tracing
dtrace -e.rationale: Validates the script without enabling any probes; a dry-run mode.

dtrace -l.translation_modifier: listing available probes instead of tracing
dtrace -l.rationale: Read-only listing of probes; no tracing or modification occurs.

dtrace -n.translation_modifier: tracing events that match a specific probe name
dtrace -n.rationale: Specifies which events to observe; read-only tracing.

dtrace -o.translation_modifier: writing trace output to a file instead of the screen
dtrace -o.rationale: Only redirects output; does not change what is traced.

dtrace -p.translation_modifier: attaching to a specific running process by its process ID
dtrace -p.rationale: Observes a single process; does not modify it by default.

dtrace -q.rationale: Only changes output formatting; does not affect tracing behavior.

dtrace -s.translation_modifier: running a tracing script from a file
dtrace -s.rationale: Executes a D script, which may include complex tracing logic or destructive actions if -w is also set.

dtrace -w.translation_modifier: allowing destructive actions such as stopping processes or modifying memory
dtrace -w.rationale: Enables actions that can kill processes or modify system state; not permitted when System Integrity Protection is enabled.

dtruss -a.translation_modifier: printing all available details including timestamps and CPU times
dtruss -a.rationale: Only adds more information to the output.

dtruss -b.translation_modifier: using a specified buffer size for trace data
dtruss -b.rationale: Only adjusts internal memory allocation for tracing.

dtruss -c.translation_modifier: printing a summary of system call counts instead of individual calls
dtruss -c.rationale: Only changes the output format to a summary view.

dtruss -d.translation_modifier: printing relative timestamps for each system call
dtruss -d.rationale: Only adds timing information to the output.

dtruss -e.translation_modifier: printing elapsed time for each system call
dtruss -e.rationale: Only adds timing information to the output.

dtruss -f.translation_modifier: following child processes as they are created
dtruss -f.rationale: Expands tracing to child processes; still read-only.

dtruss -n.translation_modifier: tracing all processes matching a specified name
dtruss -n.rationale: Selects processes by name; still read-only tracing.

dtruss -o.translation_modifier: printing CPU time consumed by each system call
dtruss -o.rationale: Only adds timing information to the output.

dtruss -p.translation_modifier: attaching to an already-running process by its process ID
dtruss -p.rationale: Traces an existing process; read-only observation.

dtruss -s.translation_modifier: printing stack backtraces for each system call
dtruss -s.rationale: Only adds diagnostic information to the output.

dtruss -t.translation_modifier: filtering output to only a specified system call
dtruss -t.rationale: Narrows the trace to a single system call type.

du -A.translation_modifier: showing the apparent file size instead of the actual disk space used
du -A.rationale: Reports logical size rather than physical allocation; still read-only.

du -H.translation_modifier: following symbolic links on the command line but not in subdirectories
du -H.rationale: Only follows symbolic links explicitly named as arguments; still read-only.

du -I.translation_modifier: skipping files and directories that match a specified pattern
du -I.rationale: Excludes matching paths from the report; still read-only.

du -L.translation_modifier: following symbolic links and counting the size of the files they point to
du -L.rationale: Follows symbolic links to measure target file sizes; still read-only.

du -P.rationale: Default behavior; counts the link itself rather than its target; still read-only.

du -a.translation_modifier: showing an entry for every individual file, not just directories
du -a.rationale: Increases output detail to include all files; still read-only.

du -c.translation_modifier: showing a grand total at the end
du -c.rationale: Adds a summary total line to the output; still read-only.

du -d.translation_modifier: limiting the depth of directory traversal
du -d.rationale: Restricts how deep the report goes; still read-only.

du -g.rationale: Shows sizes in gigabyte blocks; still read-only.

du -h.rationale: Displays sizes in human-readable units like megabytes and gigabytes; still read-only.

du -k.rationale: Shows sizes in kilobyte blocks; still read-only.

du -l.translation_modifier: counting files with multiple hard links each time they appear
du -l.rationale: Counts hard-linked files multiple times instead of once; may overstate total usage but is still read-only.

du -m.rationale: Shows sizes in megabyte blocks; still read-only.

du -s.translation_modifier: showing only a total for each argument
du -s.rationale: Summarizes output instead of listing every subdirectory; still read-only.

du -t.translation_modifier: showing only entries larger than a specified size threshold
du -t.rationale: Filters output to entries above a given size; still read-only.

du -x.translation_modifier: staying within a single filesystem and not crossing mount points
du -x.rationale: Prevents traversal into other mounted filesystems; still read-only.

dwarfdump --all.rationale: Read-only display of all debug information.

echo -e.translation_modifier: interpreting backslash escape sequences in the text
echo -e.rationale: Enables escape characters like \n and \t; still a display-only operation.

echo -n.rationale: Only changes output formatting; no additional risk.

ecpg -c.translation_modifier: automatically generating C code from embedded SQL
ecpg -c.rationale: Controls code generation mode; does not affect any database.

ecpg -o.translation_modifier: writing the output to a specific file
ecpg -o.rationale: Only changes the output destination; overwrites are limited to the named file.

ecpg -t.rationale: Only affects generated code behavior; the preprocessor itself modifies nothing at runtime.

ed -p.rationale: Only changes the display prompt; no additional risk.

ed -s.rationale: Only suppresses output; does not change editing behavior.

egrep -c.translation_modifier: showing only a count of matching lines
egrep -c.rationale: Only changes output format; read-only operation.

egrep -i.rationale: Only changes pattern matching behavior; read-only operation.

egrep -l.translation_modifier: showing only the names of files with matches
egrep -l.rationale: Only changes output format; read-only operation.

egrep -n.translation_modifier: including line numbers in the output
egrep -n.rationale: Only changes output format; read-only operation.

egrep -r.rationale: Expands the search scope but remains a read-only operation.

egrep -v.rationale: Inverts the match criteria; still a read-only operation.

env -0.translation_modifier: separating output entries with null characters instead of newlines
env -0.rationale: Only changes output formatting; modifies nothing.

env -C.translation_modifier: changing to a specified directory before running the command
env -C.rationale: Changes the working directory for the child process only; does not modify files.

env -P.translation_modifier: searching for the command in an alternate set of directories instead of the standard search path
env -P.rationale: Changes where the command is found but does not alter the environment or files.

env -S.translation_modifier: splitting a single string into multiple arguments
env -S.rationale: Only affects how arguments are parsed; commonly used in script interpreter lines.

env -i.translation_modifier: starting with a completely empty environment
env -i.rationale: Clears all environment variables before running the command; increases isolation.

env -u.translation_modifier: removing a specified variable from the environment
env -u.rationale: Unsets a single variable; does not persist beyond the command invocation.

env -v.translation_modifier: printing verbose details about each processing step
env -v.rationale: Only adds diagnostic output; modifies nothing.

envsubst -v.translation_modifier: listing the variable names found instead of substituting them
envsubst -v.rationale: Only lists variable names; does not perform substitution.

erb -T.translation_modifier: using a specific whitespace trim mode
erb -T.rationale: Only changes how whitespace is handled in template output.

erb -r.translation_modifier: loading an additional Ruby library before processing
erb -r.rationale: Loads and executes arbitrary Ruby code from a library.

erb -x.translation_modifier: printing the generated Ruby script instead of executing it
erb -x.rationale: Only outputs the script source; does not execute the template.

errinfo -c.translation_modifier: showing an aggregate frequency count of errors
errinfo -c.rationale: Only changes the output format to a summary report.

errinfo -n.translation_modifier: monitoring only processes with a specific name
errinfo -n.rationale: Narrows the scope to named processes; still read-only.

errinfo -p.translation_modifier: monitoring only a specific process ID
errinfo -p.rationale: Narrows the scope to a single process; still read-only.

eslint --cache.translation_modifier: caching results to speed up subsequent runs
eslint --cache.rationale: Writes a cache file to disk for performance; does not change analysis results.

eslint --debug.rationale: Increases output verbosity for troubleshooting; does not change analysis behavior.

eslint --ext.translation_modifier: limiting analysis to files with specified extensions
eslint --ext.rationale: Narrows which files are checked; does not change the analysis behavior.

eslint --fix.translation_modifier: automatically fixing problems that have safe corrections
eslint --fix.rationale: Modifies source files in place to apply auto-fixable lint rules.

eslint --format.translation_modifier: using a specified output formatter for the results
eslint --format.rationale: Changes output formatting; does not affect which rules are checked.

eslint --ignore-path.translation_modifier: using a specified file to determine which paths to ignore
eslint --ignore-path.rationale: Changes which files are skipped; does not modify any source files.

eslint --max-warnings.translation_modifier: failing if the number of warnings exceeds a specified limit
eslint --max-warnings.rationale: Adds a threshold for CI enforcement; does not modify files.

eslint --no-eslintrc.rationale: Disables configuration loading; analysis runs with default rules only.

eslint --quiet.translation_modifier: reporting only errors and suppressing warnings
eslint --quiet.rationale: Reduces output verbosity; does not change which files are analyzed.

eslogger --list-events.translation_modifier: listing all supported event types instead of streaming
eslogger --list-events.rationale: Only prints available event names and exits.

eslogger --oslog.translation_modifier: writing events to the unified logging system instead of standard output
eslogger --oslog.rationale: Changes the output destination to the system log; still a read-only operation.

ex -R.rationale: Prevents accidental file overwrites by setting read-only mode.

ex -c.translation_modifier: executing a command after loading the first file
ex -c.rationale: Runs an arbitrary Ex command which may modify files or invoke shell commands.

execsnoop -c.translation_modifier: monitoring only a specific command name
execsnoop -c.rationale: Narrows the scope to a single command; still read-only.

execsnoop -v.rationale: Only adds timestamp information to the output.

expand -t.rationale: Only changes tab stop spacing; no additional risk.

expect -D.rationale: Starts the debugger for stepping through commands; a diagnostic mode.

expect -N.translation_modifier: skipping the system-wide startup configuration file
expect -N.rationale: Prevents loading of default configuration; reduces side effects.

expect -b.translation_modifier: reading the script one line at a time instead of all at once
expect -b.rationale: Only changes how the script file is read; does not affect what commands are executed.

expect -c.translation_modifier: executing a command string before the script
expect -c.rationale: Runs arbitrary Expect commands that may interact with spawned processes.

expect -d.rationale: Only adds debugging information to error output; does not change behavior.

expect -f.translation_modifier: reading commands from a specific file
expect -f.rationale: Executes an Expect script from a file, which may spawn and control other programs.

expect -i.rationale: Allows the user to type arbitrary Expect commands in real time.

expect -n.translation_modifier: skipping the user startup configuration file
expect -n.rationale: Prevents loading of the user configuration; reduces side effects.

expect -v.translation_modifier: showing the version number and exiting
expect -v.rationale: Only prints version information; does not execute any script.

export -f.translation_modifier: marking a shell function instead of a variable
export -f.rationale: Exports a function definition to child processes; no files are modified.

export -n.translation_modifier: removing the export property so the variable is no longer passed to child processes
export -n.rationale: Unmarks a variable for export; the variable still exists in the shell but is no longer inherited.

fdesetup enable --authrestart.translation_modifier: performing an authenticated restart after enabling
fdesetup enable --authrestart.rationale: Restarts the system and temporarily stores the unlock key, reducing security during the restart.

fdesetup enable --defer.translation_modifier: deferring encryption until the user logs in
fdesetup enable --defer.rationale: Delays enablement to a more convenient time; does not immediately change disk state.

fdesetup enable --forcerestart.translation_modifier: forcing a restart after enabling encryption
fdesetup enable --forcerestart.rationale: Automatically restarts the system, which may interrupt running work.

fdesetup enable --norecoverykey.translation_modifier: without creating a personal recovery key
fdesetup enable --norecoverykey.rationale: Skipping the recovery key means the only way to unlock is the user password, risking permanent data loss.

fdesetup status --extended.translation_modifier: showing estimated completion time during encryption or decryption
fdesetup status --extended.rationale: Only adds additional status detail; read-only operation.

fdisk -e.rationale: Allows modification of partition entries; changes are not written until explicitly confirmed.

fdisk -i.translation_modifier: initializing and overwriting the entire MBR sector
fdisk -i.rationale: Completely overwrites the MBR and partition table, destroying all existing partition information.

fdisk -u.translation_modifier: updating the MBR boot code while preserving the partition table
fdisk -u.rationale: Overwrites MBR boot code and the Windows disk signature, which can affect system bootability.

fdisk -y.translation_modifier: without asking for confirmation before writing
fdisk -y.rationale: Skips confirmation prompts, increasing the chance of unintended partition table changes.

fgrep -c.translation_modifier: showing only a count of matching lines
fgrep -c.rationale: Only changes output format; read-only operation.

fgrep -i.rationale: Only changes pattern matching behavior; read-only operation.

fgrep -l.translation_modifier: showing only the names of files with matches
fgrep -l.rationale: Only changes output format; read-only operation.

fgrep -r.rationale: Expands the search scope but remains a read-only operation.

fgrep -v.rationale: Inverts the match criteria; still a read-only operation.

file -I.translation_modifier: showing the content type and character encoding instead of a human-readable description
file -I.rationale: Changes the output format; still read-only.

file -L.translation_modifier: following shortcuts to examine the target file instead of the shortcut itself
file -L.rationale: Resolves the link before inspection; still read-only.

file -b.translation_modifier: showing only the file type without the file name

file -f.translation_modifier: reading the list of files to examine from a specified file
file -f.rationale: Reads file names from a list; still performs read-only inspection.

file -h.translation_modifier: examining the shortcut itself instead of following it to the target file
file -h.rationale: Inspects the link rather than its target; still read-only.

file -i.translation_modifier: showing the content type and character encoding instead of a human-readable description
file -i.rationale: Changes the output format; still read-only.

file -k.translation_modifier: showing all matching file types instead of stopping at the first match
file -k.rationale: Provides more detailed output; still read-only.

file -s.translation_modifier: examining special device files in addition to regular files
file -s.rationale: Reads from device files, which is unusual but still a read-only operation.

file -z.translation_modifier: looking inside compressed files to identify their contents
file -z.rationale: Decompresses for inspection only; does not modify any files.

find -L.rationale: Follows symbolic links, which may expand the search scope but remains read-only by default.

find -and.translation_modifier: requiring both the previous and the next condition to be true
find -and.rationale: Combines filter expressions with logical AND; does not modify files.

find -atime.translation_modifier: matching files by last access time
find -atime.rationale: Filters by access date; does not modify files.

find -ctime.translation_modifier: matching files by last status change time
find -ctime.rationale: Filters by inode change date; does not modify files.

find -delete.rationale: Permanently removes all files matching the search criteria without confirmation or recoverability.

find -depth.translation_modifier: processing directory contents before the directory itself
find -depth.rationale: Changes traversal order; does not modify files on its own.

find -empty.translation_modifier: matching only empty files or directories
find -empty.rationale: Filters to empty items; does not modify files.

find -exec.translation_modifier: running a specified command on each matching file
find -exec.rationale: Executes an arbitrary command for each result; the risk depends entirely on the command being run.

find -execdir.translation_modifier: running a specified command from each matching file's directory
find -execdir.rationale: Executes a command from the file's directory; slightly safer than -exec but risk still depends on the command.

find -group.translation_modifier: matching files belonging to a specific group
find -group.rationale: Filters by file group; does not modify files.

find -iname.translation_modifier: matching files by name pattern, ignoring case
find -iname.rationale: Case-insensitive filename filter; does not modify files.

find -iregex.translation_modifier: matching files whose full path matches a regular expression, ignoring case
find -iregex.rationale: Case-insensitive regex filter on the full path; does not modify files.

find -maxdepth.translation_modifier: limiting the search to a specified number of directory levels
find -maxdepth.rationale: Restricts the search depth; a scope-limiting option.

find -mindepth.translation_modifier: skipping results above a specified directory depth
find -mindepth.rationale: Excludes shallow results from the output; does not modify files.

find -mmin.translation_modifier: matching files modified within a specified number of minutes
find -mmin.rationale: Filters by recent modification time; does not modify files.

find -mtime.translation_modifier: matching files by last modification time
find -mtime.rationale: Filters by modification date; does not modify files.

find -name.rationale: Filters search results by filename; does not modify files.

find -newer.translation_modifier: matching files modified more recently than a reference file
find -newer.rationale: Compares modification times; does not modify files.

find -not.rationale: Negates a filter expression; does not modify files.

find -ok.translation_modifier: prompting for confirmation before running a command on each matching file
find -ok.rationale: Like -exec but asks before each execution, preventing accidental operations.

find -or.translation_modifier: matching if either the previous or the next condition is true
find -or.rationale: Combines filter expressions with logical OR; does not modify files.

find -path.translation_modifier: matching files by their full path pattern
find -path.rationale: Filters by full pathname; does not modify files.

find -perm.rationale: Filters by file permissions; does not modify files.

find -print.translation_modifier: printing each matching path on its own line
find -print.rationale: Default action; outputs matching paths without modifying files.

find -print0.translation_modifier: separating results with null characters instead of newlines
find -print0.rationale: Changes output formatting for safe piping to xargs; does not modify files.

find -prune.translation_modifier: skipping the contents of matched directories
find -prune.rationale: Prevents descent into matching directories; a scope-limiting option.

find -regex.translation_modifier: matching files whose full path matches a regular expression
find -regex.rationale: Filters by regex on the entire path; does not modify files.

find -size.rationale: Filters by file size; does not modify files.

find -type.translation_modifier: matching only the specified file type
find -type.rationale: Filters by type (file, directory, symbolic link, etc.); does not modify files.

find -user.translation_modifier: matching files owned by a specific user
find -user.rationale: Filters by file owner; does not modify files.

find -x.rationale: Restricts search to the current filesystem; a scope-limiting option.

finger -g.translation_modifier: showing only the real name from the user information field
finger -g.rationale: Only restricts which user details are displayed; read-only operation.

finger -h.translation_modifier: showing the remote host instead of office information in short format
finger -h.rationale: Only changes which field is displayed; read-only operation.

finger -k.translation_modifier: without checking the user accounting database
finger -k.rationale: Only skips the accounting database lookup; read-only operation.

finger -l.translation_modifier: showing detailed multi-line output including home directory and login shell
finger -l.rationale: Only changes the amount of detail displayed; read-only operation.

finger -m.translation_modifier: matching only login names instead of also matching real names
finger -m.rationale: Only changes the matching behavior; read-only operation.

finger -o.translation_modifier: showing office location and phone instead of the remote host in short format
finger -o.rationale: Only changes which field is displayed; read-only operation.

finger -p.translation_modifier: hiding the contents of plan, project, and public key files
finger -p.rationale: Only suppresses display of extra user files; read-only operation.

finger -s.rationale: Only changes the output format; read-only operation.

flask --app.translation_modifier: loading a specific Flask application module
flask --app.rationale: Only specifies which application to load; does not change behavior.

flask run --debug.translation_modifier: enabling debug mode with auto-reloading and detailed error pages
flask run --debug.rationale: Debug mode exposes a live debugger in the browser that can execute arbitrary Python code.

flex -B.translation_modifier: optimizing the generated scanner for batch processing instead of interactive use
flex -B.rationale: Changes scanner behavior at runtime; no safety impact.

flex -I.translation_modifier: generating an interactive scanner that reads input one character at a time
flex -I.rationale: Changes scanner behavior at runtime; no safety impact.

flex -L.translation_modifier: omitting line-tracking directives from the generated code
flex -L.rationale: Removes line references that help debuggers map errors back to the specification file.

flex -P.translation_modifier: using a custom prefix for generated symbol names instead of the default
flex -P.rationale: Only affects naming in generated code; useful when combining multiple scanners.

flex -d.translation_modifier: enabling debug mode in the generated scanner
flex -d.rationale: Only adds debugging output to the generated code.

flex -f.translation_modifier: generating a faster scanner using larger lookup tables
flex -f.rationale: Trades memory for speed in the generated code; no safety impact.

flex -i.rationale: Only changes how patterns are matched in the generated code.

flex -l.translation_modifier: generating a scanner compatible with the original lex tool
flex -l.rationale: Enables compatibility mode; only affects generated code behavior.

flex -o.translation_modifier: writing output to a specific file
flex -o.rationale: Only changes the output destination; overwrites are limited to the named file.

flex -s.translation_modifier: generating an error for input that does not match any rule instead of echoing it
flex -s.rationale: Makes unmatched input an error rather than passing it through; only affects generated code.

flex -t.translation_modifier: writing the generated scanner to the terminal instead of a file
flex -t.rationale: Sends output to standard out; does not create or overwrite any file.

flex -v.translation_modifier: showing statistics about the generated scanner
flex -v.rationale: Displays read-only summary information; does not change the output.

fmt -c.rationale: Only changes the alignment of output text.

fmt -m.rationale: Only changes how mail headers are handled in the output.

fmt -n.translation_modifier: formatting lines that begin with a dot character
fmt -n.rationale: Only changes which lines are reformatted; no destructive action.

fmt -p.rationale: Only changes paragraph detection logic; no destructive action.

fmt -s.translation_modifier: collapsing multiple spaces into single spaces
fmt -s.rationale: Only changes whitespace in the output.

fmt -w.translation_modifier: using a specific maximum line width
fmt -w.rationale: Only changes the target line width for formatting.

fold -b.translation_modifier: counting width in bytes rather than column positions
fold -b.rationale: Only changes how width is measured; no destructive action.

fold -s.translation_modifier: breaking lines at the last blank character within the width
fold -s.rationale: Improves readability by breaking at word boundaries instead of mid-word.

fold -w.translation_modifier: using a specific line width instead of the default 80 columns
fold -w.rationale: Only changes the target width for line wrapping.

footprint --all.translation_modifier: including all processes in the output
footprint --all.rationale: Read-only display of memory footprint for all processes.

footprint --sample.translation_modifier: continuously sampling memory at a specified interval
footprint --sample.rationale: Repeatedly gathers memory data; still a read-only operation.

footprint -a.translation_modifier: targeting all processes on the system
footprint -a.rationale: Expands the scope to all processes; still a read-only operation.

footprint -v.rationale: Only adds more detail to the output.

fping --all.translation_modifier: pinging all addresses in the specified network range
fping --all.rationale: Sends ICMP packets to all addresses in a range; read-only network probing.

fping -a.translation_modifier: showing only hosts that are reachable
fping -a.rationale: Only filters the output; read-only operation.

fping -c.translation_modifier: sending a specific number of pings to each target
fping -c.rationale: Only changes how many pings are sent; read-only network diagnostic.

fping -g.translation_modifier: generating a target list from a CIDR range or IP range
fping -g.rationale: Expands the target list; still sends only ICMP echo requests.

fping -l.translation_modifier: continuously pinging targets in a loop
fping -l.rationale: Sends pings indefinitely; still a read-only diagnostic.

fping -q.translation_modifier: suppressing per-ping output and showing only summary
fping -q.rationale: Only changes the output format; read-only operation.

fping -u.translation_modifier: showing only hosts that are unreachable
fping -u.rationale: Only filters the output; read-only operation.

fs_usage -F.translation_modifier: trimming long pathnames from the right side instead of the left
fs_usage -F.rationale: Only changes how pathnames are displayed.

fs_usage -R.translation_modifier: reading from a saved trace file instead of monitoring the live system
fs_usage -R.rationale: Processes an existing file; no live system interaction.

fs_usage -b.translation_modifier: annotating disk operations with boot cache information
fs_usage -b.rationale: Only adds diagnostic annotations to the output.

fs_usage -e.translation_modifier: excluding specified processes from the output
fs_usage -e.rationale: Only filters which processes are displayed.

fs_usage -f.translation_modifier: filtering output to a specific category of events
fs_usage -f.rationale: Only changes which event types are displayed.

fs_usage -t.translation_modifier: stopping automatically after a specified number of seconds
fs_usage -t.rationale: Only limits how long the tool runs.

fs_usage -w.translation_modifier: forcing wide output with full detail

fsck -f.translation_modifier: checking even if the filesystem is marked clean
fsck -f.rationale: Forces a check on a clean filesystem, which may make repairs that would otherwise be skipped.

fsck -n.rationale: Read-only mode that reports problems but does not modify the filesystem.

fsck -p.translation_modifier: automatically repairing safe inconsistencies without prompting
fsck -p.rationale: Makes corrections automatically; limits repairs to those considered safe, but still modifies filesystem metadata.

fsck -y.translation_modifier: answering yes to all repair prompts
fsck -y.rationale: Approves all repairs without review, including potentially destructive corrections.

fuser -c.translation_modifier: treating the file as a mount point and reporting all open files on that filesystem
fuser -c.rationale: Expands the scope to an entire filesystem; still a read-only operation.

fuser -u.translation_modifier: including the username of each process
fuser -u.rationale: Only adds user information to the output.

g++ -E.translation_modifier: only running the preprocessor without compiling
g++ -E.rationale: Outputs preprocessed source code; no object file or executable is created.

g++ -I.translation_modifier: adding a directory to the header file search path
g++ -I.rationale: Only changes where the compiler looks for header files.

g++ -L.translation_modifier: adding a directory to the library search path
g++ -L.rationale: Only changes where the linker looks for libraries.

g++ -O2.rationale: Only changes how the code is optimized during compilation.

g++ -O3.rationale: Maximizes optimization; may change timing behavior but does not affect safety.

g++ -Wall.rationale: Only changes which warnings are displayed during compilation.

g++ -Werror.translation_modifier: treating all warnings as errors that stop compilation
g++ -Werror.rationale: Makes compilation stricter but does not change the output when it succeeds.

g++ -Wextra.translation_modifier: enabling additional compiler warnings beyond the common set
g++ -Wextra.rationale: Only adds more diagnostic messages; does not change the compiled output.

g++ -c.translation_modifier: compiling to object files without linking
g++ -c.rationale: Produces object files only; no executable is created.

g++ -g.translation_modifier: including debugging information in the output
g++ -g.rationale: Adds debug symbols; does not change program behavior.

g++ -l.rationale: Adds a library dependency; does not execute anything.

g++ -o.translation_modifier: writing the output to a specific file

g++ -shared.translation_modifier: producing a shared library instead of an executable
g++ -shared.rationale: Only changes the output file type.

g++ -std.translation_modifier: compiling for a specific C++ language standard
g++ -std.rationale: Selects which language features are allowed; does not affect safety.

gcc -E.translation_modifier: only running the preprocessor without compiling
gcc -E.rationale: Outputs preprocessed source code; no object file or executable is created.

gcc -I.translation_modifier: adding a directory to the header file search path
gcc -I.rationale: Only changes where the compiler looks for header files.

gcc -L.translation_modifier: adding a directory to the library search path
gcc -L.rationale: Only changes where the linker looks for libraries.

gcc -O2.rationale: Only changes how the code is optimized during compilation.

gcc -O3.rationale: Maximizes optimization; may change timing behavior but does not affect safety.

gcc -S.translation_modifier: compiling to assembly language without assembling or linking
gcc -S.rationale: Produces assembly output only; no binary is created.

gcc -Wall.rationale: Only changes which warnings are displayed during compilation.

gcc -Werror.translation_modifier: treating all warnings as errors that stop compilation
gcc -Werror.rationale: Makes compilation stricter but does not change the output when it succeeds.

gcc -Wextra.translation_modifier: enabling additional compiler warnings beyond the common set
gcc -Wextra.rationale: Only adds more diagnostic messages; does not change the compiled output.

gcc -c.translation_modifier: compiling to object files without linking
gcc -c.rationale: Produces object files only; no executable is created.

gcc -g.translation_modifier: including debugging information in the output
gcc -g.rationale: Adds debug symbols; does not change program behavior.

gcc -l.rationale: Adds a library dependency; does not execute anything.

gcc -o.translation_modifier: writing the output to a specific file

gcc -shared.translation_modifier: producing a shared library instead of an executable
gcc -shared.rationale: Only changes the output file type.

gcc -std.translation_modifier: compiling for a specific C language standard
gcc -std.rationale: Selects which language features are allowed; does not affect safety.

gcloud --format.rationale: Changes output format (JSON, YAML, table, etc.); read-only display change.

gcloud --impersonate-service-account.translation_modifier: acting as a specified service account
gcloud --impersonate-service-account.rationale: Runs commands with the permissions of another identity, which may have broader access.

gcloud --project.translation_modifier: targeting a specific Google Cloud project
gcloud --project.rationale: Overrides the default project; does not change what operations are available.

gcloud --quiet.translation_modifier: without interactive prompts, using defaults for all choices
gcloud --quiet.rationale: Disables confirmation prompts, allowing destructive operations to proceed without user verification.

gcloud app deploy --no-promote.translation_modifier: without routing traffic to the new version
gcloud app deploy --no-promote.rationale: Deploys the version without directing traffic to it, allowing safe testing.

gcloud app deploy --promote.translation_modifier: routing all traffic to the new version immediately
gcloud app deploy --promote.rationale: Sends live traffic to the new version, which may affect users if the deployment is faulty.

gcloud compute instances delete --delete.translation_modifier: also deleting the specified type of attached disks
gcloud compute instances delete --delete.rationale: Permanently destroys attached persistent disks, which may contain irreplaceable data.

gcloud compute instances delete --keep-d.translation_modifier: preserving the specified type of attached disks
gcloud compute instances delete --keep-d.rationale: Prevents disk deletion, reducing the blast radius of the instance deletion.

gcloud compute scp --compress.rationale: Compression is a transport optimization; it does not change what is transferred.

gcloud compute scp --recurse.translation_modifier: copying directories and their contents recursively
gcloud compute scp --recurse.rationale: Recursive copy can transfer many files at once, increasing the volume of data written to or read from the remote instance.

gcloud compute scp --zone.translation_modifier: targeting an instance in a specific zone
gcloud compute scp --zone.rationale: Zone selection is routing only; it does not change what the operation does.

gcloud compute ssh --command.translation_modifier: running a specific command on the remote instance and returning
gcloud compute ssh --command.rationale: Executes the supplied command non-interactively on the remote host; the command itself determines impact.

gcloud compute ssh --zone.translation_modifier: targeting an instance in a specific zone
gcloud compute ssh --zone.rationale: Zone selection is routing only; it does not change what the operation does.

gcloud run deploy --allow-unauthenticate.translation_modifier: allowing anyone on the internet to invoke the service
gcloud run deploy --allow-unauthenticate.rationale: Makes the service publicly accessible without authentication.

gcloud run deploy --no-traffic.translation_modifier: without routing any traffic to the new revision
gcloud run deploy --no-traffic.rationale: Deploys a new revision that does not receive traffic until explicitly routed.

gcloud storage cp --recursive.rationale: Copies entire directory trees, increasing the scope of the transfer.

gcloud storage rm --all-versions.translation_modifier: including all object versions, not just live versions
gcloud storage rm --all-versions.rationale: Deletes versioned objects as well, removing the ability to recover previous versions.

gcloud storage rm --recursive.translation_modifier: deleting all objects under the specified path and any empty buckets
gcloud storage rm --recursive.rationale: Removes all objects recursively, which can wipe an entire bucket's contents.

gcore -o.translation_modifier: writing the core file to a specific path

gcore -s.translation_modifier: suspending the process while capturing the core dump
gcore -s.rationale: Pauses the target process during capture, which may disrupt its operation.

gcore -x.translation_modifier: selecting which types of memory pages to include
gcore -x.rationale: Controls the scope of the core dump content; the compact option produces smaller files.

gem cleanup --dryrun.translation_modifier: simulating the cleanup without actually removing anything
gem cleanup --dryrun.rationale: No gems are deleted; only shows what would be removed.

gem install --force.rationale: Skips dependency validation, which may leave the gem in a broken state.

gem install --ignore-dependencies.translation_modifier: without installing any required dependency gems
gem install --ignore-dependencies.rationale: The installed gem may not work correctly without its dependencies.

gem install --no-document.rationale: Only skips building docs; speeds up installation without changing behavior.

gem install --user-install.translation_modifier: installing into the user's home directory instead of the system directory
gem install --user-install.rationale: Limits the install scope to the current user; avoids modifying system directories.

gem install --version.translation_modifier: installing a specific version of the gem
gem install --version.rationale: Only constrains which version is installed.

gem uninstall --all.translation_modifier: removing all installed versions of the gem
gem uninstall --all.rationale: Removes every version at once; other gems that depend on them may break.

gem uninstall --executables.translation_modifier: also removing the gem's installed executable scripts
gem uninstall --executables.rationale: Cleans up executable files left behind; they can be reinstalled.

gem uninstall --force.translation_modifier: removing the gem even if other gems depend on it
gem uninstall --force.rationale: Ignores dependency requirements, which may break other installed gems.

gem update --system.translation_modifier: updating RubyGems itself to the latest version
gem update --system.rationale: Modifies the package manager binary, which affects all future gem operations.

gh api --method.translation_modifier: using a specific HTTP method such as POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE
gh api --method.rationale: Non-GET methods modify or delete remote resources.

gh api --paginate.translation_modifier: fetching all pages of results automatically
gh api --paginate.rationale: Follows pagination links to retrieve complete result sets; still read-only when used with GET.

gh cache delete --all.translation_modifier: deleting all caches in the repository
gh cache delete --all.rationale: Removes every cache at once, which may significantly slow all subsequent workflow runs.

gh issue delete --yes.rationale: Skips the confirmation prompt on a destructive operation.

gh label delete --yes.rationale: Skips the confirmation prompt on label deletion.

gh pr close --delete-branch.translation_modifier: deleting the local and remote branch after closing
gh pr close --delete-branch.rationale: Removes the branch, which may discard unmerged work if not preserved elsewhere.

gh pr create --draft.translation_modifier: marking it as a draft that is not ready for review
gh pr create --draft.rationale: Creates the PR in draft state, signaling it is not ready to merge.

gh pr create --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the creation without actually opening a pull request
gh pr create --dry-run.rationale: No pull request is created; only shows what would happen.

gh pr create --fill.translation_modifier: using commit messages for the title and body
gh pr create --fill.rationale: Auto-fills PR metadata from commits; still creates the same PR.

gh pr merge --admin.rationale: Overrides required checks and reviews, merging code that has not passed safeguards.

gh pr merge --auto.translation_modifier: enabling auto-merge once requirements are met
gh pr merge --auto.rationale: Schedules an automatic merge, which will proceed without further human confirmation.

gh pr merge --delete-branch.rationale: Removes the local and remote branch, which is expected but irreversible without recreating it.

gh pr merge --merge.translation_modifier: using a merge commit that preserves all individual commits
gh pr merge --merge.rationale: Selects the default merge strategy; does not increase destructive potential.

gh pr merge --rebase.translation_modifier: rebasing the commits onto the base branch
gh pr merge --rebase.rationale: Changes the merge strategy; the PR is still merged into the base branch.

gh pr merge --squash.translation_modifier: squashing all commits into one before merging
gh pr merge --squash.rationale: Changes the merge strategy but does not increase destructive potential.

gh pr review --approve.translation_modifier: approving the pull request for merging
gh pr review --approve.rationale: Signals the PR is ready to merge, which may trigger auto-merge if configured.

gh pr review --comment.translation_modifier: leaving a comment without approving or requesting changes
gh pr review --comment.rationale: Posts a neutral review comment; does not affect merge eligibility.

gh pr review --request-changes.translation_modifier: requesting changes that block merging until addressed
gh pr review --request-changes.rationale: Blocks the PR from merging until the review is dismissed or resolved.

gh release create --draft.translation_modifier: saving it as a draft without publishing
gh release create --draft.rationale: The release is not visible to the public until explicitly published.

gh release create --generate-notes.rationale: Fills in release notes automatically; does not affect the release content or assets.

gh release create --prerelease.translation_modifier: marking it as a pre-release version
gh release create --prerelease.rationale: Labels the release as pre-release; does not change its visibility or content.

gh release create --verify-tag.translation_modifier: aborting if the tag does not already exist on the remote
gh release create --verify-tag.rationale: Adds a safety check that prevents accidental tag creation.

gh release delete --cleanup-tag.translation_modifier: also deleting the associated Git tag
gh release delete --cleanup-tag.rationale: Removes the tag in addition to the release, which may break references and automation.

gh release delete --yes.rationale: Skips the confirmation prompt on a destructive operation.

gh repo archive --yes.rationale: Bypasses the confirmation prompt on archiving, which makes the repository read-only.

gh repo create --clone.translation_modifier: cloning it to the local machine after creation
gh repo create --clone.rationale: Creates a local directory; does not affect remote state beyond the initial creation.

gh repo create --private.translation_modifier: making it visible only to you and collaborators
gh repo create --private.rationale: Restricts access to the repository owner and explicitly added collaborators.

gh repo create --public.translation_modifier: making it publicly visible to everyone
gh repo create --public.rationale: Public repositories expose code to the entire internet.

gh repo delete --yes.rationale: Skips the confirmation prompt on a destructive operation, increasing the chance of accidental deletion.

git add --all.translation_modifier: including all modified, deleted, and new files in the entire repository
git add --all.rationale: May unintentionally stage files the user did not mean to include, such as secrets or build artifacts.

git add --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the operation without actually staging anything
git add --dry-run.rationale: No changes are made; only shows what would be staged.

git add --force.translation_modifier: including files that are normally ignored by .gitignore
git add --force.rationale: Bypasses .gitignore rules, which may cause secrets or build artifacts to be tracked.

git add --patch.translation_modifier: interactively choosing individual hunks to stage
git add --patch.rationale: Gives fine-grained control over what is staged; reduces accidental inclusion.

git add --update.translation_modifier: only for files already tracked by Git
git add --update.rationale: Limits scope to tracked files; will not add new untracked files.

git add -A.translation_modifier: including all modified, deleted, and new files in the entire repository
git add -A.rationale: Alias for --all; may unintentionally stage files the user did not mean to include.

git am --abort.translation_modifier: aborting the patch application and restoring the previous state
git am --abort.rationale: Safely cancels the operation and returns to the pre-am state.

git am --no-verify.translation_modifier: skipping pre-applypatch and applypatch-msg hook checks
git am --no-verify.rationale: Bypasses safety hooks that may enforce code quality or policy.

git branch --all.translation_modifier: including both local and remote-tracking branches
git branch --all.rationale: Only affects the listing display; no branches are modified.

git branch --force.translation_modifier: resetting the branch pointer even if the branch already exists
git branch --force.rationale: Moves an existing branch to a new commit, discarding its previous position.

git branch -D.translation_modifier: forcefully deleting a branch even if it has unmerged commits
git branch -D.rationale: Deletes a branch regardless of merge status; unmerged commits may become unreachable.

git branch -d.translation_modifier: deleting a branch that has been fully merged
git branch -d.rationale: Deletes a merged branch; the commits remain reachable but the branch name is lost.

git checkout --force.translation_modifier: discarding any uncommitted local changes that conflict
git checkout --force.rationale: Permanently throws away uncommitted work in the working tree without confirmation.

git checkout -b.translation_modifier: creating a new branch at the current commit
git checkout -b.rationale: Creates a new branch and switches to it; fully reversible.

git cherry-pick --abort.translation_modifier: aborting the cherry-pick and restoring the previous state
git cherry-pick --abort.rationale: Safely cancels a cherry-pick in progress.

git cherry-pick --no-commit.translation_modifier: applying the changes to the working tree without creating a commit
git cherry-pick --no-commit.rationale: Lets the user inspect the result before committing.

git clean -X.rationale: Targets ignored files specifically, which may include build caches or local configuration.

git clean -d.rationale: Extends deletion to entire directory trees, increasing the scope of data loss.

git clean -f.rationale: Required for git clean to execute; without it the command refuses to run. Risk matches the base command.

git clean -i.translation_modifier: interactively selecting which files to delete
git clean -i.rationale: Gives the user per-file control, reducing the risk of accidental deletion.

git clean -n.translation_modifier: simulating the operation without actually deleting anything
git clean -n.rationale: Dry-run mode; only shows what would be removed.

git clean -x.rationale: Deletes ignored files such as build outputs, IDE configs, and environment files that may be irreplaceable.

git clone --branch.translation_modifier: checking out a specific branch or tag instead of the default
git clone --branch.rationale: Selects which branch to check out; does not affect existing files.

git clone --depth.translation_modifier: creating a shallow clone with only the specified number of recent commits
git clone --depth.rationale: Reduces download size; the clone is functional but has truncated history.

git clone --recursive.rationale: Downloads additional repositories; no existing data is modified.

git commit --all.translation_modifier: automatically staging all modified and deleted tracked files before committing
git commit --all.rationale: May commit changes the user did not intend to include.

git commit --amend.translation_modifier: replacing the most recent commit instead of creating a new one
git commit --amend.rationale: Rewrites the last commit; dangerous if that commit has already been pushed to a shared branch.

git commit --message.translation_modifier: with the commit message provided on the command line
git commit --message.rationale: Specifies the message directly; does not change what is committed.

git commit --no-verify.translation_modifier: skipping all pre-commit and commit-msg hook checks
git commit --no-verify.rationale: Bypasses safety hooks that may enforce linting, tests, or secret detection.

git config --unset.rationale: Removes a single config entry; can be re-set with the same command.

git config --unset-all.translation_modifier: removing all values for a configuration key
git config --unset-all.rationale: Removes all entries for a multivalue key; may affect hooks, aliases, or remote configurations.

git diff --staged.translation_modifier: showing only changes that have been staged for commit
git diff --staged.rationale: Narrows the diff to the staging area; read-only operation.

git diff --stat.rationale: Shows a summary of changed files instead of full diffs; read-only operation.

git fetch --all.rationale: Fetches from every remote but still does not modify local branches.

git fetch --force.translation_modifier: overwriting local refs even if the update is not a fast-forward
git fetch --force.rationale: Allows non-fast-forward ref updates which could cause confusion about remote history.

git fetch --prune.translation_modifier: removing local remote-tracking branches that no longer exist on the remote
git fetch --prune.rationale: Cleans up stale tracking refs; does not affect local branches or uncommitted work.

git gc --aggressive.translation_modifier: spending extra time optimizing the repository more thoroughly
git gc --aggressive.rationale: More thorough repacking; safe but can take a very long time on large repositories.

git gc --prune.translation_modifier: immediately expiring unreachable objects regardless of their age
git gc --prune.rationale: Removes all unreachable objects without waiting for the default grace period, eliminating recovery options.

git log --all.translation_modifier: including commits from all branches and refs
git log --all.rationale: Widens the log output to all branches; still read-only.

git log --graph.rationale: Adds a visual branch graph to the output; read-only operation.

git log --oneline.rationale: Changes output formatting to one line per commit; read-only operation.

git merge --abort.translation_modifier: aborting the current merge and restoring the previous state
git merge --abort.rationale: Safely cancels a merge in progress and returns to the pre-merge state.

git merge --no-commit.translation_modifier: without automatically creating a merge commit
git merge --no-commit.rationale: Gives the user a chance to inspect the merge result before committing.

git merge --no-verify.translation_modifier: skipping the pre-merge and commit-msg hook checks
git merge --no-verify.rationale: Bypasses safety hooks that may enforce code quality or policy.

git merge --squash.translation_modifier: squashing all incoming commits into a single set of changes without a merge commit
git merge --squash.rationale: Discards individual commit history from the merged branch.

git mv --force.translation_modifier: overwriting the destination even if it already exists
git mv --force.rationale: Silently overwrites an existing file at the destination path.

git pull --force.translation_modifier: overwriting local tracking refs even when they are not ancestors
git pull --force.rationale: Forces reference updates that may discard local-only changes or cause unexpected history changes.

git pull --rebase.translation_modifier: replaying local commits on top of the remote changes instead of merging
git pull --rebase.rationale: Rewrites local commit hashes, which can cause issues if those commits were already shared.

git push --all.translation_modifier: pushing all local branches to the remote
git push --all.rationale: May push branches that were not intended to be shared.

git push --delete.translation_modifier: deleting the specified branch or tag on the remote
git push --delete.rationale: Permanently removes a remote ref, which may disrupt other contributors' workflows.

git push --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the push without actually sending data
git push --dry-run.rationale: No data is transmitted; only shows what would happen.

git push --force.rationale: Rewrites the remote branch's commit history, which can permanently discard other contributors' work.

git push --force-with-lease.translation_modifier: overwriting remote history only if no one else has pushed
git push --force-with-lease.rationale: Safer than --force but still rewrites history; fails if the remote has diverged.

git push --mirror.translation_modifier: making the remote an exact mirror of the local repository, deleting all non-matching refs
git push --mirror.rationale: Destructively overwrites the entire remote to match local state, removing branches, tags, and history.

git push --no-verify.rationale: Bypasses pre-push hooks that may enforce CI checks or branch protections.

git push --prune.translation_modifier: deleting remote branches that no longer exist locally
git push --prune.rationale: Only removes remote refs the user has already deleted locally; the intent is explicit cleanup.

git push --tags.rationale: Publishes all tags, including ones that may not be ready for release.

git rebase --abort.translation_modifier: aborting the rebase and restoring the branch to its original state
git rebase --abort.rationale: Safely cancels a rebase in progress; no commits are lost.

git rebase --continue.translation_modifier: continuing after resolving conflicts in the current step
git rebase --continue.rationale: Proceeds with the rebase; the user should verify conflict resolutions are correct.

git rebase --force-rebase.translation_modifier: rewriting all commits even if they could be fast-forwarded
git rebase --force-rebase.rationale: Creates new commit hashes unnecessarily, but does not add destructive capability beyond what rebase already does.

git rebase --interactive.translation_modifier: allowing individual commits to be reordered, edited, squashed, or dropped
git rebase --interactive.rationale: Gives more control over the rebase than the default; the risk of history rewriting is already in the base command.

git rebase --onto.translation_modifier: replaying commits onto a specified target commit instead of the upstream
git rebase --onto.rationale: Gives more control over where commits are replayed; the risk of history rewriting is already in the base command.

git remote -v.translation_modifier: showing the fetch and push URLs for each remote
git remote -v.rationale: Adds URL details to the listing; read-only operation.

git reset --hard.translation_modifier: discarding all uncommitted changes in the working directory
git reset --hard.rationale: Permanently deletes uncommitted work with no built-in recovery mechanism.

git reset --mixed.translation_modifier: unstaging changes but keeping them in the working directory
git reset --mixed.rationale: Default mode; preserves working tree changes while resetting the staging area.

git reset --soft.translation_modifier: keeping all changes staged for commit
git reset --soft.rationale: Only moves the branch pointer; staged and working tree files are untouched.

git restore --source.translation_modifier: from a specific commit or branch instead of the staging area
git restore --source.rationale: Replaces working tree files with content from an arbitrary commit.

git restore --staged.translation_modifier: unstaging the files without modifying the working tree
git restore --staged.rationale: Only removes files from the staging area; working tree is untouched.

git restore --worktree.translation_modifier: overwriting the files in the working directory
git restore --worktree.rationale: Replaces working tree files; uncommitted changes to those files are permanently lost.

git revert --abort.translation_modifier: aborting the revert and restoring the previous state
git revert --abort.rationale: Safely cancels a revert in progress.

git revert --no-commit.translation_modifier: applying the revert to the working tree without creating a commit
git revert --no-commit.rationale: Lets the user inspect the reverted changes before committing.

git rm --cached.translation_modifier: only removing the file from the staging area while keeping it on disk
git rm --cached.rationale: Untracks the file without deleting it from the working tree.

git rm --force.translation_modifier: even if the file has uncommitted changes
git rm --force.rationale: Deletes files with unstaged or staged modifications that may not be recoverable.

git rm -r.rationale: Removes all matching files in subdirectories, increasing the blast radius.

git stash --all.translation_modifier: also saving untracked and ignored files
git stash --all.rationale: Includes ignored files like build artifacts; the clean step may remove files the user expected to keep.

git stash --include-untracked.rationale: Extends the stash to include untracked files; more comprehensive but still reversible.

git stash --keep-index.translation_modifier: keeping the staged changes in the staging area
git stash --keep-index.rationale: Only stashes unstaged changes; staged work remains in the index.

git submodule deinit --all.translation_modifier: unregistering every submodule in the repository
git submodule deinit --all.rationale: Removes working tree data for all submodules at once.

git submodule deinit --force.translation_modifier: even if the submodule has local modifications
git submodule deinit --force.rationale: Discards local changes in the submodule working tree without confirmation.

git submodule update --recursive.translation_modifier: including nested submodules at all levels
git submodule update --recursive.rationale: Extends the update to nested submodules, increasing the scope of changes.

git switch --discard-changes.rationale: Permanently throws away uncommitted work in the working tree without confirmation.

git switch --force.rationale: Alias for --discard-changes; permanently throws away uncommitted work.

git switch -c.translation_modifier: creating a new branch at the current commit
git switch -c.rationale: Creates a new branch and switches to it; fully reversible.

git tag -a.translation_modifier: creating an annotated tag with a message
git tag -a.rationale: Creates a full tag object with metadata; slightly more permanent than a lightweight tag but still reversible.

git tag -d.rationale: Removes the tag locally; the tag can be recreated if the commit hash is known.

git tag -f.translation_modifier: overwriting an existing tag with the same name
git tag -f.rationale: Silently moves a tag to a different commit, which can cause confusion for collaborators.

git update-ref -d.rationale: Removes the reference entirely, which may make commits unreachable.

git worktree remove --force.translation_modifier: even if the working tree has uncommitted changes
git worktree remove --force.rationale: Deletes the working tree without checking for uncommitted work.

git-lfs fetch --all.translation_modifier: downloading LFS objects for all refs, not just the current branch
git-lfs fetch --all.rationale: Increases download scope but only populates the local cache.

git-lfs migrate export --everything.translation_modifier: across all refs in the repository
git-lfs migrate export --everything.rationale: Rewrites every ref in the repository, maximizing the scope of history changes.

git-lfs migrate import --everything.translation_modifier: across all refs in the repository
git-lfs migrate import --everything.rationale: Rewrites every ref in the repository, maximizing the scope of history changes.

git-lfs migrate import --no-rewrite.translation_modifier: without rewriting existing history, only converting in new commits
git-lfs migrate import --no-rewrite.rationale: Avoids history rewriting; only future commits will use LFS for the specified file types.

git-lfs prune --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the operation without actually deleting anything
git-lfs prune --dry-run.rationale: No files are deleted; only shows what would be pruned.

git-lfs prune --force.translation_modifier: deleting all objects except unpushed ones, including those needed by the current checkout
git-lfs prune --force.rationale: Removes objects required for the current working tree, which may require re-fetching.

git-lfs prune --no-verify-remote.translation_modifier: skipping remote verification before deleting locally
git-lfs prune --no-verify-remote.rationale: Disables the safety check, risking deletion of locally-unique copies.

git-lfs prune --verify-remote.translation_modifier: verifying the remote has a copy before deleting locally
git-lfs prune --verify-remote.rationale: Adds a safety check that confirms remote availability before local deletion.

git-lfs push --all.translation_modifier: uploading all locally referenced LFS objects
git-lfs push --all.rationale: Pushes all LFS objects reachable from any ref, which may include unintended files.

git-lfs push --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the push without actually uploading anything
git-lfs push --dry-run.rationale: No data is transmitted; only shows what would be pushed.

go build -o.translation_modifier: writing the output to a specific file

go build -race.rationale: Adds runtime instrumentation for detecting race conditions; does not change program logic.

go build -v.translation_modifier: printing the names of packages as they are compiled
go build -v.rationale: Only adds diagnostic output; does not change the build result.

go clean -cache.rationale: Removes all cached build artifacts; they will be rebuilt on next compilation but deletion is immediate.

go clean -testcache.rationale: Forces tests to re-run next time; no source code or binaries are affected.

go get -u.translation_modifier: updating dependencies to their latest versions
go get -u.rationale: Fetches newer versions of dependencies, which may introduce breaking changes.

go test -bench.translation_modifier: running benchmark functions that match the given pattern
go test -bench.rationale: Runs performance benchmarks; does not modify any files.

go test -cover.rationale: Adds coverage instrumentation; does not change test behavior.

go test -race.translation_modifier: enabling the data race detector during tests
go test -race.rationale: Adds runtime instrumentation; does not change test logic.

go test -run.translation_modifier: running only tests whose names match the given pattern
go test -run.rationale: Filters which tests execute; does not add destructive capability.

go test -v.translation_modifier: printing the name and result of each individual test
go test -v.rationale: Only adds diagnostic output; does not change test behavior.

gpg --batch.rationale: Disables interactive prompts; commonly used in automated scripts.

gpg --decrypt -o.translation_modifier: writing the decrypted output to a specified file
gpg --decrypt -o.rationale: Specifies the output destination; may overwrite an existing file.

gpg --delete-keys --yes.rationale: Skips the confirmation prompt, increasing the risk of accidental key deletion.

gpg --delete-secret-keys --yes.rationale: Skips confirmation for private key deletion; the key may be permanently lost.

gpg --encrypt --armor.translation_modifier: encoding the output in text-safe ASCII format
gpg --encrypt --armor.rationale: Changes output encoding only; does not affect the encryption.

gpg --encrypt --symmetric.translation_modifier: using a passphrase instead of a public key for encryption
gpg --encrypt --symmetric.rationale: Changes the encryption method but does not increase risk.

gpg --encrypt -o.translation_modifier: writing output to a specified file
gpg --encrypt -o.rationale: Specifies the output destination; may overwrite an existing file.

gpg --encrypt -r.translation_modifier: specifying a recipient for the encrypted message
gpg --encrypt -r.rationale: Selects which key to encrypt for; does not change the encryption operation.

gpg --export --armor.translation_modifier: encoding the exported key in text-safe ASCII format
gpg --export --armor.rationale: Changes output encoding only; does not affect the key data.

gpg --export -o.translation_modifier: writing the exported key to a specified file
gpg --export -o.rationale: Specifies the output destination; may overwrite an existing file.

gpg --homedir.translation_modifier: using a specific directory for configuration and keyrings
gpg --homedir.rationale: Overrides the default configuration directory; does not modify the default one.

gpg --keyring.rationale: Selects a non-default keyring; does not modify the default keyring.

gpg --sign --armor.translation_modifier: encoding the signature in text-safe ASCII format
gpg --sign --armor.rationale: Changes output encoding only; does not affect the signature.

gpg --sign --clearsign.translation_modifier: wrapping the message in a readable text signature
gpg --sign --clearsign.rationale: Creates a cleartext signed message; a formatting choice.

gpg --sign --detach-sign.translation_modifier: creating a separate signature file instead of embedding it
gpg --sign --detach-sign.rationale: Creates a detached signature file; the original is not modified.

gpg --sign -u.translation_modifier: using a specific private key for signing
gpg --sign -u.rationale: Selects which key to sign with; does not change the signing operation.

gpg --verbose.rationale: Only increases the amount of output displayed.

gpg-agent --allow-preset-passphrase.translation_modifier: allowing passphrases to be set by external programs
gpg-agent --allow-preset-passphrase.rationale: Lets other programs inject passphrases; reduces the security of passphrase management.

gpg-agent --daemon.rationale: Forks the agent into the background; standard startup mode.

gpg-agent --default-cache-ttl.translation_modifier: setting how long cached passphrases remain valid in seconds
gpg-agent --default-cache-ttl.rationale: Controls cache duration; a security-tuning option.

gpg-agent --max-cache-ttl.translation_modifier: setting the maximum time a cached passphrase can be used regardless of access
gpg-agent --max-cache-ttl.rationale: Limits the maximum cache lifetime; a security-enhancing option.

gpg-agent --no-grab.translation_modifier: without grabbing the keyboard during passphrase entry
gpg-agent --no-grab.rationale: Changes input behavior; does not affect key management.

gpg-agent --server.translation_modifier: running in server mode and reading commands from standard input
gpg-agent --server.rationale: Keeps the agent in the foreground to accept commands; does not modify keys.

gpg-agent --verbose.rationale: Only increases the amount of output displayed.

grep --exclude.translation_modifier: skipping files whose names match a specified pattern
grep --exclude.rationale: Narrows the set of files searched; still read-only.

grep --exclude-dir.translation_modifier: skipping directories whose names match a specified pattern
grep --exclude-dir.rationale: Narrows the set of directories searched; still read-only.

grep --include.translation_modifier: searching only files whose names match a specified pattern
grep --include.rationale: Narrows the set of files searched; still read-only.

grep -A.translation_modifier: including a specified number of lines after each match
grep -A.rationale: Adds trailing context lines to output; still read-only.

grep -B.translation_modifier: including a specified number of lines before each match
grep -B.rationale: Adds leading context lines to output; still read-only.

grep -C.translation_modifier: including a specified number of lines before and after each match
grep -C.rationale: Adds surrounding context lines to output; still read-only.

grep -E.rationale: Changes the regex dialect; still read-only.

grep -F.translation_modifier: treating the pattern as a literal string instead of a regular expression

grep -H.translation_modifier: always showing the filename for each match
grep -H.rationale: Prefixes each match with the filename; still read-only.

grep -L.translation_modifier: showing only the names of files that do not contain a match
grep -L.rationale: Inverts file-level matching to show non-matching files; still read-only.

grep -P.rationale: Changes the regex dialect to PCRE; still read-only.

grep -R.translation_modifier: recursively through all subdirectories, following symbolic links
grep -R.rationale: Like -r but follows symbolic links, potentially expanding search scope; still read-only.

grep -Z.translation_modifier: separating output filenames with null characters instead of newlines
grep -Z.rationale: Changes output delimiter for safe piping to xargs; still read-only.

grep -c.translation_modifier: showing only the count of matching lines per file
grep -c.rationale: Changes output to counts; still read-only.

grep -e.translation_modifier: using an explicitly specified pattern, allowing multiple patterns or patterns starting with a dash
grep -e.rationale: Specifies one or more patterns; still read-only.

grep -f.rationale: Loads patterns from a file instead of the command line; still read-only.

grep -h.translation_modifier: suppressing the filename prefix in output
grep -h.rationale: Removes filename prefixes from output; still read-only.

grep -i.rationale: Broadens matches to ignore case; still read-only.

grep -l.translation_modifier: showing only the names of files that contain a match
grep -l.rationale: Changes output format to filenames only; still read-only.

grep -m.translation_modifier: stopping after a specified number of matches
grep -m.rationale: Limits the number of matches returned; still read-only.

grep -n.rationale: Adds line numbers to output; still read-only.

grep -o.translation_modifier: showing only the matching portion of each line
grep -o.rationale: Changes output to show only the matched text; still read-only.

grep -q.translation_modifier: suppressing all output and only setting the exit code
grep -q.rationale: Produces no output; useful in scripts for testing whether a match exists.

grep -r.rationale: Searches files in subdirectories; still read-only.

grep -s.translation_modifier: suppressing error messages about nonexistent or unreadable files
grep -s.rationale: Silences file access errors; still read-only.

grep -v.translation_modifier: showing only lines that do not match

grep -w.rationale: Narrows matches to word boundaries; still read-only.

grep -x.rationale: Requires the pattern to match the full line; still read-only.

gunzip --force.translation_modifier: overwriting existing output files without prompting
gunzip --force.rationale: Overwrites existing output files without confirmation; recoverable from backups.

gunzip --recursive.translation_modifier: recursively through all files in subdirectories
gunzip --recursive.rationale: Processes entire directory trees, increasing the scope of files affected.

gunzip -c.translation_modifier: writing decompressed output to the terminal instead of replacing the file
gunzip -c.rationale: Leaves original files intact; only writes to the terminal.

gunzip -f.rationale: Forces overwriting of output files and allows decompression even in unusual situations.

gunzip -k.rationale: Preserves the input file instead of deleting it after decompression.

gunzip -r.rationale: Decompresses files throughout a directory tree, replacing each with its decompressed version.

gunzip -t.translation_modifier: testing the compressed file integrity without decompressing
gunzip -t.rationale: Read-only integrity check that does not modify any files.

gzip -1.rationale: Changes compression level only; does not affect which files are processed.

gzip -9.rationale: Changes compression level only; does not affect which files are processed.

gzip -N.translation_modifier: restoring the original filename and timestamp when decompressing
gzip -N.rationale: Uses stored metadata to name the output file; does not add destructive capability.

gzip -c.translation_modifier: writing output to standard output and keeping the original file
gzip -c.rationale: Leaves the original file intact; output goes to standard output.

gzip -d.rationale: Decompresses .gz files in place, replacing them with the original content.

gzip -f.rationale: Forces compression even if the output file already exists.

gzip -k.translation_modifier: keeping the original file instead of replacing it
gzip -k.rationale: Preserves the source file; a safety-enhancing option.

gzip -l.translation_modifier: listing compression statistics without modifying files

gzip -n.translation_modifier: without saving the original filename and timestamp in the compressed file
gzip -n.rationale: Changes metadata storage only; does not affect file content.

gzip -q.rationale: Suppresses warning messages; does not change behavior.

gzip -r.rationale: Compresses or decompresses all files in a directory tree.

gzip -t.translation_modifier: testing the integrity of compressed files without decompressing
gzip -t.rationale: Read-only operation that verifies compressed file integrity.

gzip -v.rationale: Displays compression ratio for each file; does not change behavior.

halt -N.translation_modifier: without flushing the file system cache during process cleanup but still syncing at the kernel level
halt -N.rationale: Skips the initial cache flush, which may cause data loss if devices are unavailable, though a kernel-level sync still occurs.

halt -l.translation_modifier: without recording the halt in the system log
halt -l.rationale: Only suppresses log recording; does not change the halt behavior itself.

halt -n.rationale: Skipping the cache flush can cause filesystem corruption and data loss.

halt -q.rationale: Performs an ungraceful shutdown, skipping process cleanup.

hdiutil attach -nobrowse.translation_modifier: hiding the mounted volumes from the Finder
hdiutil attach -nobrowse.rationale: Cosmetic change; the volumes are still accessible.

hdiutil attach -nomount.rationale: Only creates the device node; no volumes are mounted.

hdiutil attach -noverify.translation_modifier: skipping the checksum verification of the disk image
hdiutil attach -noverify.rationale: Bypasses integrity checking; a corrupted image may be mounted without warning.

hdiutil attach -readonly.translation_modifier: mounting the image in read-only mode
hdiutil attach -readonly.rationale: Prevents any modifications to the disk image contents.

hdiutil attach -shadow.translation_modifier: redirecting writes to a separate shadow file instead of the original image
hdiutil attach -shadow.rationale: Preserves the original disk image; all changes go to the shadow file.

hdiutil burn -noverify.rationale: Bypasses post-burn verification; a failed burn may go undetected.

hdiutil convert -format.translation_modifier: specifying the output disk image format
