hdiutil convert -format.rationale: Determines the output format; does not affect the source image.

hdiutil convert -ov.rationale: Destroys the existing file at the output path.

hdiutil create -encryption.translation_modifier: encrypting the disk image with a passphrase
hdiutil create -encryption.rationale: Adds encryption to the new image; improves security.

hdiutil create -ov.rationale: Destroys the existing disk image and replaces it with a new one.

hdiutil create -size.translation_modifier: setting the size of the new disk image
hdiutil create -size.rationale: Specifies the capacity of the new image; does not affect existing files.

hdiutil create -srcfolder.translation_modifier: creating the image from the contents of a folder
hdiutil create -srcfolder.rationale: Reads the source folder to populate the image; does not modify the source.

hdiutil create -type.translation_modifier: setting the disk image type such as sparse or fixed-size
hdiutil create -type.rationale: Determines how storage is allocated; does not affect existing files.

hdiutil detach -force.translation_modifier: forcibly detaching even if files are still open
hdiutil detach -force.rationale: Forces detachment regardless of open files, which may cause data loss or corruption.

hdiutil resize -limits.translation_modifier: displaying the minimum and maximum possible sizes instead of resizing
hdiutil resize -limits.rationale: Read-only query that prints size constraints without modifying the image.

hdiutil resize -size.translation_modifier: setting the new size of the disk image
hdiutil resize -size.rationale: Shrinking below used capacity causes data loss.

head -c.translation_modifier: showing a specified number of bytes instead of lines
head -c.rationale: Changes the unit of output from lines to bytes; still read-only.

head -n.translation_modifier: showing a specified number of lines
head -n.rationale: Controls how many lines are displayed; still read-only.

heap -addresses.translation_modifier: printing the address of each individual allocation
heap -addresses.rationale: Only adds address details to the output.

heap -guessNonObjects.translation_modifier: identifying non-object memory blocks referenced by objects
heap -guessNonObjects.rationale: Performs deeper read-only analysis of memory contents.

heap -noContent.translation_modifier: hiding the content descriptions of memory allocations

heap -s.translation_modifier: sorting output by total size instead of count

heap -showSizes.translation_modifier: showing the distribution of individual allocation sizes for each type
heap -showSizes.rationale: Only adds more detail to the output.

heap -sortBySize.translation_modifier: sorting output by total size instead of count

heap -sumObjectFields.translation_modifier: including referenced non-object memory sizes in object totals
heap -sumObjectFields.rationale: Only changes how sizes are aggregated in the output.

heap -z.translation_modifier: separating output by memory zone instead of showing an aggregate
heap -z.rationale: Only changes how results are grouped in the output.

heap -zones.translation_modifier: separating output by memory zone instead of showing an aggregate
heap -zones.rationale: Only changes how results are grouped in the output.

hexdump -C.translation_modifier: showing both hexadecimal and ASCII representations side by side

hexdump -b.translation_modifier: displaying each byte as a three-digit octal number

hexdump -c.translation_modifier: displaying each byte as an ASCII character

hexdump -d.translation_modifier: displaying two-byte units in unsigned decimal

hexdump -e.translation_modifier: using a custom format string to control the display
hexdump -e.rationale: Only changes the output format using a user-specified template.

hexdump -n.translation_modifier: limiting output to a specific number of bytes
hexdump -n.rationale: Only restricts how much of the file is displayed.

hexdump -s.translation_modifier: skipping a specified number of bytes from the beginning
hexdump -s.rationale: Only changes the starting offset for display.

hexdump -v.translation_modifier: showing all data including repeated identical lines
hexdump -v.rationale: Only disables line deduplication in the output.

host -4.translation_modifier: using only IPv4 for the query
host -4.rationale: Restricts transport to IPv4; still a read-only query.

host -6.translation_modifier: using only IPv6 for the query
host -6.rationale: Restricts transport to IPv6; still a read-only query.

host -C.translation_modifier: checking consistency of start-of-authority records across all authoritative name servers
host -C.rationale: Queries multiple servers for comparison; still read-only.

host -T.translation_modifier: using TCP instead of UDP for the query
host -T.rationale: Changes the transport protocol; still a read-only query.

host -W.translation_modifier: setting a custom timeout in seconds for the query
host -W.rationale: Changes the wait time; still a read-only query.

host -a.translation_modifier: showing all available DNS record types
host -a.rationale: Only changes the scope of the query; still read-only.

host -l.translation_modifier: performing a zone transfer to list all records
host -l.rationale: Requests a zone transfer from the server; read-only query that does not modify DNS data.

host -r.rationale: Changes query behavior to non-recursive; still read-only.

host -t.translation_modifier: querying for a specific DNS record type
host -t.rationale: Only changes which record type is looked up.

host -v.translation_modifier: showing verbose output with full record details

host -w.rationale: Sets timeout to maximum; still a read-only query.

hostname -f.translation_modifier: showing the fully qualified domain name

hostname -s.translation_modifier: showing only the short hostname without the domain

htpasswd -D.translation_modifier: deleting the specified user from the password file
htpasswd -D.rationale: Removes a user's authentication entry, which may lock them out of protected resources.

htpasswd -b.translation_modifier: reading the password from the command line instead of prompting
htpasswd -b.rationale: The password is visible in process listings and shell history.

htpasswd -c.translation_modifier: creating a new password file, overwriting any existing one
htpasswd -c.rationale: Destroys the existing password file and all its entries.

htpasswd -n.translation_modifier: printing the result to standard output instead of updating the file
htpasswd -n.rationale: Does not modify any files; only outputs the result.

htpasswd -v.translation_modifier: verifying a password instead of updating it

httpd -t.translation_modifier: testing the configuration file syntax without starting the server

iconutil -c.translation_modifier: converting to a specified format, either an icon file or an icon set folder

iconv -s.translation_modifier: suppressing warnings about characters that cannot be converted

id -F.translation_modifier: showing the full name of the user

id -p.translation_modifier: showing the output in a human-readable format
id -p.rationale: Only changes the output to a more readable layout.

id -r.translation_modifier: showing the real ID instead of the effective ID

ifconfig -a.translation_modifier: showing all network interfaces, including those that are down
ifconfig -a.rationale: Only changes the scope of the display; read-only operation.

ifconfig -alias.translation_modifier: removing a network address from the interface

ifconfig -arp.translation_modifier: disabling address resolution on the interface

ifconfig -l.translation_modifier: listing the names of all network interfaces
ifconfig -l.rationale: Read-only listing of interface names; does not modify anything.

ifconfig -m.translation_modifier: showing the supported media types for an interface

ifconfig -v.rationale: Increases output verbosity; does not change behavior.

ifconfig alias.translation_modifier: adding an additional network address to the interface
ifconfig alias.rationale: Modifies network configuration by assigning an extra address.

ifconfig down.rationale: Deactivates a network interface, which may disconnect the system from the network.

ifconfig mtu.translation_modifier: setting the maximum packet size for the interface

initdb --data-checksums.translation_modifier: enabling data checksums on all pages

initdb --locale.translation_modifier: using a specified locale for the cluster

initdb --waldir.translation_modifier: storing write-ahead log files in a specified directory
initdb --waldir.rationale: Separates write-ahead log storage from the data directory; a layout configuration choice.

initdb -A.translation_modifier: using a specified default authentication method

initdb -E.rationale: Sets the default character encoding for the cluster; a configuration choice with no destructive impact.

initdb -U.rationale: Names the bootstrap superuser; a configuration choice during initialization.

initdb -W.translation_modifier: prompting for a superuser password during setup
initdb -W.rationale: Adds password-based authentication for the superuser; a security-enhancing option.

initdb -k.translation_modifier: enabling data checksums on all pages
initdb -k.rationale: Adds data integrity verification; a safety-enhancing option that may slightly reduce performance.

install -B.translation_modifier: using a custom suffix for backup files instead of the default
install -B.rationale: Only changes the naming convention for backup files created with -b.

install -C.translation_modifier: only copying if the file has actually changed

install -S.translation_modifier: flushing each file to disk immediately after copying
install -S.rationale: Ensures data is written to disk right away, reducing risk of data loss from a crash.

install -b.translation_modifier: creating a backup of any existing file before overwriting
install -b.rationale: Preserves the original file by renaming it before overwriting.

install -c.rationale: Copies the file, which is already the default behavior.

install -d.translation_modifier: creating directories instead of copying files
install -d.rationale: Only creates directories; does not overwrite existing files.

install -g.translation_modifier: setting the group of the installed files

install -m.translation_modifier: setting specific access permissions on the installed files

install -o.translation_modifier: setting the owner of the installed files

install -p.translation_modifier: preserving the original file's access and modification times

install -s.translation_modifier: removing debugging information from the installed programs

install_name_tool -add_rpath.translation_modifier: adding a new runtime search path for libraries

install_name_tool -delete_rpath.translation_modifier: removing a runtime search path for libraries

install_name_tool -id.translation_modifier: changing the library's own install name
install_name_tool -id.rationale: Changes how other programs reference this library; incorrect values break dependents.

install_name_tool -rpath.translation_modifier: replacing an existing runtime search path with a new one
install_name_tool -rpath.rationale: Changes where the program looks for libraries at runtime.

installer -allowUntrusted.translation_modifier: allowing packages signed by untrusted or expired certificates
installer -allowUntrusted.rationale: Bypasses certificate trust verification, allowing potentially malicious packages to install.

installer -applyChoiceChangesXML.translation_modifier: customizing which package components to install
installer -applyChoiceChangesXML.rationale: Modifies which parts of a package are installed, potentially skipping important components.

installer -config.translation_modifier: saving the installation arguments to a configuration file instead of installing
installer -config.rationale: No installation is performed; only writes a configuration file.

installer -dominfo.translation_modifier: listing available installation domains instead of installing
installer -dominfo.rationale: Read-only query that lists valid installation domains.

installer -dumplog.rationale: Only adds verbose logging to error output.

installer -file.translation_modifier: reading installation parameters from a configuration file
installer -file.rationale: Applies pre-configured installation settings; behavior depends on the file contents.

installer -lang.translation_modifier: setting the language for the installed system
installer -lang.rationale: Only relevant for OS installs; sets the default language preference.

installer -pkg.translation_modifier: specifying the package file to install
installer -pkg.rationale: Designates which package to install; the package may contain arbitrary scripts.

installer -pkginfo.translation_modifier: displaying package information instead of installing
installer -pkginfo.rationale: Read-only query that displays package contents without installing.

installer -plist.rationale: Formats output as XML property list; does not change installation behavior.

installer -showChoicesXML.translation_modifier: displaying installable package choices in XML format instead of installing
installer -showChoicesXML.rationale: Read-only query that lists available install choices.

installer -store.translation_modifier: installing the package as if it came from the Mac App Store
installer -store.rationale: Installs using App Store conventions; the package may modify system files.

installer -target.translation_modifier: specifying the destination volume for installation
installer -target.rationale: Determines which disk or volume receives the installed files.

installer -verbose.rationale: Increases output detail; does not change installation behavior.

installer -verboseR.rationale: Formats verbose output for machine parsing; does not change installation behavior.

installer -volinfo.translation_modifier: listing available installation volumes instead of installing
installer -volinfo.rationale: Read-only query that lists valid target volumes.

ioreg -a.rationale: Only changes the output format; no state modification.

ioreg -c.translation_modifier: filtering to devices of a specific class

ioreg -d.translation_modifier: limiting the tree depth to a specified level
ioreg -d.rationale: Only controls how deep the tree is displayed.

ioreg -k.translation_modifier: filtering to devices that have a specific property key
ioreg -k.rationale: Only narrows which devices are displayed.

ioreg -l.translation_modifier: showing all properties for each displayed device
ioreg -l.rationale: Only increases the detail shown; read-only operation.

ioreg -n.translation_modifier: filtering to devices matching a specific name
ioreg -n.rationale: Only narrows which devices are displayed.

ioreg -p.translation_modifier: traversing a specific registry plane instead of the default
ioreg -p.rationale: Only changes which view of the device hierarchy is shown.

ioreg -r.translation_modifier: showing only subtrees rooted at matching devices
ioreg -r.rationale: Only changes the tree display starting point; read-only operation.

ioreg -w.translation_modifier: setting the maximum line width for the output
ioreg -w.rationale: Only controls output wrapping; no state modification.

ioreg -x.translation_modifier: displaying data and numbers in hexadecimal
ioreg -x.rationale: Only changes the output format; no state modification.

iostat -c.translation_modifier: repeating the display a specific number of times
iostat -c.rationale: Only controls how many times statistics are sampled.

iostat -d.rationale: Only filters the output to device information.

iostat -w.translation_modifier: pausing a specified number of seconds between updates

ipcrm -m.translation_modifier: marking a shared memory segment for removal by its ID
ipcrm -m.rationale: Marks the shared memory segment for destruction after the last process detaches.

ipcrm -q.translation_modifier: removing a message queue by its ID
ipcrm -q.rationale: Permanently destroys the message queue and all messages in it.

ipcrm -s.translation_modifier: removing a synchronization lock set by its ID
ipcrm -s.rationale: Permanently destroys the synchronization lock set, which may cause processes relying on it to fail.

ipcs -a.translation_modifier: showing the maximum amount of detail for all inter-process communication types
ipcs -a.rationale: Only changes the level of detail displayed.

ipcs -m.translation_modifier: showing only shared memory segment information
ipcs -m.rationale: Only filters the output to shared memory.

ipcs -q.rationale: Only filters the output to message queues.

ipcs -s.rationale: Only filters the output to synchronization locks.

java -D.rationale: Passes a key-value pair to the program; the effect depends on how the program uses it.

java -Xms.translation_modifier: setting the initial heap memory size
java -Xms.rationale: Sets the starting memory allocation; does not change program behavior.

java -Xmx.translation_modifier: setting the maximum heap memory size
java -Xmx.rationale: Limits how much memory the program can use; does not change program behavior.

java -agentlib.translation_modifier: loading a native agent library for profiling or debugging
java -agentlib.rationale: Loads native code into the virtual machine, which could have side effects depending on the agent.

java -cp.translation_modifier: using a custom classpath to locate classes and resources
java -cp.rationale: Only changes where the runtime looks for classes; does not execute anything by itself.

java -ea.translation_modifier: enabling assertion checks in the program

java -jar.rationale: Executes the main class packaged in the Java archive file; the risk depends on what that code does.

java -server.rationale: Selects a different optimization strategy; does not change program logic.

java -verbose.translation_modifier: printing detailed information about class loading and garbage collection
java -verbose.rationale: Only adds diagnostic output; does not change program behavior.

java -version.rationale: Read-only version display; nothing is executed.

javac -Werror.rationale: Makes compilation stricter but does not change the output when it succeeds.

javac -Xlint.rationale: Only changes which warnings are displayed during compilation.

javac -cp.translation_modifier: using a custom classpath to find referenced classes
javac -cp.rationale: Only changes where the compiler looks for dependencies.

javac -d.rationale: Only changes the output destination for compiled files.

javac -source.translation_modifier: compiling for a specific Java language version

javac -target.rationale: Controls the output bytecode version; does not affect safety.

javac -verbose.translation_modifier: printing detailed information about the compilation process
javac -verbose.rationale: Only adds diagnostic output; does not change the compiled result.

jest --config.rationale: Selects which configuration to use; does not change Jest's capabilities.

jest --coverage.translation_modifier: collecting and reporting code coverage statistics

jest --updateSnapshot.translation_modifier: overwriting existing test snapshots with new values
jest --updateSnapshot.rationale: Rewrites snapshot files, which changes the expected test output baseline.

jest --verbose.translation_modifier: showing detailed results for each individual test
jest --verbose.rationale: Increases output detail; does not change test execution.

jest --watch.translation_modifier: continuously re-running tests when source files change
jest --watch.rationale: Keeps Jest running as a long-lived process that re-runs on file changes.

jest --watchAll.translation_modifier: continuously re-running all tests when any file changes
jest --watchAll.rationale: Like --watch but re-runs all tests instead of only affected ones.

join -1.translation_modifier: joining on a specific field from the first file

join -2.translation_modifier: joining on a specific field from the second file
join -2.rationale: Only changes which field is used for matching.

jq --argjson.translation_modifier: passing a named JSON value into the filter
jq --argjson.rationale: Provides input to the jq program as parsed JSON; does not modify files.

jq --args.translation_modifier: treating remaining arguments as string values for positional access
jq --args.rationale: Provides positional string arguments accessible via $ARGS; does not modify files.

jq --indent.rationale: Changes the number of spaces used for indentation; purely cosmetic.

jq --jsonargs.translation_modifier: treating remaining arguments as JSON values instead of filenames
jq --jsonargs.rationale: Changes how trailing arguments are interpreted; does not modify files.

jq --raw-output0.translation_modifier: outputting raw strings separated by null bytes instead of newlines
jq --raw-output0.rationale: Changes output delimiters for use with xargs -0; does not modify files.

jq --rawfile.translation_modifier: loading a file's raw text into a named string variable

jq --slurpfile.translation_modifier: loading a JSON file into a named variable as an array
jq --slurpfile.rationale: Reads an additional file for use in the filter; does not modify any files.

jq --tab.rationale: Changes output indentation to tabs; purely cosmetic.

jq -R.translation_modifier: reading each input line as a plain string instead of JSON
jq -R.rationale: Changes how input is parsed; does not modify files.

jq -S.translation_modifier: sorting object keys alphabetically in the output
jq -S.rationale: Changes output ordering; does not modify input files.

jq -c.rationale: Changes output formatting; does not modify input files.

jq -e.translation_modifier: setting the exit code based on whether the output is null or false
jq -e.rationale: Changes the exit code behavior; useful for conditionals in scripts.

jq -f.translation_modifier: loading the filter expression from a file instead of the command line
jq -f.rationale: Changes where the filter is read from; does not modify files.

jq -j.translation_modifier: outputting raw strings without a trailing newline
jq -j.rationale: Changes output formatting; does not modify files.

jq -n.translation_modifier: using null as the input instead of reading data
jq -n.rationale: Changes the input source to null; useful for constructing JSON from scratch.

jq -r.translation_modifier: outputting raw strings without JSON quoting
jq -r.rationale: Changes output formatting; does not modify input files.

jq -s.translation_modifier: reading all inputs into a single array before processing
jq -s.rationale: Changes how input is consumed; does not modify files.

kdestroy --credential.translation_modifier: removing only a specific credential from the cache

kdestroy -c.translation_modifier: removing a specific credential cache instead of the default

kdestroy -p.translation_modifier: removing the cache associated with a specific principal

keytool -delete -alias.rationale: Identifies which key or certificate to permanently remove.

keytool -genkeypair -dname.translation_modifier: setting the distinguished name for the certificate

keytool -genkeypair -storepass.translation_modifier: providing the keystore password on the command line

keytool -genkeypair -validity.translation_modifier: setting how many days the certificate is valid
keytool -genkeypair -validity.rationale: Controls certificate lifetime; does not change the operation.

keytool -importcert -alias.translation_modifier: storing the certificate under a specific name
keytool -importcert -alias.rationale: Labels the entry; does not change the import operation.

keytool -importcert -trustcacerts.translation_modifier: also trusting certificates from the default certificate authority store
keytool -importcert -trustcacerts.rationale: Includes standard trusted certificates in chain validation.

keytool -importkeystore -destkeystore.translation_modifier: importing into a specific destination keystore

keytool -importkeystore -srckeystore.translation_modifier: importing from a specific source keystore
keytool -importkeystore -srckeystore.rationale: Specifies the source; does not change the import operation.

keytool -importkeystore -srcstoretype.translation_modifier: specifying the format of the source keystore
keytool -importkeystore -srcstoretype.rationale: Selects the keystore format; does not change the import operation.

keytool -list -alias.rationale: Filters the output to one entry; read-only.

keytool -list -keystore.translation_modifier: listing entries from a specific keystore file
keytool -list -keystore.rationale: Selects a non-default keystore to display; read-only.

keytool -list -v.translation_modifier: showing detailed information for each entry
keytool -list -v.rationale: Only adds more detail to the output.

kill -0.translation_modifier: checking whether the process exists without actually sending a signal
kill -0.rationale: No signal is delivered; only tests if the process is running and the user has permission to signal it.

kill -1.translation_modifier: asking the process to reload its configuration or shut down
kill -1.rationale: Same as -HUP; may cause the process to reload settings or terminate.

kill -15.rationale: Asks the process to shut down cleanly; this is the default signal.

kill -2.translation_modifier: sending an interrupt as if the user pressed Control-C
kill -2.rationale: Same as -INT; interrupts the process the same way pressing Control-C would.

kill -3.translation_modifier: requesting termination and a diagnostic snapshot of the process
kill -3.rationale: Same as -QUIT; asks the process to quit and may produce a diagnostic dump.

kill -9.translation_modifier: forcing immediate termination with no chance for the process to clean up
kill -9.rationale: Immediately stops the process without allowing it to save data or release resources.

kill -CONT.rationale: Restarts a suspended process; it simply continues where it left off.

kill -HUP.translation_modifier: asking the process to reload its configuration or shut down
kill -HUP.rationale: May cause the process to reload settings or terminate, depending on the program.

kill -INT.translation_modifier: sending an interrupt as if the user pressed Control-C
kill -INT.rationale: Interrupts the process the same way pressing Control-C would.

kill -KILL.translation_modifier: forcing immediate termination with no chance for the process to clean up
kill -KILL.rationale: Same as -9; immediately stops the process without allowing it to save data or release resources.

kill -QUIT.translation_modifier: requesting termination and a diagnostic snapshot of the process
kill -QUIT.rationale: Asks the process to quit and may produce a diagnostic dump for debugging.

kill -STOP.translation_modifier: pausing the process so it can be resumed later
kill -STOP.rationale: Suspends the process without terminating it; it can be resumed with a continue signal.

kill -TERM.rationale: Same as -15; asks the process to terminate cleanly.

kill -l.translation_modifier: listing all available signal names instead of sending a signal
kill -l.rationale: Read-only operation that prints signal names and exits.

killall -9.translation_modifier: sending immediate termination signal to forcefully terminate all matching processes
killall -9.rationale: Immediately kills all matching processes with no chance for graceful shutdown.

killall -i.translation_modifier: prompting for confirmation before signaling each process

kinit --password-file.translation_modifier: reading the password from a file instead of prompting

kinit -A.translation_modifier: requesting a ticket with no addresses

kinit -R.translation_modifier: renewing an existing ticket instead of obtaining a new one

kinit -S.translation_modifier: requesting a ticket for a specific service instead of the default

kinit -V.rationale: Only increases the amount of output displayed.

kinit -k.translation_modifier: authenticating using a keytab file instead of a password

kinit -l.rationale: Controls how long the ticket remains valid; does not change access scope.

kinit -p.rationale: Allows the ticket to be proxied; does not change what is accessed.

kinit -r.translation_modifier: setting the maximum renewable lifetime for the ticket

kinit -t.translation_modifier: using a specific keytab file for authentication

klist -v.translation_modifier: showing verbose details including encryption types and flags

kswitch -p.translation_modifier: switching to the cache associated with a specific principal

kubectl annotate --all.translation_modifier: on every resource of the specified type in the current isolated group
kubectl annotate --all.rationale: Applies the annotation to all matching resources in the current isolated group.

kubectl annotate --overwrite.rationale: Overwrites current annotations; annotations are generally informational.

kubectl apply --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the apply without actually modifying the cluster
kubectl apply --dry-run.rationale: No resources are changed; only validates the configuration.

kubectl apply --force.translation_modifier: deleting and recreating the resource if it cannot be patched
kubectl apply --force.rationale: Destroys and recreates resources, causing downtime and potential data loss.

kubectl apply --prune.translation_modifier: deleting cluster resources not present in the configuration file
kubectl apply --prune.rationale: Removes resources from the cluster that are not in the applied manifest, which may delete critical workloads.

kubectl apply --recursive.rationale: Applies every manifest found recursively, increasing the scope of changes.

kubectl apply -f.translation_modifier: from a specified file or URL
kubectl apply -f.rationale: Applies whatever configuration is defined in the file.

kubectl cordon --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the operation without actually cordoning the node
kubectl cordon --dry-run.rationale: No changes are made; only shows what would happen.

kubectl create --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the creation without actually submitting it to the cluster
kubectl create --dry-run.rationale: No resources are created; only validates and prints the result.

kubectl create -f.translation_modifier: from a specified file or URL
kubectl create -f.rationale: Creates whatever resources are defined in the file; the user should review the file contents.

kubectl delete --all.translation_modifier: targeting every resource of the specified type in the current isolated group
kubectl delete --all.rationale: Deletes all resources of a type, which can destroy an entire application or environment.

kubectl delete --all-namespaces.translation_modifier: across every isolated group in the cluster
kubectl delete --all-namespaces.rationale: Combined with a resource type, deletes those resources cluster-wide.

kubectl delete --cascade.translation_modifier: controlling whether dependent resources are also deleted
kubectl delete --cascade.rationale: A control parameter that changes cascade behavior; the default (background cascade) is the standard expectation.

kubectl delete --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the deletion without actually removing any resources
kubectl delete --dry-run.rationale: No resources are deleted; only validates the request.

kubectl delete --force.translation_modifier: bypassing graceful deletion and immediately removing the resource
kubectl delete --force.rationale: Skips graceful shutdown, which can cause data corruption in stateful applications.

kubectl delete --grace-period=0.translation_modifier: with no grace period for shutdown
kubectl delete --grace-period=0.rationale: Sets the grace period to zero, but has no additional effect without --force.

kubectl delete -f.translation_modifier: matching the resources defined in a file
kubectl delete -f.rationale: Specifies which resources to delete from a file; the destructive risk is in the base command.

kubectl drain --delete-emptydir-data.translation_modifier: even if pods use emptyDir volumes that will lose their data
kubectl drain --delete-emptydir-data.rationale: Allows eviction of pods with local data stored in emptyDir volumes, causing data loss.

kubectl drain --force.translation_modifier: even if there are unmanaged pods that would be permanently deleted
kubectl drain --force.rationale: Deletes pods not managed by a controller, which cannot be automatically recreated.

kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets.rationale: Allows the drain to proceed past daemonset pods, which will be recreated automatically.

kubectl exec -it.rationale: Allocates a terminal for interactive use; no additional risk beyond the base command.

kubectl get --all-namespaces.translation_modifier: across every isolated group in the cluster
kubectl get --all-namespaces.rationale: Widens the read-only query but does not modify anything.

kubectl get -l.rationale: Narrows the query to matching labels; still read-only.

kubectl get -n.rationale: Narrows the query scope to a single isolated group.

kubectl get -o.translation_modifier: formatted as the specified output type
kubectl get -o.rationale: Changes output format only; no resources are modified.

kubectl get -w.translation_modifier: watching for changes and streaming updates
kubectl get -w.rationale: Follows resource changes in real time; still a read-only operation.

kubectl label --all.translation_modifier: on every resource of the specified type in the current isolated group
kubectl label --all.rationale: Applies the label change to all matching resources, which may affect selectors and routing.

kubectl label --overwrite.rationale: Overwrites current labels, which may break service selectors or scheduling constraints.

kubectl logs --all-containers.translation_modifier: from every container in the pod
kubectl logs --all-containers.rationale: Widens log output to all containers; still read-only.

kubectl logs --previous.translation_modifier: from the previous instance of the container
kubectl logs --previous.rationale: Shows logs from a crashed or restarted container; still read-only.

kubectl logs --tail.translation_modifier: showing only the specified number of most recent lines
kubectl logs --tail.rationale: Limits output to recent lines; read-only operation.

kubectl logs -f.translation_modifier: streaming new log lines as they are produced
kubectl logs -f.rationale: Follows the log stream; still a read-only operation.

kubectl patch --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the patch without actually modifying the resource
kubectl patch --dry-run.rationale: No resources are changed; only validates the patch.

kubectl patch --type.rationale: Controls how the patch is applied; does not add destructive capability.

kubectl replace --force.translation_modifier: deleting and recreating the resource instead of updating it
kubectl replace --force.rationale: Destroys and recreates the resource, causing downtime and potential data loss.

kubectl replace -f.translation_modifier: from a specified file or URL
kubectl replace -f.rationale: Replaces the resource with whatever is defined in the file.

kubectl run --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the creation without actually submitting it to the cluster
kubectl run --dry-run.rationale: No resources are created; only validates and prints the result.

kubectl run --rm.translation_modifier: automatically deleting the pod after it exits
kubectl run --rm.rationale: Cleans up the pod on exit, preventing orphaned resources.

kubectl scale --all.translation_modifier: for every resource of the specified type in the current isolated group
kubectl scale --all.rationale: Scales all matching resources at once, which could cause widespread service disruption.

kubectl scale --replicas.translation_modifier: to the specified number of replicas
kubectl scale --replicas.rationale: Setting replicas to zero effectively shuts down the application.

kubectl taint --all.translation_modifier: on every node in the cluster
kubectl taint --all.rationale: Applies the taint to all nodes, which could make the entire cluster unschedulable for affected pods.

last -d.translation_modifier: showing a snapshot of who was logged in at a specific date and time
last -d.rationale: Only filters the output to a point in time; read-only operation.

latency -p.rationale: Only filters which threads are monitored.

latency -st.translation_modifier: logging events when scheduling latency exceeds a specified threshold in microseconds
latency -st.rationale: Only changes which events are logged; no system modification.

launchctl kickstart -k.translation_modifier: killing the running instance first and then restarting it
launchctl kickstart -k.rationale: Terminates the currently running service process before restarting, which interrupts any work in progress.

launchctl kickstart -p.translation_modifier: printing the process ID of the started service
launchctl kickstart -p.rationale: Only adds informational output; does not change what happens to the service.

launchctl load -F.translation_modifier: forcing the load regardless of the disabled setting
launchctl load -F.rationale: Bypasses the disabled check, which may load a service that was intentionally turned off.

launchctl load -w.translation_modifier: overriding the disabled setting and enabling the service
launchctl load -w.rationale: Forces a previously disabled service to load and persist that change.

launchctl reboot apps.translation_modifier: terminating all user-launched applications without a full reboot
launchctl reboot apps.rationale: Forcefully closes all user applications without prompting to save, risking data loss.

launchctl reboot halt.translation_modifier: shutting the system down completely without restarting
launchctl reboot halt.rationale: Powers off the system entirely, interrupting all processes and unsaved work with no automatic restart.

launchctl reboot logout.translation_modifier: logging out the current user session without a full reboot
launchctl reboot logout.rationale: Forcefully ends the login session without giving applications a chance to save, risking data loss.

launchctl reboot userspace.translation_modifier: restarting only the user-level programs without rebooting the hardware
launchctl reboot userspace.rationale: Tears down and restarts all user-level programs, which may cause data loss in running applications.

launchctl unload -F.translation_modifier: forcing the unload regardless of the disabled setting
launchctl unload -F.rationale: Bypasses the disabled check when unloading the service.

launchctl unload -w.translation_modifier: marking the service as disabled so it will not reload
launchctl unload -w.rationale: Persistently disables the service, preventing it from starting until re-enabled.
