mod-mono-server --root.rationale: Sets the base directory for application paths.

mod-mono-server --terminate.translation_modifier: gracefully stopping a running server instance instead of starting one
mod-mono-server --terminate.rationale: Shuts down a running server, interrupting any active requests.

mongosh --authenticationDatabase.rationale: Selects which database holds the user credentials; does not change what operations can be performed.

mongosh --eval.translation_modifier: executing a specified JavaScript expression and then exiting
mongosh --eval.rationale: Runs arbitrary database commands directly, including destructive operations like drop or deleteMany.

mongosh --file.translation_modifier: executing JavaScript commands from a file and then exiting
mongosh --file.rationale: Runs an entire script that may contain destructive operations and is harder to review at execution time.

mongosh --host.translation_modifier: connecting to a specified database server host
mongosh --host.rationale: Specifies which server to connect to; does not change what operations can be performed.

mongosh --nodb.translation_modifier: starting without connecting to any database
mongosh --nodb.rationale: Launches the shell without a database connection; no data can be modified until a connection is made.

mongosh --password.rationale: Provides authentication credentials for the connection.

mongosh --port.rationale: Specifies which port to connect on; does not change what operations can be performed.

mongosh --quiet.rationale: Suppresses startup messages and connection information; cosmetic only.

mongosh --shell.translation_modifier: entering interactive mode after running a file or eval command
mongosh --shell.rationale: Keeps the session open for interactive use; does not change what commands are available.

mongosh --tls.translation_modifier: connecting over an encrypted TLS connection
mongosh --tls.rationale: Enables transport encryption; does not affect command capabilities.

mongosh --username.rationale: Specifies the authentication identity; the user's permissions determine what operations are allowed.

mono --aot.translation_modifier: compiling the assembly to native code ahead of time
mono --aot.rationale: Produces a native code cache file; does not execute the application.

mono --arch.translation_modifier: using a specific CPU architecture mode
mono --arch.rationale: Selects 32-bit or 64-bit execution mode; no additional risk.

mono --debug.rationale: Enables debug symbols and diagnostics; no additional risk.

mono --gc.translation_modifier: using a specified garbage collector implementation
mono --gc.rationale: Selects the garbage collection engine; no additional risk.

mono --profile.rationale: Collects performance data; no additional risk beyond the base command.

mono-configuration-crypto -c.translation_modifier: creating a new RSA key pair
mono-configuration-crypto -c.rationale: Generates a new key that may replace an existing one in the key store.

mono-configuration-crypto -d.rationale: Restores an encrypted section to plaintext; read-oriented operation.

mono-configuration-crypto -e.rationale: Encrypts a section of the config file, making it unreadable without the key.

mono-configuration-crypto -i.translation_modifier: importing a key from a file into a container
mono-configuration-crypto -i.rationale: Adds or replaces a key in the store from an external file.

mono-configuration-crypto -l.translation_modifier: listing all key container names in the store

mono-configuration-crypto -r.translation_modifier: removing a key container from the store
mono-configuration-crypto -r.rationale: Deletes a cryptographic key; encrypted configuration sections become unreadable without the key.

mono-configuration-crypto -x.translation_modifier: exporting a key from a container to a file
mono-configuration-crypto -x.rationale: Writes a cryptographic key to a file, which could expose it.

mono-service --no-daemon.translation_modifier: in the foreground without running as a background service
mono-service --no-daemon.rationale: Prevents backgrounding and keeps the terminal attached; useful for debugging.

mono-service -d.rationale: Sets the working directory for the service; no additional risk.

mono-service -l.translation_modifier: using a specified lock file path
mono-service -l.rationale: Changes the lock file location; no additional risk.

mono-xmltool --prettyprint.translation_modifier: reformatting the XML with standard indentation
mono-xmltool --prettyprint.rationale: Reformats XML output; the source file is not modified unless explicitly overwritten.

mono-xmltool --transform.translation_modifier: applying a transformation stylesheet to produce transformed output
mono-xmltool --transform.rationale: Produces transformed output; the source file is not modified.

mono-xmltool --validate.translation_modifier: validating an XML instance against a schema or grammar
mono-xmltool --validate.rationale: Read-only schema validation; no files are modified.

monodis --output.translation_modifier: writing output to a specified file instead of standard output
monodis --output.rationale: Changes output destination; still a read-only operation on the input assembly.

monodocer --delete.translation_modifier: deleting documentation entries for members that no longer exist in the assembly
monodocer --delete.rationale: Removes XML documentation files for removed members, which may discard manually written content.

monodocer --preserve.translation_modifier: marking removed members as preserved instead of deleting them
monodocer --preserve.rationale: Prevents deletion of documentation for removed members.

monodocer -o.translation_modifier: writing to a specified output directory
monodocer -o.rationale: Sets the documentation output directory; no additional risk.

monodocs2html --force-update.translation_modifier: regenerating all files regardless of modification dates
monodocs2html --force-update.rationale: Overwrites existing output files unconditionally; source documentation is not affected.

monodocs2html -o.translation_modifier: writing output to a specified directory
monodocs2html -o.rationale: Sets the output directory; no additional risk.

monolinker -c.translation_modifier: with a specified action for core assemblies
monolinker -c.rationale: Controls whether core assemblies are skipped, copied, or linked; linking may remove needed code.

monolinker -o.translation_modifier: writing output to a specified directory
monolinker -o.rationale: Sets the output directory; defaults to 'output' to avoid overwriting originals.

monop --refs.translation_modifier: listing the referenced assemblies instead of type members

monop -d.translation_modifier: showing only members declared in the type itself
monop -d.rationale: Filters output to exclude inherited members; still read-only.

monop -p.rationale: Shows additional member details; still read-only.

monop -s.rationale: Broadens the type search; still read-only.

more +F.translation_modifier: following the end of the file in real time as new content is added
more +F.rationale: Continuously watches for new data appended to the file; read-only monitoring.

more -F.translation_modifier: exiting immediately if the entire file fits on one screen
more -F.rationale: Skips the pager entirely for short files; read-only convenience behavior.

more -N.translation_modifier: showing line numbers at the start of each line
more -N.rationale: Adds line numbers to the display; purely cosmetic and changes nothing on disk.

more -S.translation_modifier: cutting off long lines at the screen edge instead of wrapping them
more -S.rationale: Changes how long lines are displayed; does not modify the file.

more -i.translation_modifier: ignoring upper and lower case differences when searching
more -i.rationale: Makes text searches case-insensitive; read-only behavior change.

more -n.translation_modifier: hiding line numbers from prompts and status messages
more -n.rationale: Suppresses line number information in the display; purely cosmetic.

more -s.translation_modifier: collapsing multiple blank lines into a single blank line
more -s.rationale: Compresses consecutive blank lines in the display; does not alter the file.

mount -a.translation_modifier: attaching all volumes listed in the system's volume table
mount -a.rationale: Mounts multiple volumes at once, increasing the scope of changes to the directory tree.

mount -d.translation_modifier: simulating the attach without actually performing it
mount -d.rationale: Dry run that does everything except the actual attach operation.

mount -f.translation_modifier: forcibly revoking write access when switching a volume to read-only
mount -f.rationale: Forces removal of write access, which can interrupt programs that have open files.

mount -k.translation_modifier: without following shortcuts in the target directory path
mount -k.rationale: Prevents shortcut traversal during the mount; a minor safety measure.

mount -o.translation_modifier: with specified options controlling access and behavior
mount -o.rationale: Passes additional options that can change permissions, caching, and access rules on the volume.

mount -r.translation_modifier: as read-only, preventing any changes to the volume's contents
mount -r.rationale: Restricts access to read-only, which reduces risk compared to the default.

mount -t.rationale: Filters or specifies the volume type; does not add risk by itself.

mount -u.translation_modifier: updating the options of an already attached volume
mount -u.rationale: Changes settings on a live volume, which could affect running programs.

mount -v.translation_modifier: showing detailed information about what is being done
mount -v.rationale: Increases output verbosity; does not change what is mounted.

mount -w.translation_modifier: as read-write, allowing changes to the volume's contents
mount -w.rationale: Allows writing to the mounted volume.

mount_9p -r.rationale: Restricts the mount to read-only access.

mount_afp -i.rationale: Requests a password at runtime instead of embedding it in the URL.

mount_afp -k.translation_modifier: as a hard mount that retries persistently on network errors
mount_afp -k.rationale: Keeps retrying on errors, which may cause processes to hang indefinitely.

mount_afp -s.translation_modifier: as a soft mount that times out on network errors
mount_afp -s.rationale: Allows the mount to fail gracefully on network problems instead of hanging.

mount_apfs -s.translation_modifier: mounting a specific snapshot of the volume as read-only
mount_apfs -s.rationale: Mounts a point-in-time snapshot; read-only and does not affect the live volume.

mount_nfs -o bg.translation_modifier: retrying the mount in the background if the initial attempt fails
mount_nfs -o bg.rationale: Moves retry logic to a background process; useful for non-critical mounts at boot.

mount_smbfs -N.rationale: Skips the password prompt; credentials must be provided another way.

mozroots --import.translation_modifier: importing the certificates into the trust store
mozroots --import.rationale: Adds certificates to the trust store, changing which servers are trusted.

mozroots --machine.translation_modifier: in the machine-wide trust store instead of the user store
mozroots --machine.rationale: Modifies the machine-wide trust store, affecting TLS validation for all users on the system.

mozroots --sync.translation_modifier: synchronizing the trust store by adding and removing certificates to match Mozilla's list
mozroots --sync.rationale: Removes previously trusted certificates, which may break TLS connections to servers that relied on those roots.

mpioutil modify path --disable.rationale: Reduces path redundancy, which may cause I/O failures if other paths are unavailable.

mpioutil modify path --enable.rationale: Restores a previously disabled path, increasing redundancy.

msbuild -property.rationale: Sets build properties; affects only the build output.

msbuild -restore.rationale: Downloads dependencies from configured package sources.

msbuild -target.rationale: Narrows the build scope; no additional risk.

msgattrib --clear-fuzzy.translation_modifier: clearing the fuzzy flag from all messages
msgattrib --clear-fuzzy.rationale: Changes translation status flags in the output; no system-level risk.

msgattrib --force.rationale: Bypasses the overwrite prompt, silently replacing existing output files.

msgattrib --only-fuzzy.rationale: Filters the output; no system-level risk.

msgattrib --set-fuzzy.rationale: Changes translation status flags in the output; no system-level risk.

msgcat --force.rationale: Bypasses the overwrite prompt, silently replacing existing output files.

msgcomm --force.rationale: Bypasses the overwrite prompt, silently replacing existing output files.

msgconv --force.rationale: Bypasses the overwrite prompt, silently replacing existing output files.

msgen --force.rationale: Bypasses the overwrite prompt, silently replacing existing output files.

msgfilter --force.rationale: Bypasses the overwrite prompt, silently replacing existing output files.

msgfmt --check.translation_modifier: performing additional validation checks on the input
msgfmt --check.rationale: Adds stricter validation; still produces the same output.

msgfmt --statistics.rationale: Adds summary output; no additional risk.

msggrep --force.rationale: Bypasses the overwrite prompt, silently replacing existing output files.

msgmerge --force.rationale: Bypasses the overwrite prompt, silently replacing existing output files.

msgmerge -U.translation_modifier: updating the translation file in place
msgmerge -U.rationale: Modifies the existing PO file directly, which could discard translations if the template has changed significantly.

msgpre --force.rationale: Bypasses the overwrite prompt, silently replacing existing output files.

msgunfmt --force.rationale: Bypasses the overwrite prompt, silently replacing existing output files.

msguniq --force.rationale: Bypasses the overwrite prompt, silently replacing existing output files.

mtree -K.translation_modifier: adding specified keywords to the set of attributes checked
mtree -K.rationale: Expands which file attributes are compared; no data modification.

mtree -L.rationale: Changes how links are handled during comparison or specification generation.

mtree -U.translation_modifier: updating file ownership, permissions, and timestamps to match the specification
mtree -U.rationale: Modifies file metadata and creates missing directories to match the specification.

mtree -X.translation_modifier: excluding files matching patterns in a specified file
mtree -X.rationale: Narrows scope by skipping matched files.

mtree -c.translation_modifier: generating a specification from the directory hierarchy instead of comparing
mtree -c.rationale: Read-only operation that outputs a specification to the terminal.

mtree -d.rationale: Narrows scope to only directory entries.

mtree -e.translation_modifier: without complaining about files present on disk but missing from the specification
mtree -e.rationale: Suppresses warnings about extra files; no data modification.

mtree -f.translation_modifier: reading the specification from a specified file instead of the terminal
mtree -f.rationale: Only changes where the specification is read from.

mtree -i.translation_modifier: indenting the output by directory depth

mtree -k.translation_modifier: checking only the specified keywords instead of all default attributes
mtree -k.rationale: Changes which attributes are compared; no data modification.

mtree -p.translation_modifier: rooted at a specified directory path
mtree -p.rationale: Changes the target directory; no additional risk.

mtree -r.translation_modifier: removing files not described in the specification
mtree -r.rationale: Deletes files that are not listed in the specification, which may cause data loss.

mtree -u.translation_modifier: updating file attributes to match the specification and reporting mismatches as errors
mtree -u.rationale: Same as -U but returns an error status if the hierarchy did not match.

mtree -x.translation_modifier: without descending into other mounted filesystems
mtree -x.rationale: Restricts scope to a single filesystem; reduces what is processed.

mv -f.rationale: Suppresses confirmation prompts, allowing silent overwrite of destination files.

mv -h.translation_modifier: without following symbolic links at the destination
mv -h.rationale: Renames the symbolic link itself instead of moving the file into the linked directory.

mv -i.rationale: Adds an interactive confirmation step, reducing the risk of accidental overwrite.

mv -v.translation_modifier: showing each file as it is moved
mv -v.rationale: Adds verbose output without changing what is moved.

mysql --batch.translation_modifier: formatting output for non-interactive use without column borders
mysql --batch.rationale: Changes output formatting only; does not affect what queries are executed.

mysql --force.translation_modifier: continuing execution even after SQL errors
mysql --force.rationale: Suppresses error-based stopping, which may allow partially destructive scripts to continue.

mysql --local-infile.translation_modifier: allowing the database to import data directly from files on the client machine
mysql --local-infile.rationale: Enables reading arbitrary files from the client filesystem into the database, which may expose sensitive data.

mysql --safe-updates.translation_modifier: blocking bulk update and delete statements that lack a filter condition
mysql --safe-updates.rationale: Prevents accidental bulk modifications; a safety-enhancing option.

mysql --skip-column-names.rationale: Changes output formatting only; omits column headers from query results.

mysql --ssl-mode.translation_modifier: using a specified SSL encryption mode for the connection
mysql --ssl-mode.rationale: Controls connection encryption; does not affect query capabilities.

mysql -D.rationale: Selects which database to operate on; does not change what operations can be performed.

mysql -P.translation_modifier: connecting on a specified TCP port
mysql -P.rationale: Specifies which port to connect on; does not change what operations can be performed.

mysql -e.translation_modifier: executing a single SQL statement and then exiting
mysql -e.rationale: Runs arbitrary SQL directly, including destructive statements like DROP or DELETE, without an interactive session.

mysql -h.translation_modifier: connecting to a specified database server host
mysql -h.rationale: Specifies which server to connect to; does not change what operations can be performed.

mysql -p.translation_modifier: prompting for a password before connecting
mysql -p.rationale: Adds an explicit authentication step before connecting.

mysql -u.translation_modifier: connecting as a specified database user
mysql -u.rationale: Specifies the authentication identity; does not change what operations are available.

nano -B.translation_modifier: creating a backup of the file before saving changes
nano -B.rationale: Preserves the original file as a backup; a safety-enhancing option.

nano -v.translation_modifier: opening the file in read-only view mode
nano -v.rationale: Prevents any modifications to the file.

nbdst --preallocate.translation_modifier: pre-allocating the shadow file to a specified size
nbdst --preallocate.rationale: Allocates disk space and resets the shadow file.

nbdst --recycle.translation_modifier: resetting and reusing an existing shadow file
nbdst --recycle.rationale: Discards previously written data in the shadow file.

nc -4.rationale: Restricts the network protocol; does not change connection capabilities.

nc -6.rationale: Restricts the network protocol; does not change connection capabilities.

nc -X.translation_modifier: connecting through a proxy using a specified protocol
nc -X.rationale: Routes the connection through a proxy; does not add destructive capability.

nc -d.rationale: Disables input; useful for background connections.

nc -k.translation_modifier: continuing to listen for additional connections after the current one closes
nc -k.rationale: Keeps the listening port open indefinitely, which may expose the port longer than intended.

nc -l.translation_modifier: listening for incoming connections instead of initiating one
nc -l.rationale: Opens a listening port that accepts connections from other hosts.

nc -n.translation_modifier: without resolving hostnames or service names
nc -n.rationale: Skips DNS lookups; does not change the connection's capabilities.

nc -p.rationale: Sets the local port number; does not add destructive capability.

nc -u.rationale: Switches the transport protocol; does not change the connection's capabilities.

nc -v.rationale: Increases output verbosity; does not change behavior.

nc -w.translation_modifier: closing the connection after a specified number of idle seconds
nc -w.rationale: Limits connection duration; a scope-reducing option.

nc -x.translation_modifier: connecting through a specified proxy server
nc -x.rationale: Specifies the proxy address; does not add destructive capability.

nc -z.translation_modifier: scanning for open ports without sending data
nc -z.rationale: Only checks if a port is open; no data is transmitted.

ndp -a.translation_modifier: displaying all current NDP cache entries
ndp -a.rationale: Read-only listing of the neighbor cache.

ndp -c.rationale: Clears the neighbor cache, temporarily disrupting IPv6 connectivity until entries are re-learned.

ndp -d.translation_modifier: deleting a specific NDP cache entry
ndp -d.rationale: Removes a single neighbor entry, which may briefly disrupt connectivity to that host.

ndp -r.rationale: Read-only display of IPv6 default routers.

ndp -s.translation_modifier: adding a static NDP entry for a host
ndp -s.rationale: Adds a permanent neighbor mapping, which could misdirect traffic if set incorrectly.

net-snmp-cert --force.rationale: Replaces existing SNMP certificates; may disrupt monitoring until reconfigured.

net-snmp-create-v3-user -ro.rationale: Restricts the new user to read-only access, limiting potential impact.

netstat -L.translation_modifier: showing the size of connection listen queues

netstat -W.rationale: Only changes output formatting; still read-only.

netstat -a.rationale: Shows additional connection information; still read-only.

netstat -b.translation_modifier: showing byte counts for each interface
netstat -b.rationale: Adds byte count information to the display; still read-only.

netstat -f.translation_modifier: limited to a specific address family
netstat -f.rationale: Filters output to one address family; still read-only.

netstat -l.translation_modifier: showing full IPv6 addresses without truncation
netstat -l.rationale: Only changes address display format; still read-only.

netstat -m.rationale: Read-only display of memory management information.

netstat -n.translation_modifier: showing addresses as numbers instead of resolving hostnames

netstat -p.translation_modifier: limited to a specific network protocol
netstat -p.rationale: Filters output to one protocol; still read-only.

netstat -w.translation_modifier: refreshing the display at a specified interval in seconds
netstat -w.rationale: Continuously displays updated statistics; still read-only.

nettop -m.translation_modifier: monitoring only a specific protocol type
nettop -m.rationale: Filters the display to a specific protocol; still read-only.

nettop -p.rationale: Filters the display to a specific process; still read-only.

networkQuality -I.translation_modifier: testing on a specific network interface
networkQuality -I.rationale: Binds the test to a specific interface; no additional risk.

networkQuality -d.rationale: Reduces the scope of testing; no additional risk.

networkQuality -s.translation_modifier: running upload and download tests sequentially instead of in parallel
networkQuality -s.rationale: Changes test methodology; no additional risk.

networkQuality -u.rationale: Reduces the scope of testing; no additional risk.

networksetup -addpreferredwirelessnetwor.translation_modifier: adding a Wi-Fi network to the saved networks list
networksetup -addpreferredwirelessnetwor.rationale: Adds a network to the preferred list without changing the current connection.

networksetup -createlocation.translation_modifier: creating a new network location profile
networksetup -createlocation.rationale: Adds a new location without affecting the current configuration.

networksetup -createnetworkservice.translation_modifier: creating a new network service on a hardware port
networksetup -createnetworkservice.rationale: Adds a new service without affecting existing configurations.

networksetup -deletelocation.rationale: Removes a saved network configuration; cannot be recovered without manual recreation.

networksetup -detectnewhardware.translation_modifier: scanning for new network hardware and creating default services for it
networksetup -detectnewhardware.rationale: Creates new network service configurations for detected hardware.

networksetup -getMTU.translation_modifier: displaying the maximum packet size for a hardware port
networksetup -getMTU.rationale: Read-only display of the maximum packet size value.

networksetup -getairportnetwork.translation_modifier: displaying the currently connected Wi-Fi network
networksetup -getairportnetwork.rationale: Read-only display of the current Wi-Fi network name.

networksetup -getairportpower.translation_modifier: displaying whether Wi-Fi is on or off
networksetup -getairportpower.rationale: Read-only display of Wi-Fi power state.

networksetup -getcomputername.rationale: Read-only display of the computer name.

networksetup -getcurrentlocation.translation_modifier: displaying the name of the active network location profile
networksetup -getcurrentlocation.rationale: Read-only display of the current location.

networksetup -getdnsservers.translation_modifier: displaying the DNS servers for a service
networksetup -getdnsservers.rationale: Read-only display of configured DNS servers.

networksetup -getinfo.translation_modifier: displaying the current network configuration for a service
networksetup -getinfo.rationale: Read-only display of IP address, subnet, router, and DNS information.

networksetup -getmacaddress.translation_modifier: displaying the hardware address for a specific port or device
networksetup -getmacaddress.rationale: Read-only display of the hardware address.

networksetup -getnetworkserviceenabled.translation_modifier: displaying whether a network service is enabled or disabled

networksetup -getsearchdomains.translation_modifier: displaying the search domains for a service
networksetup -getsearchdomains.rationale: Read-only display of configured search domains.

networksetup -getwebproxy.translation_modifier: displaying the web proxy settings for a service

networksetup -help.translation_modifier: displaying usage information for all available commands

networksetup -listallhardwareports.translation_modifier: listing all hardware ports with their device names and addresses
networksetup -listallhardwareports.rationale: Read-only listing of hardware port details.

networksetup -listallnetworkservices.translation_modifier: listing all network services on the system
networksetup -listallnetworkservices.rationale: Read-only listing of configured network services.

networksetup -listnetworkserviceorder.translation_modifier: listing all network services in their priority order
networksetup -listnetworkserviceorder.rationale: Read-only listing of service order with port and device details.

networksetup -listpreferredwirelessnetwo.translation_modifier: listing all saved Wi-Fi networks for a device
networksetup -listpreferredwirelessnetwo.rationale: Read-only listing of remembered wireless networks.

networksetup -ordernetworkservices.translation_modifier: changing the priority order in which network services are used
networksetup -ordernetworkservices.rationale: Reordering services changes which connection the system prefers, affecting routing.

networksetup -printcommands.translation_modifier: listing all available commands without descriptions

networksetup -removeallpreferredwireless.translation_modifier: removing all saved Wi-Fi networks from a device
networksetup -removeallpreferredwireless.rationale: Deletes all remembered wireless networks, requiring manual reconnection to each.

networksetup -removenetworkservice.translation_modifier: removing a network service from the system configuration
networksetup -removenetworkservice.rationale: Deletes a network service configuration, which can permanently disrupt connectivity for that interface.

networksetup -removepreferredwirelessnet.translation_modifier: removing a Wi-Fi network from the saved networks list
networksetup -removepreferredwirelessnet.rationale: Removes one remembered network; the device can still reconnect manually.

networksetup -setMTU.translation_modifier: setting the maximum packet size for a hardware port
networksetup -setMTU.rationale: An incorrect maximum packet size value can cause network communication failures.

networksetup -setairportnetwork.translation_modifier: connecting to a specified Wi-Fi network
networksetup -setairportnetwork.rationale: Switches the Wi-Fi connection to a different network.

networksetup -setairportpower.translation_modifier: turning Wi-Fi on or off for a specific device
networksetup -setairportpower.rationale: Disabling Wi-Fi immediately drops the wireless connection.

networksetup -setbootp.translation_modifier: switching to the bootstrap protocol for automatic IP configuration
networksetup -setbootp.rationale: Changes the IP configuration method, which may disrupt connectivity.

networksetup -setcomputername.rationale: Changes the visible hostname; does not affect connectivity.

networksetup -setdhcp.translation_modifier: switching to automatic IP configuration using DHCP
networksetup -setdhcp.rationale: Changes the IP configuration method; the assigned address may differ from the previous one.

networksetup -setdnsservers.translation_modifier: setting the DNS servers for a service
networksetup -setdnsservers.rationale: Changes DNS resolution, which affects how all applications resolve hostnames.

networksetup -setmanual.translation_modifier: setting a manual IP address, subnet mask, and router
networksetup -setmanual.rationale: Changes the IP configuration, which can disrupt network connectivity if set incorrectly.

networksetup -setnetworkserviceenabled.translation_modifier: enabling or disabling a network service
networksetup -setnetworkserviceenabled.rationale: Disabling a service stops all connectivity through that interface.

networksetup -setproxyautodiscovery.translation_modifier: turning automatic proxy discovery on or off for a service
networksetup -setproxyautodiscovery.rationale: Only toggles whether the system looks for proxy configuration automatically.

networksetup -setsearchdomains.translation_modifier: setting the search domains for a service
networksetup -setsearchdomains.rationale: Changes which domains are automatically searched during name resolution.

networksetup -setsecurewebproxy.translation_modifier: configuring a secure web proxy for a service
networksetup -setsecurewebproxy.rationale: Routes all HTTPS traffic through a proxy, which could expose data or block access if misconfigured.

networksetup -setsocksfirewallproxy.translation_modifier: configuring a network relay proxy for a service
networksetup -setsocksfirewallproxy.rationale: Routes traffic through a network relay proxy, which could expose data or block access if misconfigured.

networksetup -setv4off.translation_modifier: turning off IPv4 for a network service
networksetup -setv4off.rationale: Disabling IPv4 can immediately break network connectivity for the service.

networksetup -setv6automatic.translation_modifier: setting IPv6 to configure itself automatically
networksetup -setv6automatic.rationale: Enables automatic IPv6 configuration, which is the standard default.

networksetup -setv6off.translation_modifier: turning off IPv6 for a network service
networksetup -setv6off.rationale: Disabling IPv6 may break connectivity to IPv6-only resources.

networksetup -setwebproxy.translation_modifier: configuring a web proxy for a service
networksetup -setwebproxy.rationale: Routes all HTTP traffic through a proxy, which could expose data or block access if misconfigured.

networksetup -setwebproxystate.translation_modifier: turning the web proxy on or off for a service
networksetup -setwebproxystate.rationale: Enabling or disabling the proxy changes how HTTP traffic is routed.

networksetup -switchtolocation.translation_modifier: switching to a different network location profile
networksetup -switchtolocation.rationale: Changes all network settings at once by switching to a different location.

newfs_apfs -A.translation_modifier: adding a volume to an existing container instead of creating a new one
newfs_apfs -A.rationale: Non-destructively adds a volume; existing data in the container is preserved.

newfs_apfs -C.translation_modifier: creating a container only, with no volumes
newfs_apfs -C.rationale: Formats the device as an empty container, destroying existing data.

newfs_apfs -E.rationale: Enables volume encryption; losing the key makes data unrecoverable.

newfs_apfs -v.rationale: Sets the volume label; no additional risk.

newfs_exfat -N.translation_modifier: only printing parameters without actually creating the filesystem
newfs_exfat -N.rationale: Dry run that does not modify the device.

newfs_hfs -J.rationale: Enables journaling for crash recovery; no additional risk beyond the base command.

newfs_hfs -N.translation_modifier: only printing parameters without actually creating the filesystem
newfs_hfs -N.rationale: Dry run that does not modify the device.

newfs_hfs -b.translation_modifier: with a specified allocation block size
newfs_hfs -b.rationale: Sets the block size for the new filesystem; no additional risk beyond the base command.

newfs_hfs -s.rationale: Changes filename comparison behavior; no additional risk beyond the base command.

newfs_hfs -v.rationale: Only sets the display name of the new volume; no additional risk.

newfs_msdos -F.rationale: Selects FAT12, FAT16, or FAT32; no additional risk beyond the base command.

newfs_msdos -N.translation_modifier: only printing parameters without actually creating the filesystem
newfs_msdos -N.rationale: Dry run that does not modify the device.

newsyslog -n.translation_modifier: only printing what would be done without actually rotating any logs
newsyslog -n.rationale: Dry run that does not modify any log files.

nfsstat -z.rationale: Resets NFS statistics, losing historical performance data.

nice -n.rationale: Sets the priority offset; negative values require root privileges.

nl -b.translation_modifier: selecting which lines to number based on a type rule
nl -b.rationale: Controls which body lines get numbered; no destructive action.

nl -i.translation_modifier: incrementing line numbers by a specified value
nl -i.rationale: Only changes the numbering increment; no destructive action.

nl -n.translation_modifier: using a specified number format such as left-justified, right-justified, or zero-padded
nl -n.rationale: Only changes the formatting of line numbers.

nl -p.translation_modifier: without restarting numbering at logical page boundaries
nl -p.rationale: Only affects numbering continuity across pages; no destructive action.

nl -s.translation_modifier: using a custom separator between line numbers and text
nl -s.rationale: Only changes the delimiter character; no destructive action.

nl -v.translation_modifier: starting numbering at a specified value
nl -v.rationale: Only changes the initial line number; no destructive action.

nl -w.translation_modifier: using a specified width for line numbers
nl -w.rationale: Only changes the column width of line numbers.

nm -A.translation_modifier: prefixing each line with the file name
nm -A.rationale: Adds file identification to each output line; still read-only.

nm -U.translation_modifier: hiding names that are referenced but not defined in this file
nm -U.rationale: Filters out undefined references; still read-only.

nm -a.translation_modifier: including all entries, even those used only for debugging

nm -g.translation_modifier: showing only names that are visible to other programs
nm -g.rationale: Filters output to externally accessible names; still read-only.

nm -j.translation_modifier: showing only the names without addresses or types

nm -m.translation_modifier: showing detailed information about where each name is stored
nm -m.rationale: Provides more descriptive output about each entry; still read-only.

nm -n.translation_modifier: sorted by memory address instead of alphabetically

nm -p.translation_modifier: without sorting, preserving the original order

nm -r.rationale: Reverses the sort direction; still read-only.

nm -u.translation_modifier: showing only names that are referenced but not defined in this file
nm -u.rationale: Filters output to missing dependencies; still read-only.

nm -x.translation_modifier: displaying all values in hexadecimal format
nm -x.rationale: Changes number display format; still read-only.

node --abort-on-uncaught-exception.translation_modifier: crashing with a core dump on unhandled errors instead of exiting gracefully
node --abort-on-uncaught-exception.rationale: Changes error handling behavior; may produce a core dump file but does not affect normal execution.

node --allow-child-process.translation_modifier: allowing the script to spawn child processes under the permission model
node --allow-child-process.rationale: Permits spawning subprocesses, which could execute arbitrary commands.

node --allow-fs-read.translation_modifier: granting read access to specified filesystem paths under the permission model
node --allow-fs-read.rationale: Opens a specific read permission; still more restrictive than default unrestricted mode.

node --allow-fs-write.translation_modifier: granting write access to specified filesystem paths under the permission model
node --allow-fs-write.rationale: Opens write permission to specific paths; less restrictive than blocking all writes.

node --check.translation_modifier: only checking the script for syntax errors without executing it
node --check.rationale: Validates syntax without running the code; no side effects.

node --disallow-code-generation-from-str.translation_modifier: preventing the use of eval and similar dynamic code execution
node --disallow-code-generation-from-str.rationale: Restricts dynamic code execution; a safety-enhancing option.

node --experimental-permission.translation_modifier: enabling the permission model to restrict filesystem and child process access
node --experimental-permission.rationale: Adds security restrictions; a safety-enhancing option.

node --import.translation_modifier: preloading an ES module before the main script runs
node --import.rationale: Loads and executes an ES module before the main script; the preloaded module may have side effects.

node --input-type.translation_modifier: treating the input as a specific module type
node --input-type.rationale: Changes how the input is parsed; does not affect what code is executed.

node --inspect.translation_modifier: enabling the debugger on the default port
node --inspect.rationale: Opens a debug port for local inspection; does not change program behavior.

node --inspect-brk.translation_modifier: enabling the debugger and pausing before the first line executes
node --inspect-brk.rationale: Opens a debug port and pauses execution; does not change program behavior.

node --max-old-space-size.translation_modifier: setting the maximum memory available for the JavaScript heap in megabytes
node --max-old-space-size.rationale: Adjusts a resource limit; does not change what code is executed.

node --require.translation_modifier: preloading a specified module before the main script runs
node --require.rationale: Loads and executes a module before the main script; the preloaded module may have side effects.

node -e.translation_modifier: evaluating a string of JavaScript passed as an argument
node -e.rationale: Runs inline code directly; the risk depends on what the code does.

node -p.translation_modifier: evaluating a JavaScript expression and printing the result
node -p.rationale: Executes inline code and outputs the return value; same risk as -e.

notarytool -v.rationale: Only increases the amount of output displayed.

notarytool store-credentials --no-valida.translation_modifier: saving credentials without verifying them first
notarytool store-credentials --no-valida.rationale: Skips the validation step; credentials may turn out to be invalid.

notarytool store-credentials --sync.translation_modifier: making the credentials available across devices via iCloud Keychain
notarytool store-credentials --sync.rationale: Syncs credentials to other devices; removable from iCloud Keychain.

notarytool store-credentials --validate.translation_modifier: verifying the credentials are valid before saving them
notarytool store-credentials --validate.rationale: Tests credentials against the server before storing; a safety check.

notarytool submit --apple-id.rationale: Specifies the Apple ID for authentication.

notarytool submit --force.translation_modifier: uploading even if pre-flight validation finds problems
notarytool submit --force.rationale: Bypasses local validation checks; the submission may be rejected by Apple.

notarytool submit --no-s3-acceleration.rationale: Uses standard upload speed; may help with connectivity issues.

notarytool submit --team-id.translation_modifier: specifying the developer team to use
notarytool submit --team-id.rationale: Selects which team to submit under; required for multi-team accounts.

notarytool submit --timeout.translation_modifier: exiting after a specified duration if the submission has not completed
notarytool submit --timeout.rationale: Limits how long the tool waits; the submission continues processing on Apple's servers.

notarytool submit --wait.translation_modifier: waiting for the submission to complete before exiting
notarytool submit --wait.rationale: Blocks until processing is done; does not change the submission.

notarytool submit -k.translation_modifier: authenticating using an App Store Connect API key file
notarytool submit -k.rationale: Specifies the private key for API authentication.

notarytool submit -p.translation_modifier: authenticating using credentials stored in the Keychain
notarytool submit -p.rationale: Uses previously saved credentials; does not expose secrets on the command line.

notifyutil -g.translation_modifier: getting the current state value for a specified key
notifyutil -g.rationale: Read-only retrieval of a notification state value.

notifyutil -p.translation_modifier: posting a notification for a specified key
notifyutil -p.rationale: Sends a notification event; may trigger registered listeners.

notifyutil -s.translation_modifier: setting the state value for a specified key
notifyutil -s.rationale: Sets a notification state value; only affects the notification system, not files or services.

notifyutil -w.translation_modifier: waiting and watching for notifications on a specified key

npm audit fix --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the fixes without actually modifying any packages
npm audit fix --dry-run.rationale: Shows what would be fixed without making changes.

npm audit fix --force.translation_modifier: installing semver-major updates to fix vulnerabilities
npm audit fix --force.rationale: Upgrades dependencies across major versions, which may introduce breaking API changes.

npm cache clean --force.translation_modifier: proceeding even though the cache is self-healing
npm cache clean --force.rationale: Required for cache clean to execute; npm will re-download packages as needed.

npm ci --ignore-scripts.translation_modifier: skipping all pre- and post-install scripts
npm ci --ignore-scripts.rationale: Prevents execution of lifecycle scripts, reducing the risk of arbitrary code execution during installation.

npm config set -g.rationale: Changes npm settings for all projects on the machine, not just the current project.

npm install --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the installation without making any changes
npm install --dry-run.rationale: Reports what would be installed without downloading or writing any files.

npm install --force.translation_modifier: bypassing cache and overwriting existing packages
npm install --force.rationale: Ignores cache and allows incompatible dependency resolution, but the result is a local node_modules change recoverable with npm ci.

npm install --ignore-scripts.translation_modifier: skipping all pre- and post-install scripts
npm install --ignore-scripts.rationale: Prevents execution of lifecycle scripts, reducing the risk of arbitrary code execution during installation.

npm install --legacy-peer-deps.rationale: Skips peer dependency checks, which may result in incompatible package combinations at runtime.

npm install --production.rationale: Installs only production dependencies; reduces the installed package set.

npm install --save-dev.translation_modifier: adding the package as a development-only dependency
npm install --save-dev.rationale: Records the package under devDependencies in package.json; does not change installation behavior.

npm install --save-exact.translation_modifier: pinning the exact version number instead of a semver range
npm install --save-exact.rationale: Records the precise version in package.json; reduces update flexibility but increases reproducibility.

npm install -g.translation_modifier: installing globally for all projects on this machine
npm install -g.rationale: Modifies the system-wide package directory, which can affect all Node.js projects.

npm publish --access.translation_modifier: setting the package visibility on the registry
npm publish --access.rationale: Controls whether the package is public or restricted; public packages are visible to everyone.

npm publish --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the publish without uploading to the registry
npm publish --dry-run.rationale: Shows what would be published without actually uploading the package.

npm publish --tag.translation_modifier: publishing under a specific distribution tag instead of latest
npm publish --tag.rationale: Controls which tag the version is published under; using 'latest' by mistake can affect all users.

npm uninstall -g.translation_modifier: removing the package from the global installation
npm uninstall -g.rationale: Modifies the system-wide package directory, which can affect all Node.js projects.

npm unpublish --force.translation_modifier: removing the package even outside the standard safety period
npm unpublish --force.rationale: Bypasses npm's safety restrictions on unpublishing, enabling removal of packages that others may depend on.

npm update --save.translation_modifier: updating the version ranges in package.json to match
npm update --save.rationale: Modifies package.json version constraints, which affects future installs.

npm update -g.rationale: Modifies the system-wide package directory, which can affect all Node.js projects.

npm version --no-git-tag-version.translation_modifier: without creating a git commit or tag
npm version --no-git-tag-version.rationale: Only updates version in package.json without git operations.

npx --no.translation_modifier: refusing to download packages that are not already installed locally
npx --no.rationale: Prevents fetching remote packages, limiting execution to locally installed binaries only.

npx --package.translation_modifier: using a specific package instead of inferring it from the command name
npx --package.rationale: Explicitly specifies which package to use; does not change the execution model.

npx --workspaces.translation_modifier: running the command in every workspace in the project
npx --workspaces.rationale: Executes the command across all workspaces, increasing the scope of any side effects.

npx --yes.translation_modifier: without prompting for confirmation before downloading packages
npx --yes.rationale: Skips the confirmation prompt, allowing automatic download and execution of remote code.

npx -c.translation_modifier: running a shell command string in the package environment
npx -c.rationale: Executes an arbitrary shell command with the package binaries available on the PATH.

npx -w.translation_modifier: running the command in the context of a specific workspace
npx -w.rationale: Scopes execution to a named workspace; does not change the execution model.

nscurl --ats-diagnostics.translation_modifier: running App Transport Security diagnostic checks against the URL
nscurl --ats-diagnostics.rationale: Read-only diagnostic that tests TLS configuration; does not transfer data.

nscurl -o.translation_modifier: writing the response to a specified file
nscurl -o.rationale: Saves output to a file; the specified file will be overwritten if it exists.

nslookup -debug.translation_modifier: showing detailed information about the query and response
nslookup -debug.rationale: Increases output verbosity for troubleshooting; still read-only.

nslookup -port.translation_modifier: connecting to the name server on a specified port number
nslookup -port.rationale: Changes which port to use for the query; still read-only.

nslookup -query.translation_modifier: requesting a specific type of record
nslookup -query.rationale: Changes the kind of information requested; equivalent to -type.

nslookup -retry.translation_modifier: retrying a specified number of times if the server does not respond
nslookup -retry.rationale: Controls how many times the query is repeated; still read-only.

nslookup -timeout.translation_modifier: waiting a specified number of seconds for a reply
nslookup -timeout.rationale: Sets how long to wait for a response; still read-only.

nslookup -type.translation_modifier: requesting a specific type of record
nslookup -type.rationale: Changes the kind of information requested; still a read-only query.

nslookup -version.translation_modifier: showing the version number and exiting immediately
nslookup -version.rationale: Prints version information and exits without performing any query.

nsupdate -l.translation_modifier: updating only the local DNS server using a session key
nsupdate -l.rationale: Limits updates to the local server, reducing blast radius.

nsupdate -v.translation_modifier: using TCP instead of UDP for the update
nsupdate -v.rationale: Changes the transport protocol; no additional risk.

nvram -c.rationale: Wipes all NVRAM settings, which can render the system unbootable or reset all hardware configuration.

nvram -d.rationale: Removes a firmware variable, which could change boot behavior or hardware configuration.

nvram -f.rationale: Bulk-sets NVRAM variables from a file, changing multiple boot and hardware settings at once.

nvram -p.rationale: Read-only display of all NVRAM variables.

objdump -C.rationale: Only changes how symbol names are formatted in the output.

objdump -S.translation_modifier: interleaving source code with the disassembly
objdump -S.rationale: Read-only display that shows source alongside assembly.

objdump -d.rationale: Read-only operation that displays disassembled machine code without modifying the binary file.

objdump -f.rationale: Read-only display of the file's main header.

objdump -j.translation_modifier: limiting output to a specific section
objdump -j.rationale: Filters which section is displayed; still read-only.

objdump -l.translation_modifier: displaying source file line numbers alongside the disassembly
objdump -l.rationale: Read-only display that maps instructions to source lines.

objdump -s.translation_modifier: displaying the full contents of each section
objdump -s.rationale: Read-only hex dump of all section data.

objdump -t.rationale: Read-only listing of symbols in the binary.

objdump -x.rationale: Read-only display of all header information.

od -A.translation_modifier: using the specified numbering system for addresses
od -A.rationale: Changes the display format of byte positions; read-only output.

od -N.translation_modifier: limiting the display to the specified number of bytes
od -N.rationale: Restricts how much data is shown; read-only output.

od -a.rationale: Changes display to named-character format; read-only output.

od -b.translation_modifier: showing each byte as a three-digit octal number
od -b.rationale: Changes display to octal byte format; read-only output.

od -c.translation_modifier: showing bytes as printable characters with special characters escaped
od -c.rationale: Changes display to character mode; read-only output.

od -j.translation_modifier: skipping the specified number of bytes before displaying
od -j.rationale: Starts display at a byte offset; read-only output.

od -t.translation_modifier: using a custom output format type
od -t.rationale: Selects the display format for bytes; read-only output.

od -v.translation_modifier: showing all data including repeated lines
od -v.rationale: Prevents collapsing duplicate lines into a star; read-only output.

od -x.translation_modifier: showing bytes in two-byte hexadecimal groups
od -x.rationale: Changes display to hexadecimal format; read-only output.

open --args.translation_modifier: passing all remaining arguments to the launched application
open --args.rationale: Forwards arguments to the application; no additional risk from the open command itself.

open --env.translation_modifier: adding a specified environment variable to the launched application
open --env.rationale: Sets an environment variable for the application process only.

open --stderr.translation_modifier: writing the launched application's error output to a specified file
open --stderr.rationale: Writes error output to a file, which will be created or overwritten.

open --stdin.translation_modifier: connecting the launched application's standard input to a specified file
open --stdin.rationale: Redirects stdin for the launched application; the file is read, not modified.

open --stdout.translation_modifier: writing the launched application's standard output to a specified file
open --stdout.rationale: Writes output to a file, which will be created or overwritten.

open -F.translation_modifier: without restoring the application's saved window state
open -F.rationale: Opens the application fresh; saved persistent state is discarded.

open -R.translation_modifier: revealing the file in Finder instead of opening it
open -R.rationale: Shows the file location in Finder without opening it in an application.

open -W.translation_modifier: waiting until the opened application exits before returning
open -W.rationale: Blocks the shell until the application closes; useful for scripting.

open -a.rationale: Overrides the default application; the opened file is still handled by a GUI application.

open -b.translation_modifier: using an application identified by its bundle identifier
open -b.rationale: Selects the application by bundle identifier instead of name; same behavior as -a.

open -e.rationale: Opens the file in the built-in text editor.

open -f.translation_modifier: reading from piped input and opening the result in the default text editor
open -f.rationale: Creates a temporary file from piped input and opens it; trivially reversible.

open -g.translation_modifier: without bringing the application to the foreground
open -g.rationale: Keeps the application in the background; no additional risk.

open -h.translation_modifier: searching for and opening a developer header file by name
open -h.rationale: Searches SDK header locations; read-only lookup and display.

open -j.rationale: Starts the application without showing its windows; no additional risk.

open -n.translation_modifier: opening a new instance of the application even if one is already running
open -n.rationale: Launches an additional application instance; no data is modified.

open -t.rationale: Opens the file in the system's default text editor.

open -u.translation_modifier: treating the argument as a URL even if it matches a file path
open -u.rationale: Forces URL handling instead of file path resolution; no additional risk.

opendiff -merge.translation_modifier: saving the merged result to a specified file
opendiff -merge.rationale: Enables writing a merged file, which could overwrite the target if it already exists.

opensnoop -p.translation_modifier: filtering to a specific process ID
opensnoop -p.rationale: Narrows the trace scope; still read-only.

opensnoop -x.rationale: Filters output to errors only; still read-only.

openssl enc -a.translation_modifier: encoding the output in base64 text format
openssl enc -a.rationale: Changes output encoding only; does not affect the encryption.

openssl enc -d.rationale: Reverses encryption; output may overwrite files.

openssl enc -in.translation_modifier: reading input from a specified file
openssl enc -in.rationale: Specifies the input source; does not change the operation.

openssl enc -out.translation_modifier: writing output to a specified file
openssl enc -out.rationale: May overwrite an existing file at the destination.

openssl enc -pass.rationale: Provides the passphrase non-interactively; does not change the encryption.

openssl enc -pbkdf2.translation_modifier: using a stronger key derivation method for the passphrase
openssl enc -pbkdf2.rationale: Improves security of passphrase-based encryption; a security-enhancing option.

openssl genrsa -aes256.translation_modifier: encrypting the private key with a passphrase using AES-256
openssl genrsa -aes256.rationale: Adds passphrase protection to the generated key; a security-enhancing option.

openssl genrsa -out.translation_modifier: writing the key to a specified file
openssl genrsa -out.rationale: May overwrite an existing key file, which could lock out access to systems using the old key.

openssl genrsa -passout.translation_modifier: using a specified passphrase source for key encryption
openssl genrsa -passout.rationale: Provides the passphrase non-interactively; does not change the key generation.

openssl rand -base64.translation_modifier: encoding the output in base64 text format
openssl rand -base64.rationale: Changes output encoding; does not affect the random data generation.

openssl rand -hex.translation_modifier: encoding the output in hexadecimal text format
openssl rand -hex.rationale: Changes output encoding; does not affect the random data generation.

openssl rand -out.translation_modifier: writing the random bytes to a specified file
openssl rand -out.rationale: Creates a new file; may overwrite an existing file at the destination.

openssl req -days.translation_modifier: setting the certificate validity period in days
openssl req -days.rationale: Controls how long the certificate is valid; does not change other behavior.

openssl req -key.translation_modifier: using a specified private key file
openssl req -key.rationale: Selects which key to use; does not modify the key.

openssl req -new.translation_modifier: generating a new certificate signing request
openssl req -new.rationale: Creates a new request; does not modify existing certificates or keys.

openssl req -nodes.translation_modifier: without encrypting the private key with a passphrase
openssl req -nodes.rationale: Leaves the private key unprotected on disk, which poses a security risk if the file is exposed.

openssl req -out.translation_modifier: writing output to a specified file
openssl req -out.rationale: Specifies the output destination; may overwrite an existing file.

openssl req -subj.translation_modifier: setting the certificate subject fields on the command line instead of prompting
openssl req -subj.rationale: Provides subject information non-interactively; does not change the operation.

openssl req -x509.translation_modifier: generating a self-signed certificate instead of a signing request
openssl req -x509.rationale: Creates a certificate directly; a local file operation.

openssl s_client -CAfile.translation_modifier: using a specified file of trusted certificates for verification
openssl s_client -CAfile.rationale: Provides trusted certificates for chain validation; does not modify anything.

openssl s_client -connect.translation_modifier: connecting to a specified host and port
openssl s_client -connect.rationale: Specifies the connection target; a required parameter for most uses.

openssl s_client -servername.translation_modifier: sending a specific hostname for TLS server name indication
openssl s_client -servername.rationale: Sets the server name; does not change the diagnostic nature of the connection.

openssl s_client -showcerts.translation_modifier: displaying the full certificate chain from the server
openssl s_client -showcerts.rationale: Shows additional certificate data; still a read-only operation.

openssl s_client -verify.translation_modifier: setting the maximum depth for certificate chain verification
openssl s_client -verify.rationale: Controls verification depth; a read-only diagnostic setting.

openssl x509 -in.translation_modifier: reading a certificate from a specified file
openssl x509 -in.rationale: Specifies the input file; read-only operation.

openssl x509 -noout.rationale: Reduces output; does not change behavior.

openssl x509 -text.translation_modifier: displaying the certificate details in human-readable form

osacompile -o.translation_modifier: writing the output to a specified file
osacompile -o.rationale: Sets the output file name; defaults to a.scpt.

osacompile -x.translation_modifier: saving as execute-only so the source cannot be recovered
osacompile -x.rationale: Strips source from the compiled output; no additional risk.

osascript -e.translation_modifier: executing a script statement provided on the command line
osascript -e.rationale: Runs inline script code; the risk is in what the script does.

osascript -i.translation_modifier: in interactive mode, prompting for one line at a time
osascript -i.rationale: Opens an interactive scripting session where each command is executed immediately.

osascript -l.rationale: Selects the language for compilation; no additional risk.

osascript -s.translation_modifier: using specified output style flags for how results and errors are displayed
osascript -s.rationale: Controls output formatting only; does not affect script execution.

otool -D.translation_modifier: showing only the install name of a shared library
otool -D.rationale: Read-only display of a single metadata value.

otool -I.rationale: Read-only display of indirect symbol references.

otool -L.translation_modifier: showing the shared libraries the file links against

otool -P.translation_modifier: showing the info property list embedded in the binary

otool -S.translation_modifier: showing the contents of the archive symbol definition file

otool -V.translation_modifier: showing symbolic names for both instructions and their operands
otool -V.rationale: Provides the most detailed symbolic disassembly; still read-only.

otool -d.rationale: Read-only display of the data section contents.

otool -h.rationale: Read-only display of the file header.

otool -l.rationale: Read-only display of load command details.

otool -t.rationale: Read-only display of the text section contents.

otool -v.translation_modifier: showing symbolic names instead of raw numbers
otool -v.rationale: Improves readability of output; still read-only.

passwd -i.translation_modifier: targeting a specific directory system for the password change
passwd -i.rationale: Directs the password update to a particular authentication system, which could affect login if misconfigured.

passwd -l.translation_modifier: specifying the directory location to update
passwd -l.rationale: Changes which password database is modified, such as a remote server or local file.

passwd -u.translation_modifier: authenticating as a different user when making the change
passwd -u.rationale: Uses alternate credentials for the update, which affects which account authorizes the change.

paste -d.translation_modifier: using specified characters as separators instead of tabs
paste -d.rationale: Changes the delimiter in the output; still read-only.

paste -s.translation_modifier: joining all lines of each file into a single line instead of merging across files
paste -s.rationale: Changes the merge direction; still read-only.

patch --dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the patch without actually modifying any files
patch --dry-run.rationale: No files are modified; only shows what would happen.

patch -E.translation_modifier: deleting output files that become empty after patching
patch -E.rationale: Automatically removes files, which could cause data loss if the patch is incorrect.

patch -N.translation_modifier: skipping patches that appear to be already applied or reversed
patch -N.rationale: Avoids reapplying changes; a safety-enhancing option.

patch -R.translation_modifier: reversing the patch to undo previously applied changes
patch -R.rationale: Undoes a patch application; safe if the patch was previously applied correctly.

patch -b.translation_modifier: creating backup files before modifying originals
patch -b.rationale: Preserves original files as backups; a safety-enhancing option.

patch -d.translation_modifier: changing to a specified directory before applying the patch
patch -d.rationale: Only changes the working directory for path resolution.

pkill -HUP.translation_modifier: asking matched processes to reload their configuration or shut down

pkill -P.translation_modifier: restricted to processes with a specific parent process ID

pkill -U.translation_modifier: restricted to processes with a specific real user ID

pkill -a.translation_modifier: including ancestor processes in the match

pkill -g.translation_modifier: restricted to processes in a specific process group

pkill -i.translation_modifier: ignoring upper and lower case differences when matching

pkill -l.translation_modifier: displaying the signal command used for each matched process

pkill -n.translation_modifier: targeting only the most recently started matching process
pkill -n.rationale: Limits the signal to a single process, reducing the blast radius.

pkill -o.translation_modifier: targeting only the oldest matching process
pkill -o.rationale: Limits the signal to a single process, reducing the blast radius.

pkill -t.translation_modifier: restricted to processes running on a specific terminal

pkill -u.translation_modifier: restricted to processes owned by a specific user
pkill -u.rationale: Filters by user but still signals all matching processes for that user.

pkill -v.translation_modifier: targeting processes that do not match the pattern instead

pkill -x.translation_modifier: requiring the pattern to match the entire process name exactly

scutil -W.rationale: Monitors reachability status over time; read-only.

scutil -r.translation_modifier: checking network reachability of a specified host
scutil -r.rationale: Read-only network reachability check; no state modification.

scutil -w.rationale: Blocks until a key exists or times out; no state modification.

security add-generic-password -U.translation_modifier: updating the item if it already exists

security add-internet-password -A.translation_modifier: allowing any application to access the item without warning
security add-internet-password -A.rationale: Removes access control; any application can read the stored password.

security add-internet-password -U.translation_modifier: updating the item if it already exists
security add-internet-password -U.rationale: Overwrites an existing password entry rather than failing on duplicate.

security create-keypair -A.rationale: Removes access control restrictions; any application can use the key without user confirmation.

sed -f.translation_modifier: reading editing commands from a file

sed -l.rationale: Changes buffering behavior; does not affect whether files are modified.

sed -n.translation_modifier: suppressing automatic output of each line
sed -n.rationale: Only prints lines that are explicitly selected; does not modify any files.

sed -r.rationale: GNU-compatible alias for -E; does not affect whether files are modified.

sed -u.rationale: Disables output buffering for real-time processing; does not affect whether files are modified.

segedit -extract.translation_modifier: extracting a named section to a file

sendmail -bp.translation_modifier: listing the mail queue instead of sending

sendmail -bs.translation_modifier: running as a stand-alone SMTP server on standard input and output

sendmail -bv.rationale: Only checks address validity and sends a report; no message is delivered.

sendmail -f.rationale: Specifies return address for bounce messages; no destructive action.

sendmail -i.translation_modifier: without treating a line with only a dot as end of input
sendmail -i.rationale: Changes input parsing behavior; no state modification.

sendmail -t.rationale: Reads To/Cc/Bcc headers for delivery; no additional risk beyond normal sending.

seq -f.rationale: Changes number formatting; no state modification.

setkey -n.rationale: Dry-run mode that checks syntax without modifying the database.

sftp -i.rationale: Selects an identity file; does not change the session's capabilities.

sftp -l.translation_modifier: limiting the transfer bandwidth to a specified rate
sftp -l.rationale: Throttles the transfer speed; a scope-reducing option.

sftp -q.rationale: Suppresses output messages; does not change transfer behavior.

sftp -r.rationale: Copies directory trees, increasing the scope of files transferred.

sftp -v.rationale: Increases output verbosity for debugging; does not change transfer behavior.

slapadd -l.translation_modifier: reading entries from a specified LDAP data interchange file

slapadd -n.translation_modifier: targeting a specific database by number

slapadd -u.translation_modifier: performing a dry run without modifying the database

slapcat -l.translation_modifier: writing output to a specified file

slapconfig -createreplica.translation_modifier: creating a new replica from an existing LDAP master
