stat -L.rationale: Follows shortcuts to report on the actual target file; still read-only.

stat -f.rationale: Changes which fields are displayed; still read-only.

stat -l.translation_modifier: showing output in a detailed list format
stat -l.rationale: Displays information in a long listing style; still read-only.

stat -n.translation_modifier: omitting the trailing newline from the output
stat -n.rationale: Adjusts output formatting for piping; still read-only.

stat -q.translation_modifier: hiding error messages for files that cannot be examined

stat -r.translation_modifier: showing raw numeric values instead of formatted text
stat -r.rationale: Outputs unformatted numeric data; still read-only.

stat -s.translation_modifier: showing output as variable assignments suitable for use in scripts
stat -s.rationale: Formats output for script consumption; still read-only.

stat -t.translation_modifier: formatting timestamps with a specified pattern
stat -t.rationale: Changes how dates and times appear; still read-only.

stat -x.translation_modifier: showing extra-detailed information in a verbose layout
stat -x.rationale: Expands output with additional fields; still read-only.

stringdups -callTrees.translation_modifier: showing a call tree of allocation sites for each duplicate string
stringdups -callTrees.rationale: Only changes how backtrace information is organized in the output.

stringdups -invertCallTrees.translation_modifier: showing call trees with the most specific allocation site first
stringdups -invertCallTrees.rationale: Only changes the ordering of call tree output.

stringdups -minimumCount.translation_modifier: only showing duplicates that appear at least a specified number of times
stringdups -minimumCount.rationale: Only filters which duplicates are displayed.

stringdups -nostacks.translation_modifier: hiding allocation backtraces from the output

stringdups -stringsOnly.translation_modifier: showing only string-type duplicates such as C strings and NSString objects
stringdups -stringsOnly.rationale: Only narrows which object types are displayed.

strings -a.translation_modifier: searching the entire file instead of just the data sections
strings -a.rationale: Expands the search scope; still read-only.

strings -arch.translation_modifier: targeting a specific processor architecture in a multi-architecture file
strings -arch.rationale: Selects which architecture to inspect; still read-only.

strings -n.translation_modifier: using a custom minimum length for what counts as a string
strings -n.rationale: Changes the detection threshold; still read-only.

strings -o.translation_modifier: showing the position of each string within the file
strings -o.rationale: Adds location information to output; still read-only.

strings -t.translation_modifier: showing each string's position in a specified number format
strings -t.rationale: Changes how position offsets are displayed; still read-only.

strip -N.translation_modifier: removing all symbol table entries and the string table entirely
strip -N.rationale: Aggressively strips all symbol information, making debugging and dynamic analysis impossible without rebuilding.

strip -R.translation_modifier: removing only the specific symbols listed in a file
strip -R.rationale: Selectively removes named symbols; recovery requires rebuilding.

strip -S.rationale: Removes debugging information while preserving other symbols.

strip -c.translation_modifier: removing section contents to create a stub library
strip -c.rationale: Removes executable code from a dynamic library, leaving only the interface; the library can no longer be used at runtime.

strip -no_uuid.translation_modifier: removing the unique build identifier from the binary
strip -no_uuid.rationale: Removes the UUID used to match binaries with debug symbol files.

strip -o.translation_modifier: writing the result to a separate file instead of modifying the original
strip -o.rationale: Preserves the original file by writing stripped output elsewhere.

strip -r.translation_modifier: preserving symbols referenced by dynamic libraries
strip -r.rationale: Limits stripping to keep the binary functional with dynamic linking.

strip -s.translation_modifier: keeping only the specific symbols listed in a file
strip -s.rationale: Removes all symbols not in the list; recovery requires rebuilding.

strip -u.translation_modifier: preserving undefined symbols referenced by dynamic libraries
strip -u.rationale: Limits stripping to keep the binary functional with dynamic linking.

strip -x.rationale: Strips local symbols which are needed for debugging; recovery requires rebuilding.

stty -g.translation_modifier: displaying settings in a format suitable for restoring later

su -.translation_modifier: starting a full login session with the target user's settings and home folder
su -.rationale: Same as -l; provides a complete environment as the target user, including their home folder and startup configuration.

su -f.translation_modifier: skipping the shell startup configuration files
su -f.rationale: Prevents the target shell from reading its configuration file, which only affects the shell's initial setup.

su -l.translation_modifier: starting a full login session with the target user's settings and home folder
su -l.rationale: Provides a complete environment as the target user, including their home folder and startup configuration.

su -m.translation_modifier: keeping your current environment settings instead of loading the target user's
su -m.rationale: Preserves the caller's environment, which can create security mismatches between the active user and the environment variables.

sudo --remove.translation_modifier: removing a specified user's cached credentials
sudo --remove.rationale: Removes cached authentication credentials; requires re-authentication.

sudo --reset.translation_modifier: resetting the user's cached credentials and security settings
sudo --reset.rationale: Resets all cached credentials; affects system authentication state.

sudo -E.rationale: Passes environment to the elevated command; may expose sensitive variables or bypass security policies.

sudo -i.translation_modifier: starting a login shell as the target user
sudo -i.rationale: Opens an interactive root shell with full environment; all subsequent commands run elevated.

sudo -k.rationale: Forces re-authentication on next sudo use; a security-tightening action.

sudo -l.translation_modifier: listing the allowed commands for the current user

sudo -n.translation_modifier: failing immediately if a password is required instead of prompting
sudo -n.rationale: Non-interactive mode; prevents execution if not already authenticated.

sudo -s.translation_modifier: starting a shell as the target user
sudo -s.rationale: Opens an elevated shell; all subsequent commands run with escalated privileges.

sudo -u.translation_modifier: running the command as a specified user instead of root
sudo -u.rationale: Executes with another user's permissions; risk depends on the target user's privileges.

sum -r.rationale: Only changes which checksum algorithm is used; no state modification.

sw_vers --buildVersion.translation_modifier: showing only the build version identifier

sw_vers --productName.translation_modifier: showing only the operating system name

sw_vers --productVersion.translation_modifier: showing only the operating system version number

swiftc -O.rationale: Increases optimization level; does not change the compilation model.

swiftc -g.translation_modifier: including debug information in the output
swiftc -g.rationale: Adds debug symbols; does not change program behavior.

swiftc -parse-as-library.translation_modifier: treating the input as a library module instead of a script
swiftc -parse-as-library.rationale: Changes the compilation mode; does not affect safety.

symbolscache --delete.rationale: Removes cached debug symbols; they must be re-downloaded for future debugging.

sysadminctl -addUser.rationale: Adds a new user to the system with specified privileges; reversible by deletion.

sysadminctl -admin.translation_modifier: granting administrator privileges to the new user
sysadminctl -admin.rationale: Creates a user with full administrative access to the system.

sysadminctl -deleteUser.rationale: Permanently removes a user account and potentially their home directory; irrecoverable without backups.

sysadminctl -guestAccount.translation_modifier: enabling or disabling the guest account
sysadminctl -guestAccount.rationale: Controls whether unauthenticated users can access the system.

sysadminctl -resetPasswordFor.translation_modifier: resetting the password for a local user
sysadminctl -resetPasswordFor.rationale: Changes a user's password without knowing the old one; locks the user out of their previous password.

sysadminctl -screenLock.rationale: Changes system security posture by controlling when the screen locks.

sysadminctl -secure.translation_modifier: securely erasing the deleted user's home directory
sysadminctl -secure.rationale: Overwrites the user's data making recovery impossible even with forensic tools.

sysadminctl -secureTokenOff.translation_modifier: disabling the secure token for a user
sysadminctl -secureTokenOff.rationale: Removes the secure token which may prevent the user from unlocking FileVault or performing admin tasks.

sysadminctl -secureTokenOn.translation_modifier: enabling the secure token for a user
sysadminctl -secureTokenOn.rationale: Grants the user a secure token which is required for FileVault and certain system operations.

sysadminctl -secureTokenStatus.translation_modifier: checking the secure token status for a user
sysadminctl -secureTokenStatus.rationale: Read-only operation that reports whether a Secure Token has been granted to the specified user.

sysctl -a.translation_modifier: listing all available kernel parameters and their values

sysctl -n.translation_modifier: displaying only the value without the parameter name
sysctl -n.rationale: Cosmetic output change; no state modification.

sysctl -w.translation_modifier: setting a kernel parameter to a specified value
sysctl -w.rationale: Modifies kernel state which can affect system stability, security, or performance.

system_profiler -detailLevel.translation_modifier: specifying the level of detail in the report
system_profiler -detailLevel.rationale: Controls report verbosity; no state modification.

system_profiler -json.translation_modifier: generating the report in JSON format
system_profiler -json.rationale: Changes output format; no state modification.

system_profiler -listDataTypes.translation_modifier: listing available data types that can be queried
system_profiler -listDataTypes.rationale: Read-only listing of available report categories.

system_profiler -timeout.translation_modifier: limiting the time to wait for results to a specified number of seconds
system_profiler -timeout.rationale: Controls how long to wait before returning partial results; no state modification.

system_profiler -xml.translation_modifier: generating the report in XML format
system_profiler -xml.rationale: Changes output format; no state modification.

systemsetup -getcomputername.rationale: Read-only display of the computer name.

systemsetup -getcomputersleep.translation_modifier: displaying the idle time before the computer sleeps
systemsetup -getcomputersleep.rationale: Read-only display of sleep timer setting.

systemsetup -getdate.rationale: Read-only display of the current date.

systemsetup -getdisplaysleep.translation_modifier: displaying the idle time before the display sleeps
systemsetup -getdisplaysleep.rationale: Read-only display of display sleep timer.

systemsetup -getharddisksleep.translation_modifier: displaying the idle time before the hard disk sleeps
systemsetup -getharddisksleep.rationale: Read-only display of disk sleep timer.

systemsetup -getremoteappleevents.translation_modifier: displaying whether remote Apple events are enabled
systemsetup -getremoteappleevents.rationale: Read-only display of remote events status.

systemsetup -getremotelogin.translation_modifier: displaying whether SSH remote login is enabled
systemsetup -getremotelogin.rationale: Read-only display of remote login status.

systemsetup -getstartupdisk.rationale: Read-only display of the startup disk.

systemsetup -gettime.rationale: Read-only display of the current time.

systemsetup -gettimezone.rationale: Read-only display of the current time zone.

systemsetup -getusingnetworktime.translation_modifier: displaying whether network time synchronization is enabled
systemsetup -getusingnetworktime.rationale: Read-only display of network time status.

systemsetup -liststartupdisks.rationale: Read-only listing of available startup disks.

systemsetup -setallowpowerbuttontosleepc.translation_modifier: enabling or disabling the power button sleep function
systemsetup -setallowpowerbuttontosleepc.rationale: Controls whether the power button can put the computer to sleep; easily reversible.

systemsetup -setcomputername.rationale: Changes the display name used on the network; easily reversible.

systemsetup -setcomputersleep.translation_modifier: setting the idle time before the computer sleeps
systemsetup -setcomputersleep.rationale: Changes sleep behavior; a sleeping server becomes unreachable remotely.

systemsetup -setdate.rationale: Incorrect dates can break certificate validation, authentication, and time-sensitive operations.

systemsetup -setdisplaysleep.translation_modifier: setting the idle time before the display sleeps
systemsetup -setdisplaysleep.rationale: Only affects display power; the system continues running.

systemsetup -setharddisksleep.translation_modifier: setting the idle time before the hard disk sleeps
systemsetup -setharddisksleep.rationale: May cause brief delays when accessing disk after sleep; reversible.

systemsetup -setnetworktimeserver.translation_modifier: setting the network time server address
systemsetup -setnetworktimeserver.rationale: Changes which server provides the system clock reference.

systemsetup -setremoteappleevents.translation_modifier: enabling or disabling remote Apple events
systemsetup -setremoteappleevents.rationale: Enables remote control of the machine via Apple events; enabling exposes the system to network commands.

systemsetup -setremotelogin.translation_modifier: enabling or disabling SSH remote login
systemsetup -setremotelogin.rationale: Enables or disables remote SSH access to the machine; enabling exposes the system to network access.

systemsetup -setrestartfreeze.translation_modifier: enabling or disabling automatic restart after a system freeze
systemsetup -setrestartfreeze.rationale: Controls whether the system recovers automatically from freezes.

systemsetup -setrestartpowerfailure.translation_modifier: enabling or disabling automatic restart after power failure

systemsetup -setstartupdisk.translation_modifier: setting the startup disk for next boot
systemsetup -setstartupdisk.rationale: Changes which volume the system boots from; incorrect settings may prevent boot.

systemsetup -settime.rationale: Incorrect time can break authentication and time-sensitive operations.

systemsetup -settimezone.rationale: Changes how times are interpreted; reversible by resetting.

systemsetup -setusingnetworktime.translation_modifier: enabling or disabling automatic network time synchronization
systemsetup -setusingnetworktime.rationale: Disabling may cause clock drift; enabling syncs to a time server.

systemsetup -setwakeonnetworkaccess.translation_modifier: enabling or disabling wake on network access
systemsetup -setwakeonnetworkaccess.rationale: Controls whether the system wakes from sleep when a network packet arrives.

systemstats --all.rationale: Read-only display of all system performance statistics.

tail -F.translation_modifier: continuously following new output, reopening the file if it is rotated or renamed
tail -F.rationale: Like -f but handles log rotation by detecting inode changes; still read-only.

tail -b.translation_modifier: showing a specified number of 512-byte blocks instead of lines
tail -b.rationale: Changes the unit of output to 512-byte blocks; still read-only.

tail -c.translation_modifier: showing a specified number of bytes instead of lines
tail -c.rationale: Changes the unit of output from lines to bytes; still read-only.

tail -f.translation_modifier: continuously following new output as the file grows
tail -f.rationale: Keeps the stream open to display new lines as they are appended; still read-only.

tail -n.translation_modifier: showing a specified number of lines
tail -n.rationale: Changes how many lines are displayed; still read-only.

tail -r.translation_modifier: displaying lines in reverse order from the end of the file
tail -r.rationale: Reverses the output order; still read-only.

tar --exclude.translation_modifier: skipping files and directories that match a specified pattern
tar --exclude.rationale: Reduces the set of files processed; a scope-reducing option.

tar --lz4.rationale: Adds lz4 compression; does not change the archive scope.

tar --one-file-system.translation_modifier: staying within a single file system and not crossing mount points
tar --one-file-system.rationale: Limits the scope of the archive; a safety-enhancing option.

tar --overwrite.translation_modifier: overwriting existing files without prompting during extraction
tar --overwrite.rationale: Silently replaces existing files during extraction.

tar --zstd.rationale: Adds Zstandard compression; does not change the archive scope.

tar -C.translation_modifier: changing to a specified directory before processing
tar -C.rationale: Changes the working directory; does not add destructive capability.

tar -J.rationale: Adds xz compression; does not change the archive scope.

tar -a.translation_modifier: automatically choosing the compression method based on the archive file extension
tar -a.rationale: Selects compression format; does not change the archive scope.

tar -c.rationale: Creates an archive file; does not modify the source files.

tar -f.rationale: Specifies the archive filename; required for most operations.

tar -j.rationale: Adds bzip2 compression; does not change the archive scope.

tar -k.translation_modifier: never overwriting existing files during extraction

tar -p.translation_modifier: preserving original file permissions during extraction
tar -p.rationale: Restores file permissions from the archive; does not add destructive capability.

tar -r.translation_modifier: appending files to the end of an existing archive
tar -r.rationale: Adds entries to an archive; does not overwrite or delete existing entries.

tar -t.translation_modifier: listing the contents of the archive without extracting
tar -t.rationale: Read-only listing; no files are created or modified.

tar -v.rationale: Increases output verbosity; does not change behavior.

tar -x.rationale: Extracts files to disk, potentially overwriting existing files at the destination.

tar -z.rationale: Adds gzip compression; does not change the archive scope.

taskinfo --all.rationale: Read-only display of all running task information.

tcpdump -A.translation_modifier: displaying packet contents as readable text
tcpdump -A.rationale: Shows packet payloads in readable form, which may expose sensitive data on screen.

tcpdump -C.translation_modifier: rotating the capture file when it reaches a specified size
tcpdump -C.rationale: Creates multiple capture files, which may consume significant disk space.

tcpdump -D.translation_modifier: listing all available network interfaces instead of capturing
tcpdump -D.rationale: Read-only display of available interfaces; no packets are captured.

tcpdump -F.translation_modifier: reading the capture filter expression from a file
tcpdump -F.rationale: Changes how the filter is specified; does not add capture capability.

tcpdump -G.translation_modifier: rotating the capture file at a specified interval in seconds
tcpdump -G.rationale: Creates multiple capture files over time, which may consume significant disk space.

tcpdump -X.translation_modifier: displaying packet contents in both hexadecimal and text
tcpdump -X.rationale: Shows detailed packet payloads, which may expose sensitive data on screen.

tcpdump -c.translation_modifier: stopping after capturing a specified number of packets
tcpdump -c.rationale: Limits the capture duration; a scope-reducing option.

tcpdump -e.translation_modifier: including hardware addresses in each line of output
tcpdump -e.rationale: Adds link-layer header information to the display; still a read-only operation.

tcpdump -i.translation_modifier: capturing on a specified network interface
tcpdump -i.rationale: Selects which interface to monitor; does not change the capture behavior.

tcpdump -n.translation_modifier: displaying IP addresses instead of resolving hostnames
tcpdump -n.rationale: Changes output formatting; does not change capture behavior.

tcpdump -r.translation_modifier: reading packets from a previously captured file
tcpdump -r.rationale: Reads from a file instead of the network; no live capture.

tcpdump -s.translation_modifier: capturing only a specified number of bytes from each packet
tcpdump -s.rationale: Limits the amount of data captured per packet; a scope-reducing option.

tcpdump -v.rationale: Increases output verbosity; does not change capture behavior.

tcpdump -w.translation_modifier: writing captured packets to a file
tcpdump -w.rationale: Saves potentially sensitive network data to disk.

tee -a.translation_modifier: appending to the files instead of overwriting them
tee -a.rationale: Preserves existing file content by appending; reduces overwrite risk.

tee -i.rationale: Prevents the process from being interrupted by Ctrl-C; does not affect file content.

terraform apply -auto-approve.rationale: Skips the confirmation prompt, immediately applying potentially destructive changes.

terraform apply -destroy.translation_modifier: destroying all managed infrastructure instead of creating or updating
terraform apply -destroy.rationale: Equivalent to terraform destroy; removes all managed resources.

terraform apply -lock=false.rationale: Allows concurrent modifications, which can corrupt the state file.

terraform apply -parallelism.translation_modifier: limiting the number of concurrent resource operations
terraform apply -parallelism.rationale: Controls concurrency; lower values are safer but slower.

terraform apply -refresh-only.translation_modifier: only updating the state file to match real infrastructure without making changes
terraform apply -refresh-only.rationale: Reconciles state with reality; may cause future plans to show unexpected changes.

terraform apply -target.translation_modifier: limited to a specific resource and its dependencies
terraform apply -target.rationale: Narrows the scope of the apply; reduces blast radius but may leave state inconsistent.

terraform apply -var.translation_modifier: with a specific input variable value
terraform apply -var.rationale: Passes an input variable; the risk is in what the apply does, not in setting a variable.

terraform apply -var-file.translation_modifier: using input variable values from a specified file
terraform apply -var-file.rationale: Loads variables from a file; the risk is in what the apply does, not in loading variables.

terraform destroy -auto-approve.rationale: Immediately destroys all managed infrastructure without a confirmation prompt.

terraform destroy -lock=false.rationale: Allows concurrent state modifications during destroy, risking state corruption.

terraform destroy -target.translation_modifier: limited to a specific resource and its dependencies
terraform destroy -target.rationale: Limits destruction scope but can leave state inconsistent.

terraform fmt -check.translation_modifier: only checking if files need formatting without modifying them
terraform fmt -check.rationale: Read-only check; no files are modified.

terraform fmt -recursive.translation_modifier: processing files in subdirectories as well
terraform fmt -recursive.rationale: Extends formatting to subdirectories; only modifies whitespace.

terraform force-unlock -force.rationale: Skips the confirmation prompt; the risk is in the base command, not the prompt bypass.

terraform import -lock=false.rationale: Allows concurrent state modifications, which can corrupt the state file.

terraform init -backend=false.rationale: Initializes without configuring the backend; useful for module development.

terraform init -migrate-state.translation_modifier: migrating existing state to the newly configured backend
terraform init -migrate-state.rationale: Moves state between backends; errors during migration can leave state in an inconsistent location.

terraform init -reconfigure.translation_modifier: reconfiguring the backend and ignoring any saved configuration
terraform init -reconfigure.rationale: Discards existing backend configuration, which may disconnect from the current state.

terraform init -upgrade.translation_modifier: upgrading provider plugins and modules to the latest allowed versions
terraform init -upgrade.rationale: May introduce breaking changes from newer provider versions.

terraform plan -destroy.translation_modifier: planning the destruction of all managed resources instead of the usual changes
terraform plan -destroy.rationale: Only generates a destroy plan; no infrastructure is actually destroyed.

terraform plan -out.translation_modifier: saving the plan to a file for later execution
terraform plan -out.rationale: Writes a plan file; no infrastructure is modified.

terraform plan -refresh-only.translation_modifier: only updating the state file to match real infrastructure without planning changes
terraform plan -refresh-only.rationale: Read-only reconciliation of state; no infrastructure is modified.

terraform plan -target.translation_modifier: limited to a specific resource and its dependencies
terraform plan -target.rationale: Narrows the plan scope; still read-only.

terraform plan -var.translation_modifier: with a specific input variable value
terraform plan -var.rationale: Passes a variable; no infrastructure is modified during plan.

terraform plan -var-file.translation_modifier: using input variable values from a specified file
terraform plan -var-file.rationale: Loads variables from a file; no infrastructure is modified during plan.

terraform refresh -lock=false.rationale: Allows concurrent state modifications, which can corrupt the state file.

terraform refresh -target.translation_modifier: limited to a specific resource and its dependencies
terraform refresh -target.rationale: Narrows the refresh scope but may leave state partially updated.

terraform state mv -dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the move without actually changing the state
terraform state mv -dry-run.rationale: No state changes are made; only shows what would be moved.

terraform state mv -lock=false.rationale: Allows concurrent state modifications, which can corrupt the state file.

terraform state push -force.translation_modifier: even if the state lineage or serial number does not match
terraform state push -force.rationale: Bypasses safety checks that prevent overwriting divergent state, risking total state corruption.

terraform state replace-provider -lock=f.rationale: Allows concurrent state modifications, which can corrupt the state file.

terraform state rm -dry-run.translation_modifier: simulating the removal without actually changing the state
terraform state rm -dry-run.rationale: No state changes are made; only shows what would be removed.

terraform state rm -lock=false.rationale: Allows concurrent state modifications, which can corrupt the state file.

terraform validate -json.rationale: Changes output format to JSON; still a read-only validation.

test -L.translation_modifier: checking whether a path is a symbolic link

test -d.translation_modifier: checking whether a path is a directory

test -f.translation_modifier: checking whether a path is a regular file

test -n.translation_modifier: checking whether a string is non-empty

test -r.translation_modifier: checking whether a file is readable

test -s.translation_modifier: checking whether a file exists and is not empty

test -w.translation_modifier: checking whether a file is writable

test -x.translation_modifier: checking whether a file is executable

test -z.translation_modifier: checking whether a string is empty

textutil -baseurl.translation_modifier: using a specified base URL for resolving relative links
textutil -baseurl.rationale: Controls URL resolution; no additional risk.

textutil -cat.rationale: Combines files into one output; originals are unchanged.

textutil -convert.translation_modifier: converting the document to a specified format
textutil -convert.rationale: Overwrites the input file with the converted format by default.

textutil -encoding.translation_modifier: using a specified text encoding for the output
textutil -encoding.rationale: Controls the output encoding; does not change the scope of the operation.

textutil -extension.translation_modifier: using a specified file extension for the output
textutil -extension.rationale: Overrides the default output file extension; no additional risk.

textutil -font.translation_modifier: using a specified font when converting plain text to rich text
textutil -font.rationale: Controls font selection in the output; no additional risk.

textutil -fontsize.translation_modifier: using a specified font size in points when converting plain text to rich text
textutil -fontsize.rationale: Controls font size in the output; no additional risk.

textutil -format.translation_modifier: interpreting all input files as a specified format
textutil -format.rationale: Overrides automatic format detection; does not change the scope of the operation.

textutil -info.translation_modifier: displaying information about the files without modifying them

textutil -inputencoding.translation_modifier: interpreting all input files with a specified text encoding
textutil -inputencoding.rationale: Controls how input is read; does not change the scope of the operation.

textutil -noload.translation_modifier: without loading subsidiary resources like images
textutil -noload.rationale: Skips loading external resources; reduces network and disk activity.

textutil -nostore.translation_modifier: without writing subsidiary resources to disk
textutil -nostore.rationale: Prevents writing of external resources; reduces output scope.

textutil -output.translation_modifier: writing the result to a specified output file
textutil -output.rationale: Preserves the original by writing to a different file.

textutil -stdin.translation_modifier: reading input from standard input instead of files
textutil -stdin.rationale: Changes the input source; no additional risk.

textutil -stdout.translation_modifier: writing the output to standard output instead of a file
textutil -stdout.rationale: Avoids writing to disk; preserves originals.

textutil -strip.translation_modifier: removing all metadata from the output file
textutil -strip.rationale: Discards metadata like author and title; the document content is preserved.

tidy -m.translation_modifier: modifying the input file in place
tidy -m.rationale: Overwrites the original file with the tidied version; original formatting is lost.

time -a.translation_modifier: appending timing results to the output file instead of overwriting it
time -a.rationale: Preserves existing file contents by appending; used with the -o option.

time -h.translation_modifier: formatting the output in a human-readable format
time -h.rationale: Only changes output formatting; still read-only.

time -l.translation_modifier: also showing detailed resource usage statistics
time -l.rationale: Displays additional read-only metrics like memory usage; modifies nothing.

time -o.translation_modifier: writing the timing results to a specified file
time -o.rationale: Writes timing output to a file; overwrites the file if it exists.

time -p.translation_modifier: formatting the output in the portable standard format
time -p.rationale: Only changes output formatting; still read-only.

timeout --foreground.translation_modifier: allowing the command to read from the terminal directly
timeout --foreground.rationale: Adjusts how the process interacts with the terminal; no additional data risk.

timeout --kill-after.translation_modifier: sending a forced stop signal if the command does not exit after the first signal
timeout --kill-after.rationale: Forcefully terminates the process after a grace period, which may prevent it from saving state.

timeout --preserve-status.translation_modifier: returning the command's own exit code instead of a timeout indicator
timeout --preserve-status.rationale: Only changes the exit status reported; no effect on the command or data.

timeout --signal.translation_modifier: sending a specific signal instead of the default termination signal
timeout --signal.rationale: Allows sending forceful signals like a forced-kill signal, which can prevent programs from cleaning up gracefully.

timeout -k.translation_modifier: sending a forced stop signal if the command does not exit after the first signal
timeout -k.rationale: Forcefully terminates the process after a grace period, which may prevent it from saving state.

timeout -s.translation_modifier: sending a specific signal instead of the default termination signal
timeout -s.rationale: Allows sending forceful signals like a forced-kill signal, which can prevent programs from cleaning up gracefully.

timeout -v.translation_modifier: printing a message when the time limit is reached
timeout -v.rationale: Adds informational output; no effect on the command or data.

tmutil addexclusion -p.translation_modifier: using a fixed-path exclusion that stays with the location, not the item
tmutil addexclusion -p.rationale: Exclusion is path-based; moving the item away removes the exclusion, but new items at that path become excluded.

tmutil addexclusion -v.translation_modifier: excluding an entire volume by its filesystem identity
tmutil addexclusion -v.rationale: Excludes the volume persistently across name and mount path changes.

tmutil delete -p.translation_modifier: deleting a specific path within a backup
tmutil delete -p.rationale: Permanently removes the specified path from the backup.

tmutil delete -t.translation_modifier: specifying a backup timestamp to delete
tmutil delete -t.rationale: Selects which backup to permanently remove by its timestamp.

tmutil destinationinfo -X.rationale: Changes output to XML property list format; read-only.

tmutil restore -v.rationale: Increases output verbosity during restore; does not change behavior.

tmutil setdestination -a.translation_modifier: adding the destination to the list instead of replacing
tmutil setdestination -a.rationale: Preserves existing destinations rather than replacing them.

tmutil setdestination -p.translation_modifier: prompting for the password interactively instead of on the command line
tmutil setdestination -p.rationale: Improves security by hiding the password from process listings.

tmutil startbackup --auto.translation_modifier: running the backup in automatic mode with system-managed priority
tmutil startbackup --auto.rationale: Lets the system manage backup scheduling and resources.

tmutil startbackup --block.translation_modifier: waiting for the backup to complete before returning
tmutil startbackup --block.rationale: Blocks the terminal until backup finishes; no additional risk.

tmutil startbackup --destination.translation_modifier: targeting a specific backup destination by its identifier
tmutil startbackup --destination.rationale: Selects which destination receives the backup; no additional risk.

tmutil startbackup --rotation.translation_modifier: allowing automatic destination rotation during the backup
tmutil startbackup --rotation.rationale: Permits switching between configured backup destinations.

tmux attach-session -d.translation_modifier: detaching any other clients already connected
tmux attach-session -d.rationale: Disconnects other clients from the session but does not stop any programs.

tmux attach-session -t.rationale: Specifies which session to attach to; no additional risk.

tmux detach-client -a.translation_modifier: detaching all other clients from the session
tmux detach-client -a.rationale: Disconnects other clients but does not stop programs or lose data.

tmux kill-session -a.translation_modifier: killing all sessions except the one specified
tmux kill-session -a.rationale: Terminates multiple sessions at once, potentially stopping many running programs and losing unsaved work.

tmux kill-session -t.rationale: Specifies which session to terminate; narrows the scope of the command.

tmux kill-window -t.rationale: Specifies which window to close; narrows the scope of the command.

tmux new-session -d.rationale: Creates the session in the background; no additional risk.

tmux new-session -n.rationale: Sets the initial window name; purely cosmetic.

tmux new-session -s.rationale: Names the session for easier identification; no risk impact.

tmux send-keys -t.rationale: Specifies which pane receives the keystrokes; narrows the scope.

tmux split-window -h.rationale: Changes the orientation of the split; no data impact.

tmux split-window -v.rationale: Default split direction; no data impact.

tofu apply -auto-approve.rationale: Skips the interactive approval prompt, allowing infrastructure changes to proceed unreviewed.

tofu apply -destroy.translation_modifier: destroying all managed infrastructure instead of creating or updating
tofu apply -destroy.rationale: Tears down all resources managed by OpenTofu.

tofu apply -lock=false.rationale: Allows concurrent modifications to state, risking corruption if others run commands simultaneously.

tofu apply -parallelism.translation_modifier: limiting the number of concurrent resource operations
tofu apply -parallelism.rationale: Controls concurrency; does not change what resources are modified.

tofu destroy -auto-approve.rationale: Skips the interactive approval prompt before destroying all infrastructure.

top -F.translation_modifier: skipping shared library statistics for faster updates
top -F.rationale: Reduces computation by omitting framework statistics; still read-only.

top -O.translation_modifier: using a secondary sort column to break ties
top -O.rationale: Adds a second-level sort key; still read-only.

top -S.translation_modifier: including swap and purgeable memory statistics
top -S.rationale: Adds global memory statistics to the display; still read-only.

top -U.translation_modifier: showing only processes belonging to a specified user
top -U.rationale: Filters the display to a single user's processes; still read-only.

top -a.translation_modifier: counting events cumulatively since the tool was launched
top -a.rationale: Changes the counting mode to accumulative; still read-only.

top -d.translation_modifier: counting events relative to the previous snapshot
top -d.rationale: Changes the counting mode to show differences between updates; still read-only.

top -l.translation_modifier: printing a specified number of snapshots and then exiting instead of updating in place
top -l.rationale: Runs in logging mode for a set number of samples; still read-only.

top -n.translation_modifier: showing only a specified number of processes
top -n.rationale: Limits how many processes appear in the listing; still read-only.

top -o.translation_modifier: sorting processes by a specified column such as processor usage or memory
top -o.rationale: Changes the display sort order; still read-only.

top -pid.rationale: Filters the display to a single process by its ID; still read-only.

top -r.translation_modifier: including memory region details for each process
top -r.rationale: Adds detailed memory mapping information to the output; still read-only.

top -s.translation_modifier: waiting a specified number of seconds between each update
top -s.rationale: Controls the refresh interval; still read-only.

top -stats.translation_modifier: showing only specified columns in the output
top -stats.rationale: Customizes which data columns are displayed; still read-only.

top -u.rationale: Changes user display format; still read-only.

touch -A.translation_modifier: adjusting the existing timestamps forward or backward by a specified amount
touch -A.rationale: Shifts timestamps relative to their current value; does not modify file contents.

touch -a.rationale: Limits the timestamp change to the access time only.

touch -c.translation_modifier: skipping the file if it does not already exist instead of creating it
touch -c.rationale: Prevents creation of new files; a scope-reducing option.

touch -d.translation_modifier: setting a specific date and time in a flexible format instead of using the current time
touch -d.rationale: Allows setting an arbitrary timestamp; does not modify file contents.

touch -h.translation_modifier: updating the shortcut itself instead of the file it points to
touch -h.rationale: Changes the target of the timestamp update; does not modify file contents.

touch -m.rationale: Limits the timestamp change to the modification time only.

touch -r.translation_modifier: copying the timestamps from another specified file
touch -r.rationale: Uses another file's timestamps as the source; does not modify file contents.

touch -t.translation_modifier: setting a specific date and time instead of using the current time
touch -t.rationale: Allows setting an arbitrary timestamp; does not modify file contents.

tr -C.translation_modifier: operating on all characters except the ones specified
tr -C.rationale: Inverts the character set, same as -c; still read-only.

tr -c.translation_modifier: operating on all characters except the ones specified
tr -c.rationale: Inverts the character set; still read-only.

tr -d.translation_modifier: deleting matching characters instead of replacing them
tr -d.rationale: Removes specified characters from the output; the input source is unchanged.

tr -s.translation_modifier: collapsing consecutive repeated characters into a single occurrence
tr -s.rationale: Reduces runs of the same character to one; still read-only.

traceroute -I.translation_modifier: using ping-style packets instead of the default method
traceroute -I.rationale: Switches the probe type; may produce different results through firewalls but is still read-only.

traceroute -P.translation_modifier: using a specified network protocol for probes
traceroute -P.rationale: Allows testing whether specific protocols are blocked along the path; still read-only.

traceroute -f.translation_modifier: starting the trace at a specified hop number
traceroute -f.rationale: Skips the first few hops; useful for diagnosing a known segment of the path.

traceroute -i.translation_modifier: sending probes through a specified network interface
traceroute -i.rationale: Selects which network interface to use; still read-only.

traceroute -m.translation_modifier: limiting the maximum number of hops to check
traceroute -m.rationale: Caps how far the trace goes; still read-only.

traceroute -n.translation_modifier: showing addresses as numbers instead of looking up hostnames
traceroute -n.rationale: Skips name lookups for faster output; still read-only.

traceroute -p.translation_modifier: starting from a specified port number
traceroute -p.rationale: Changes the base port used for probes; still read-only.

traceroute -q.translation_modifier: sending a specified number of test packets per hop
traceroute -q.rationale: Controls how many probes are sent at each hop; still read-only.

traceroute -s.translation_modifier: sending from a specified source address
traceroute -s.rationale: Sets the source address for outgoing probes; still read-only.

traceroute -v.translation_modifier: showing detailed information about received packets

traceroute -w.translation_modifier: waiting a specified number of seconds for each reply
traceroute -w.rationale: Sets the per-hop timeout; still read-only.

tree --dirsfirst.translation_modifier: listing directories before files at each level

tree --filelimit.translation_modifier: skipping directories that contain more than the specified number of entries
tree --filelimit.rationale: Limits output for large directories; still read-only.

tree --noreport.translation_modifier: without printing the file and directory count summary
tree --noreport.rationale: Suppresses the summary line; still read-only.

tree --prune.translation_modifier: hiding empty directories from the output
tree --prune.rationale: Removes empty directories from the display; still read-only.

tree -D.translation_modifier: showing the last modification date of each file
tree -D.rationale: Adds modification timestamps to the display; still read-only.

tree -H.translation_modifier: outputting the tree as an HTML page
tree -H.rationale: Changes output to HTML format; still read-only.

tree -I.translation_modifier: excluding files matching a wildcard pattern
tree -I.rationale: Filters out files by pattern; still read-only.

tree -J.rationale: Changes output to JSON format; still read-only.

tree -L.translation_modifier: limiting the display to a specified number of directory levels

tree -P.translation_modifier: showing only files matching a wildcard pattern
tree -P.rationale: Filters displayed files by pattern; still read-only.

tree -U.translation_modifier: listing files in the order they appear on disk, unsorted

tree -X.rationale: Changes output to XML format; still read-only.

tree -a.rationale: Shows dotfiles in the listing; still read-only.

tree -d.rationale: Restricts the listing to directories; still read-only.

tree -f.translation_modifier: showing the full path prefix for each file
tree -f.rationale: Changes output format to include full paths; still read-only.

tree -g.translation_modifier: showing the group of each file
tree -g.rationale: Displays file group ownership; still read-only.

tree -h.translation_modifier: showing file sizes in human-readable units
tree -h.rationale: Formats file sizes with K/M/G suffixes; still read-only.

tree -i.translation_modifier: without indentation lines, printing plain filenames

tree -l.translation_modifier: following symbolic links as if they were directories
tree -l.rationale: Follows symlinks during traversal; still a read-only listing.

tree -o.translation_modifier: writing the output to a file instead of the terminal
tree -o.rationale: Creates or overwrites a file with the listing output; the tree content itself is still read-only.

tree -p.translation_modifier: showing file permissions for each entry
tree -p.rationale: Displays permission bits alongside filenames; still read-only.

tree -r.rationale: Reverses the listing order; still read-only.

tree -s.translation_modifier: showing the size of each file in bytes
tree -s.rationale: Adds file size to the display; still read-only.

tree -t.translation_modifier: sorting files by last modification time

tree -u.translation_modifier: showing the owner of each file

tsc --declaration.rationale: Produces additional .d.ts files; does not change the compilation behavior.

tsc --incremental.translation_modifier: saving build information to speed up subsequent compilations
tsc --incremental.rationale: Writes a build info file for faster rebuilds; does not change compilation output.

tsc --noEmit.translation_modifier: checking types without writing any output files
tsc --noEmit.rationale: Read-only type checking that produces no output files.

tsc --outDir.translation_modifier: writing compiled output to a specified directory
tsc --outDir.rationale: Changes where output files are written; does not add destructive capability.

tsc --project.translation_modifier: using a specified tsconfig.json configuration file
tsc --project.rationale: Selects which configuration to use; does not change the compiler's capabilities.

tsc --sourceMap.translation_modifier: generating source map files for debugging
tsc --sourceMap.rationale: Produces additional .map files; does not change the compilation behavior.

tsc --strict.rationale: Increases the strictness of type checking; does not change output behavior.

tsc --watch.translation_modifier: continuously recompiling when source files change
tsc --watch.rationale: Keeps the compiler running to rebuild on changes; does not add destructive capability.

ulimit -H.translation_modifier: applying changes to the hard limit instead of the soft limit
ulimit -H.rationale: Hard limits cannot be raised again once lowered, making the change difficult to reverse.

ulimit -S.translation_modifier: applying changes to the soft limit
ulimit -S.rationale: Soft limits can be raised again up to the hard limit.

ulimit -a.rationale: Read-only display of all resource limits.

ulimit -c.translation_modifier: setting or displaying the maximum size of core dump files
ulimit -c.rationale: Only affects whether and how large crash dump files can be.

ulimit -f.translation_modifier: setting or displaying the maximum size of files the shell can create
ulimit -f.rationale: Restricting file size can cause writes to fail silently or with errors.

ulimit -l.translation_modifier: setting or displaying the maximum size of memory that can be locked
ulimit -l.rationale: Only affects the amount of memory that can be pinned in RAM.

ulimit -m.translation_modifier: setting or displaying the maximum physical memory size
ulimit -m.rationale: Restricting physical memory can degrade performance or cause process failures.

ulimit -n.translation_modifier: setting or displaying the maximum number of open files
ulimit -n.rationale: Changing the open file limit can cause processes to fail if set too low.

ulimit -s.translation_modifier: setting or displaying the maximum stack size
ulimit -s.rationale: A too-small stack size can cause programs to crash.

ulimit -t.translation_modifier: setting or displaying the maximum CPU time in seconds
ulimit -t.rationale: A too-low CPU time limit can cause long-running processes to be killed.

ulimit -u.translation_modifier: setting or displaying the maximum number of user processes
ulimit -u.rationale: Restricting the process limit can prevent new processes from starting.

ulimit -v.translation_modifier: setting or displaying the maximum virtual memory size
ulimit -v.rationale: Restricting virtual memory can cause processes to fail from allocation errors.

umask -S.translation_modifier: displaying the mask in symbolic form instead of as a number
umask -S.rationale: Only changes the output format; modifies nothing.

umount -f.translation_modifier: forcibly unmounting even if the volume is in use
umount -f.rationale: Forces unmount which can cause data loss for processes with open files on the volume.

uncompress -c.translation_modifier: writing decompressed output to the terminal instead of replacing the file
uncompress -c.rationale: Leaves the compressed file unmodified; only writes to the terminal.

uncompress -f.translation_modifier: overwriting existing files without asking for confirmation
uncompress -f.rationale: Suppresses confirmation prompts when the output file already exists.

uncompress -v.translation_modifier: showing the compression ratio for each file
uncompress -v.rationale: Only adds informational output; no change to behavior.

unexpand -a.translation_modifier: converting all sequences of spaces instead of only leading ones
unexpand -a.rationale: Expands the scope of conversion but still only affects output text.

unexpand -t.rationale: Only changes tab stop spacing; no additional risk.

uniq -D.translation_modifier: printing every copy of each repeated line instead of just one

uniq -c.translation_modifier: prefixing each line with its count of occurrences
uniq -c.rationale: Adds count information to output; still read-only.

uniq -d.translation_modifier: showing only lines that appear more than once
uniq -d.rationale: Filters output to repeated lines; still read-only.

uniq -f.translation_modifier: skipping the first specified number of fields when comparing lines
uniq -f.rationale: Adjusts which parts of each line are compared; still read-only.

uniq -i.translation_modifier: ignoring differences between uppercase and lowercase letters

uniq -s.translation_modifier: skipping the first specified number of characters when comparing lines
uniq -s.rationale: Adjusts which parts of each line are compared; still read-only.

uniq -u.translation_modifier: showing only lines that are not repeated
uniq -u.rationale: Filters output to unique lines; still read-only.

units -e.rationale: Only changes how numbers are displayed; read-only operation.

units -f.translation_modifier: loading unit definitions from a custom file
units -f.rationale: Only changes which unit definitions are available; read-only operation.

units -o.translation_modifier: using a custom number format for the result
units -o.rationale: Only changes how numbers are displayed; read-only operation.

units -q.translation_modifier: suppressing the interactive prompt and unit-loading summary
units -q.rationale: Only changes what is displayed; read-only operation.

units -t.translation_modifier: printing only the conversion result with no extra text
units -t.rationale: Only changes output formatting; read-only operation.

units -v.translation_modifier: showing the units used in the conversion
units -v.rationale: Only adds detail to the output; read-only operation.

unlz4 --rm.translation_modifier: removing the source file after successful decompression
unlz4 --rm.rationale: Deletes the compressed source file once decompression succeeds.

unlz4 -c.translation_modifier: writing decompressed output to the terminal instead of a file
unlz4 -c.rationale: Leaves the source file intact; only writes to the terminal.

unlz4 -f.translation_modifier: overwriting the output file without prompting
unlz4 -f.rationale: Overwrites existing output files without confirmation.

unlz4 -k.translation_modifier: keeping the source file after decompression
unlz4 -k.rationale: Preserves the input file; this is already the default behavior.

unlz4 -m.translation_modifier: processing multiple input files at once
unlz4 -m.rationale: Processes several files in one invocation; each file is decompressed individually.

unlz4 -r.translation_modifier: operating recursively on all files in directories
unlz4 -r.rationale: Expands the scope to all matching files in directory trees.

unlz4 -t.translation_modifier: testing compressed file integrity without producing output
unlz4 -t.rationale: Read-only integrity check that does not create or modify any files.

unlz4 -v.rationale: Only adds progress information to the output.

unlzma --force.translation_modifier: overwriting existing output files without prompting
unlzma --force.rationale: Overwrites existing output files without confirmation; recoverable from backups.

unxz --force.translation_modifier: overwriting existing output files without prompting
unxz --force.rationale: Overwrites existing output files without confirmation; recoverable from backups.

unzip -C.translation_modifier: matching filenames without regard to uppercase or lowercase
unzip -C.rationale: Changes filename matching behavior; does not add destructive capability.

unzip -Z.translation_modifier: displaying detailed archive information instead of extracting
unzip -Z.rationale: Read-only display of archive metadata; no files are modified.

unzip -d.rationale: Changes the extraction destination; does not add destructive capability.

unzip -f.translation_modifier: extracting only files that already exist on disk and are newer in the archive
unzip -f.rationale: Overwrites existing files with newer versions from the archive.

unzip -j.translation_modifier: extracting without recreating the directory structure
unzip -j.rationale: Flattens all files into one directory, which may cause files with the same name to overwrite each other.

unzip -l.translation_modifier: listing the archive contents without extracting
unzip -l.rationale: Read-only listing; no files are created or modified.

unzip -o.rationale: Silently replaces existing files during extraction.

unzip -p.translation_modifier: extracting file data to standard output instead of creating files
unzip -p.rationale: Does not create files on disk; data is written to standard output.

unzip -q.rationale: Suppresses output messages; does not change extraction behavior.

unzip -t.translation_modifier: testing the archive integrity without extracting
unzip -t.rationale: Read-only integrity check; no files are created or modified.

unzip -u.translation_modifier: updating only files that are newer than existing copies and extracting new files
unzip -u.rationale: Overwrites older files and creates new ones during extraction.

unzip -x.rationale: Reduces the set of files extracted; a scope-reducing option.

unzstd --force.translation_modifier: overwriting existing output files without prompting
unzstd --force.rationale: Overwrites existing output files without confirmation; recoverable from backups.

uttype --all.translation_modifier: displaying all known uniform type identifiers
uttype --all.rationale: Read-only display of type identifier information.

uucp --recursive.rationale: Copies entire directory trees over the Unix-to-Unix Copy protocol; increases scope of files transferred.

uudecode -c.translation_modifier: decoding multiple encoded sections from the input
uudecode -c.rationale: Processes multiple encoded sections; each creates a separate output file.

uudecode -i.rationale: Prevents overwriting, making the operation safer.

uudecode -m.translation_modifier: interpreting the input as base64 format instead of traditional uuencode
uudecode -m.rationale: Only changes the expected input encoding; no additional risk.

uudecode -o.translation_modifier: writing output to a specified file instead of the filename in the encoded data
uudecode -o.rationale: Writes to a chosen file that may overwrite existing data.

uudecode -p.translation_modifier: writing decoded output to the terminal instead of a file
uudecode -p.rationale: Avoids creating or overwriting any file on disk.

uudecode -r.translation_modifier: accepting raw input that is missing the framing header and footer lines
uudecode -r.rationale: Only changes how input is parsed; no additional risk.

uudecode -s.translation_modifier: preserving the full directory path in the output filename
uudecode -s.rationale: Allows writing to directory paths embedded in the encoded data, which could overwrite files outside the current directory.

uuencode -m.translation_modifier: using base64 encoding instead of traditional uuencode format
uuencode -m.rationale: Only changes the encoding algorithm; still outputs to the terminal.

uuencode -o.translation_modifier: writing output to a specified file instead of the terminal

uuencode -r.translation_modifier: excluding the framing header and footer lines from output
uuencode -r.rationale: Only changes output formatting; no data is modified.

vacuumdb --all.translation_modifier: operating on all databases in the cluster
vacuumdb --all.rationale: Vacuums all databases; resource-intensive but not destructive.

vacuumdb --analyze.rationale: Collects statistics used by the query planner; does not modify table data.

vacuumdb --analyze-only.translation_modifier: only updating query planner statistics without reclaiming storage
vacuumdb --analyze-only.rationale: Collects statistics only; no vacuuming or data modification occurs.

vacuumdb --freeze.translation_modifier: aggressively freezing old row versions to prevent transaction ID wraparound
vacuumdb --freeze.rationale: Preventive maintenance operation that does not delete data.

vacuumdb --full.translation_modifier: performing a full vacuum that rewrites the entire table and reclaims maximum space
vacuumdb --full.rationale: Locks each table exclusively for the duration, blocking all reads and writes until complete.

vacuumdb --skip-locked.translation_modifier: skipping tables that cannot be locked immediately
vacuumdb --skip-locked.rationale: Avoids blocking on locked tables; a safety-enhancing option.

vacuumdb -j.translation_modifier: using multiple parallel jobs for faster processing
vacuumdb -j.rationale: Increases processing speed with parallelism; does not change what is vacuumed.

vacuumdb -t.rationale: Limits the operation to a single table, reducing scope and impact.

vacuumdb -v.rationale: Adds verbose diagnostic output; does not change the operation.

vacuumlo -U.rationale: Specifies the authentication identity; the user's permissions determine what is allowed.

vacuumlo -h.translation_modifier: on a specified database server host
vacuumlo -h.rationale: Specifies which server to connect to; does not change the operation.

vacuumlo -l.translation_modifier: limiting the number of large objects removed per transaction
vacuumlo -l.rationale: Reduces the number of deletions per transaction, lowering lock contention.

vacuumlo -n.translation_modifier: simulating the removal without actually deleting anything
vacuumlo -n.rationale: No data is removed; only shows what would be done.

vacuumlo -p.rationale: Specifies which port to connect on; does not change the operation.

vacuumlo -v.rationale: Adds verbose diagnostic output; does not change the operation.

vacuumlo -w.rationale: Relies on passwordless authentication methods, which may indicate a less secure connection configuration.

vi -R.translation_modifier: opening the file in read-only mode

vim -R.translation_modifier: opening the file in read-only mode
vim -R.rationale: Prevents accidental writes to the file.

vim -d.rationale: Opens files side-by-side for comparison; does not auto-save changes.

vm_stat -c.translation_modifier: stopping after a specified number of intervals
vm_stat -c.rationale: Only limits how long the monitoring runs; read-only operation.

vmmap -interleaved.translation_modifier: printing all regions in ascending address order instead of grouping by type

vmmap -noCoalesce.translation_modifier: showing each memory region separately instead of merging adjacent identical regions
vmmap -noCoalesce.rationale: Only changes the level of detail in the output.

vmmap -pages.translation_modifier: showing region sizes in page counts instead of bytes
vmmap -pages.rationale: Only changes the unit of measurement in the output.

vmmap -s.translation_modifier: sorting regions by size instead of address

vmmap -sortBySize.translation_modifier: sorting regions by size instead of address

vmmap -submap.translation_modifier: including information about virtual memory submaps
vmmap -submap.rationale: Only adds more detail to the output.

vmmap -summary.translation_modifier: printing only the summary totals without individual region details

vmmap -v.translation_modifier: showing all available detail including submaps and split libraries
vmmap -v.rationale: Only adds more information to the output.

vmmap -verbose.translation_modifier: showing all available detail including submaps and split libraries
vmmap -verbose.rationale: Only adds more information to the output.

vmmap -w.translation_modifier: showing full file paths in wide output format

vmmap -wide.translation_modifier: showing full file paths in wide output format

w -h.rationale: Only changes output formatting; read-only operation.

w -i.translation_modifier: sorting the output by idle time
w -i.rationale: Only changes the display order; read-only operation.

w -n.translation_modifier: showing network addresses instead of resolving hostnames
w -n.rationale: Only changes how host information is displayed; read-only operation.

watch -b.translation_modifier: sounding a beep when the command returns an error

watch -c.translation_modifier: interpreting color codes in the output
watch -c.rationale: Display formatting only; no effect on data.

watch -d.rationale: Visual change only; no effect on the underlying command.

watch -e.translation_modifier: stopping when the command returns an error

watch -g.rationale: Exits when a difference is detected; does not modify any data.

watch -n.translation_modifier: at a custom interval in seconds
watch -n.rationale: Changes how often the command runs; does not affect what the command does.

watch -p.translation_modifier: running at precise intervals aligned to the clock
watch -p.rationale: Adjusts timing precision; no effect on the command or data.

watch -t.translation_modifier: hiding the header showing the interval and command
